item_13463.Description: A box for storing up to 20 items. Lasts for 5 minutes once deployed. (Each player that access the storage crate can store their own items. All storage crates allow access to the same items for that player.)
item_13463.Name: Quality Storage Crate

item_13464.Description: A box for storing up to 24 items. Lasts for 5 minutes once deployed. (Each player that access the storage crate can store their own items. All storage crates allow access to the same items for that player.)
item_13464.Name: Great Storage Crate

item_13465.Description: A box for storing up to 28 items. Lasts for 5 minutes once deployed. (Each player that access the storage crate can store their own items. All storage crates allow access to the same items for that player.)
item_13465.Name: Amazing Storage Crate

item_13466.Description: A box for storing up to 32 items. Lasts for 5 minutes once deployed. (Each player that access the storage crate can store their own items. All storage crates allow access to the same items for that player.)
item_13466.Name: Astounding Storage Crate

item_1347.Description: The shell of a deceased snail. It's pretty.
item_1347.Name: Small Conch

item_1348.Description: The shell of a deceased snail. This is an especially large and pretty shell.
item_1348.Name: Large Conch

item_13481.Description: A small cask used in dairy and beer production.
item_13481.Name: Firkin

item_13482.Description: A mid-sized cask used for food and drink production.
item_13482.Name: Kilderkin

item_13483.Description: A large cask used for storing wet and dry goods.
item_13483.Name: Barrel

item_13484.Description: A large cask used for aging wine.
item_13484.Name: Hogshead

item_135.Description: Dispels even "major" (level 100+) curses, diseases, disfigurements, addictions, and botherments.
item_135.Name: Major Panacea (Admin-Provided)

item_1350.Description: It's too waterlogged and slimy to be salvaged.
item_1350.Name: Moldy Old Boot

item_13501.Description: An elaborate contraption that can dispense free items. This model can dispense up to 10 of a single kind of item.
item_13501.Name: Simple Item Dispenser

item_13502.Description: An elaborate contraption that can dispense free items. This model can dispense up to 1000 of a single kind of item.
item_13502.Name: Large-Capacity Item Dispenser

item_13503.Description: An elaborate contraption that can dispense free items. This model can dispense up to 1000 of a single kind of item and has a place for a custom message that all visitors will see.
item_13503.Name: Fancy Item Dispenser

item_1351.Description: A handful of fragmented animal shells.
item_1351.Name: Shell Fragments

item_13513.Description: An elaborate contraption that can dispense items and collect currency. This model can sell up to 10 of a single kind of item.
item_13513.Name: Simple Item Vendor

item_13514.Description: An elaborate contraption that can dispense items and collect currency. This model can sell up to 1000 of a single kind of item.
item_13514.Name: Large-Capacity Item Vendor

item_13515.Description: An elaborate contraption that can dispense items and collect currency. This model can sell up to 1000 of a single kind of item and has a place for a custom message that all users will see.
item_13515.Name: Fancy Item Vendor

item_13516.Description: For Guide use only! This is a Fancy Item Vendor that only dispenses to Demo players.
item_13516.Name: Demo-Player Item Vendor

item_13521.Description:
An elaborate contraption that can dispense free raffle tickets and then deliver a reward to the raffle winner.

This model can dispense up to 10 free raffle tickets for a single item (or item stack).
item_13521.Name: Simple Free Item Raffler

item_13522.Description:
An elaborate contraption that can dispense free raffle tickets and then deliver a reward to the raffle winner.

This model can dispense up to 20 free raffle tickets for 1 or 2 items (or item stacks) and/or a small cash prize.
item_13522.Name: Modest Free Item Raffler

item_13523.Description:
An elaborate contraption that can dispense raffle tickets and then deliver a reward to the raffle winner.

This model can dispense up to 30 raffle tickets for up to 3 items (or item stacks) and/or a cash prize. The raffle tickets can be free or can cost Councils.
item_13523.Name: Standard Item Raffler

item_13524.Description:
An elaborate contraption that can dispense raffle tickets and then deliver a reward to the raffle winner.

This model can dispense up to 50 raffle tickets for up to 6 items (or item stacks) and/or a cash prize. The raffle tickets can be free or can cost Councils. This model has a place for an inscription that is displayed to each user.
item_13524.Name: Fancy Item Raffler

item_13525.Description:
An elaborate contraption that can dispense raffle tickets and then deliver a reward to the raffle winner.

This model can dispense up to 100 raffle tickets for up to 8 items (or item stacks) and/or a cash prize. The raffle tickets can be free or can cost Councils. This model has a place for an inscription that is displayed to each user, and a message that is shown only to the winner. This model can also be configured to have a time limit of 1-120 minutes.
item_13525.Name: Advanced Item Raffler

item_13526.Description:
An elaborate contraption that can dispense raffle tickets and then deliver a reward to the raffle winner.

This model can dispense up to 1000 raffle tickets for up to 10 items (or item stacks) and/or a cash prize. The raffle tickets can be free or can cost Councils. This model has a place for an inscription that is displayed to each user, and a message that is shown only to the winner. This model can also be configured to have a time limit of 1-120 minutes.
item_13526.Name: Ultra Item Raffler

item_13527.Description: For Guide use only! This is an Ultra Item Raffler that only allows Demo players to take tickets.
item_13527.Name: Demo-Player Raffler

item_13528.Description: A raffler with all standard options, plus the ability to attune the items to the winner. For admin use.
item_13528.Name: Admin Item Raffler

item_1354.Description: The shell of a small sea snail. Some say this species comes from the fae realm, but it doesn't seem particularly unusual.
item_1354.Name: Fae Auger Shell

item_13541.Description: A simple spring-activated trap that will stun whatever walks over it. One-use.
item_13541.Name: Paralyzing Rat Trap

item_1355.Description: A particularly flat species of sea urchin. These shells are used as currency by the Ranalon.
item_1355.Name: Sand Dollar

item_13561.Description: A very basic animal cage designed for transferring pets, intended for extremely short-term use. This one-use container can hold any captive-bred (not wild-caught) Pet-Quality (non-breeding) animal for up to 48 hours. If the animal is not rehomed in a stable by then, it will escape and be lost forever. [You can use this item on a stabled pet by visiting a stablemaster. Look for the "Use Item..." button on the stable screen.]
item_13561.Name: Simple Travel Cage

item_13562.Description: Designed for longer transit periods, this travel cage provides basic sustenance and comfort for up to a week. This one-use container can hold any captive-bred (not wild-caught) Pet-Quality (non-breeding) animal for up to 7 days (168 hours). If the animal is not rehomed in a stable by then, it will escape and be lost forever. [You can use this item on a stabled pet by visiting a stablemaster. Look for the "Use Item..." button on the stable screen.]
item_13562.Name: Robust Travel Cage

item_13571.Description: A longer-term storage solution for pets. The built-in entertainment options raise the contained pet's Happiness by 10. This one-use container can hold any captive-bred (not wild-caught) Pet-Quality (non-breeding) animal for up to 14 days. If the animal is not rehomed in a stable by then, it will escape and be lost forever. [You can use this item on a stabled pet by visiting a stablemaster. Look for the "Use Item..." button on the stable screen.]
item_13571.Name: Simple Kennel

item_13572.Description: A long-term storage solution for pets. The built-in entertainment options raise the contained pets' Happiness by 20. This one-use container can hold any captive-bred (not wild-caught) Pet-Quality (non-breeding) animal for up to 28 days. If the animal is not rehomed in a stable by then, it will escape and be lost forever. [You can use this item on a stabled pet by visiting a stablemaster. Look for the "Use Item..." button on the stable screen.]
item_13572.Name: Robust Kennel

item_13573.Description: A magical freezing system for long-term pet storage. The pet is placed into suspended animation, unable to move, but still able to dream -- and to have nightmares, which cause the pet to lose all of its Happiness. This one-use container can hold any captive-bred (not wild-caught) Pet-Quality (non-breeding) animal for up to 90 days. Pets kept in this container for more than 90 days escape and are lost. [You can use this item on a stabled pet by visiting a stablemaster. Look for the "Use Item..." button on the stable screen.]
item_13573.Name: Cryogenic Pet Crate

item_1358.Description: A lovely conch that has proven to be resilient and powerful. It's amazing for making magic weapons with!
item_1358.Name: Amazing Conch

item_1359.Description: A lovely conch that has proven to be resilient and powerful. It's perfect for making magic weapons with!
item_1359.Name: Perfect Conch

item_13591.Description: A sack filled with strange substances that stay warm for a long time. (To use, give to a mother pet bee or wasp that is still guarding her larva in the 'gestation' stage. It will speed up incubation by 12 hours.)
item_13591.Name: Miniature Egg Incubator

item_13592.Description: A sack filled with strange substances that stay warm for a long time and smell reassuring to insects. (To use, give to a mother pet bee or wasp that is still guarding her larva in the 'gestation' stage. It will speed up incubation by 24 hours.)
item_13592.Name: Super Egg Incubator

item_1360.Description: A tool used aboard Fae ships during the repair of hull damage. It's quite heavy!
item_1360.Name: Articulated Cutting Arm

item_1361.Description: This lightweight piece of... metal? Is used for... something? Anyway, it's green.
item_1361.Name: Accuracy Circuit

item_1362.Description: A few drops of residue from some type of cold elemental.
item_1362.Name: Frost Elemental Runoff

item_1363.Description: A crystallized honeycomb containing an audio message. Only fae seem to be able to access these documents, but in this case it's clearly humdrum day-to-day paperwork.
item_1363.Name: "Jumpdrive Diagnostic Results"

item_1364.Description: A crystallized honeycomb containing an audio message. Only fae seem to be able to access these documents, but in this case it's clearly humdrum day-to-day paperwork.
item_1364.Name: "Dimensional Scan Repair Log"

item_1365.Description: A crystallized honeycomb containing an audio message. Only fae seem to be able to access these documents, but in this case it's clearly humdrum day-to-day paperwork.
item_1365.Name: "Entropic Barrier Maintenance Requirements"

item_1366.Description: A small lump of gold with arrows carved into it. It seems to be a pawn for some sort of game.
item_1366.Name: Golden Zelta Token

item_1367.Description: A small shiny green rock with arrows carved into it. It seems to be a pawn for some sort of game.
item_1367.Name: Aventurine Zelta Token

item_1368.Description: It's a sealed pouch with a mineral inside.
item_1368.Name: Mortal-Realm Mineral Sample

item_1369.Description: It's a sealed pouch with something inside.
item_1369.Name: Mortal-Realm Flora Sample

EffectDescs: Pigs gain +15 Pig Damage for 30 minutes
item_13701.Name: Wooden Figurine of a Pig

EffectDescs: Deer gain +15 Deer Damage for 30 minutes
item_13702.Name: Wooden Figurine of a Deer

item_13703.Name: Wooden Figurine of a Black Bear

EffectDescs: Rabbits gain +15 Rabbit Damage for 30 minutes
item_13704.Name: Wooden Figurine of a Bunny

item_13705.Name: Wooden Figurine of a Barn Owl

EffectDescs: Pigs gain +35 Pig Damage for 30 minutes
item_13707.Name: Wooden Figurine of a Hog

EffectDescs: Deer gain +35 Deer Damage for 30 minutes
item_13708.Name: Wooden Figurine of a Buck

item_13709.Name: Wooden Figurine of a Cave Bear

EffectDescs: Rabbits gain +35 Rabbit Damage for 30 minutes
item_13710.Name: Wooden Figurine of a Rabbit

item_13711.Name: Wooden Figurine of a Horned Owl

item_13717.Name: Wooden Figurine of a Great Rhino

EffectDescs: Pigs gain +60 Pig Damage for 30 minutes
item_13721.Name: Wooden Figurine of a Boar

EffectDescs: Deer gain +60 Deer Damage for 30 minutes
item_13722.Name: Wooden Figurine of a Stag

item_13723.Name: Wooden Figurine of a Grizzly Bear

EffectDescs: Rabbits gain +60 Rabbit Damage for 30 minutes
item_13724.Name: Wooden Figurine of a Hare

item_13725.Name: Wooden Figurine of a Great Owl

item_13728.Name: Wooden Figurine of a Shaggy Camel

item_1374.Description: A small bit of xogrite, used as currency in distant rakshasa outposts. The process of making this alloy is a closely-guarded secret, but one of its ingredients seems to be xedrite.
item_1374.Name: Xogrite Chunk

item_1375.Description: The giant glowy sack from a dead tentakiller.
item_1375.Name: Tentakiller Gland

item_1376.Description: A giant rubbery tentacle, not unlike an octopus tentacle (if the octopus was nightmarishly large).
item_1376.Name: Tentakiller Tentacle

item_1377.Description: A slimy three-pronged tongue from a kuvou corpse.
item_1377.Name: Kuvou Tongue

item_1378.Description: A strange organ cut out of a kuvou corpse.
item_1378.Name: Kuvou Poison Sack

item_1379.Description: The sharp, bony appendage of a hexapus.
item_1379.Name: Hexapus Arm

item_1380.Description: One of the rings of sharp teeth found in the "mouth" of a hexapus.
item_1380.Name: Hexapus Mouth Ring

item_1381.Description: A decent-sized frog. It's still alive, for now. It is comfortable being held and may have been someone's pet.
item_1381.Name: Frog

item_1382.Description: Used by orcs to smoke raw (unrefined) gur-horta.
item_1382.Name: Orcish Pipe

item_1383.Description: This large net has seen heavy use, and now needs significant repair... or, more likely, replacement.
item_1383.Name: Broken Fishing Net

item_1384.Description: This high-quality fishing hook was made by an expert blacksmith.
item_1384.Name: Iron Fishing Hook

item_1385.Description: This strain of gur-horta is relatively weak, making it a poor choice for refining into combat potions. However, it's popular among orcs that smoke the leaves recreationally due to its mellow taste and low side-effects.
item_1385.Name: Povus Gur-Horta Leaves

item_1386.Description: Parts of a broken sword blade. Looks like it was once an orcish khopesh, but it's not repairable.
item_1386.Name: Broken Sword

item_1387.Description: Smithed from iron, these washers are used in making and maintaining orcish traps.
item_1387.Name: Iron Trap Spacers

item_1388.Description: Carefully tailored to the eyes of a ratkin, these are worn when a ratkin must go outside during bright sun. The lenses are made of blue glass.
item_1388.Name: Ratkin Glare Protectors

item_1389.Description: A huge, pointy, surprisingly old-looking bone.
item_1389.Name: Triceratops Horn Bone

item_1390.Description: The bones of an extinct creature's tail.
item_1390.Name: Bone Tail Assembly

item_1391.Description: Part of an extinct species of great cat.
item_1391.Name: Ancient Cat Jawbone

item_1392.Description: The slimy, sticky skin of a toxic frog. DO NOT LICK!
item_1392.Name: Toxic Frog Skin

item_1393.Description: This handful of dirt is weird and smelly and full of fungus.
item_1393.Name: Spore-Infested Dirt

item_1394.Description: Most are nondescript, but a few have streaks of quartz.
item_1394.Name: Pebbles

item_1395.Description: Powdered bone prepared via a secret necromantic ritual. This is used by necromancers to summon undead skeletons.
item_1395.Name: Necromancy Dust

item_1397.Description: The hacked-off claw of an aktaari. This is a grim trophy that is upsetting for aktaari to see.
item_1397.Name: Aktaari Claw

item_1398.Description: The bile gland of an aktaari. This horrific trophy Is upsetting for aktaari to see.
item_1398.Name: Aktaari Bile Gland

item_1400.Description: The dismembered claw of a demonic beast. Dangerous to the touch.
item_1400.Name: Osslar Claw

item_14001.Description: A simple wooden key with a faint green magical glow.
item_14001.Name: Wooden Key

item_14002.Description: A key cut from magical ice. It won't melt until it is used in whatever strange door it's designed for.
item_14002.Name: Winter Nexus Key

item_14003.Description:
A brief note written in a lovely flowing script. It says,

"Do you remember when your helm was shattered? Probably not. You gave it to me to repair, but it was beyond my skill. I took it to Haetrix, who used inappropriately-strong magic, and now its reality is damaged. Anyway, if your helm disappears in a puff of logic, don't fret. I've locked it in a box for you near the Sun Vale mouth. Gut a troll to light the lamp light, rip the wings off a deviant fae for the second, and rip out the stomach of your least favorite ogre for the third.

- Trallix"
item_14003.Name: Note to Algid Overseer Winterhue

item_14004.Description: A key cut from magical ice.
item_14004.Name: Dementia Puck's Key

item_14005.Description: A key formed of dirt, held in place via magic.
item_14005.Name: Fae Animal Nexus Key

item_14006.Description: It's a piece of lacquered wood shaped like a long worm with a fanged mouth. Pretty impressive, really.
item_14006.Name: Gulagra's Sigil Key

item_14007.Description: It's a small parchment with a magical inscription. You can use this to get past a huge icy barrier beneath the ruined tower in Kur.
item_14007.Name: Ice Bypass Spell

item_14008.Description: A small metal key you found in a cave in Kur Mountains.
item_14008.Name: Wolf Loot Key

item_14009.Description: A metal key from Gravamux, a ghoul.
item_14009.Name: Gravamux's Key

item_1401.Description: One of the spikes from the back of a demonic Osslar.
item_1401.Name: Osslar Spike

item_14010.Description: A crystal used to unlock certain Crone Hegemony armory chests. This one is partially digested, but should still work.
item_14010.Name: Hegemonic Storage Key

item_14011.Description: An ancient stone key, worn by yetis as a good luck token.
item_14011.Name: Yeti Key

item_14012.Description:
A note in a jaggy, hurried handwriting. It says,

"Test is still underway. I have passed the Combat and Teleportation trials, but I can't figure out how to get into the locked chest with the altars around it. I used Divination, but the only answer I got was 'SEWN'.

I still have my secret weapon: a Potion of Brilliance. Will drink it if necessary, but leaving it here for now."
item_14012.Name: Journal Entry

item_14013.Description:
A metal key with a note attached. In flowery script it says,

"My dear Lawyr, I knew you could do it! Meet me on the mainland and I'll help you recover your destiny. - Yurra"
item_14013.Name: Chest Key

item_14015.Description: It's a parchment with strange symbols on it. Perhaps someone could explain its meaning to you.
item_14015.Name: Symbols of Darkness

item_14016.Description: A drop of blood that's been affected by the fae realm. Winterprize crystals are known to be sensitive to this sort of blood. Carrying it in large quantities is unwise, however, as it can corrupt the bearer. (You cannot carry more than 6 at once.)
item_14016.Name: Winter Fae Blood

item_14017.Description: Lets you leap high and control your fall. You also take no damage from falls, no matter how high. On the down side, you'll be too disoriented to effectively fight, and your attacks will deal very little damage.
EffectDescs: Boosts jumping abilities dramatically, and reduces all attacks by 90%, for 2 minutes
item_14017.Name: Superjump Potion

item_14018.Description: Lets you fly for 5 minutes (press the Move Up key to begin). Also grants immunity to falling damage. Only usable outdoors; entering a dungeon will cause the effect to immediately end.
item_14018.Name: Flight Potion

item_14019.Description: Lets you sprint very, very fast. (Hold down shift key to switch between sprinting and walking.) You also take no damage from falls. Lasts 2 minutes.
item_14019.Name: Super Speed Potion

item_1402.Description: The proboscis-like organ of a grickling. Revolting.
item_1402.Name: Gricklicker

item_14020.Description: A bulky wooden cup full of greenish energy. You can sip this in your dying moments in order to come back to life. Only druids can consume this energy.
item_14020.Name: Chalice of Life

item_14021.Description: A bone key that fits in any of the special event loot chests in Serbule. (Look behind the inn.)
item_14021.Name: Event Loot Key (Universal)

item_14022.Description: A bone key that fits in the special chest in Serbule for level 15-20 loot. (Look behind the inn.)
item_14022.Name: Level 15-20 Event Loot Key

item_14023.Description: A bone key that fits in the special chest in Serbule for level 30 loot. (Look behind the inn.)
item_14023.Name: Level 30 Event Loot Key

item_14024.Description: A bone key that fits in the special chest in Serbule for level 40 loot. (Look behind the inn.)
item_14024.Name: Level 40 Event Loot Key

item_14025.Description: A bone key that fits in the special chest in Serbule for level 50 loot. (Look behind the inn.)
item_14025.Name: Level 50 Event Loot Key

item_14026.Description: A bone key that fits in the special chest in Serbule for level 60 loot. (Look behind the inn.)
item_14026.Name: Level 60 Event Loot Key

item_14027.Description: A transferrable day-pass to visit the parts of Rahu that are usually off-limits to tourists. While this permit lasts, the citizens of Rahu will not attack you and shopkeepers will generally be willing to deal with you. The pass becomes invalidated if you attack any Rahu citizen, and the plateau where the Onkara train is still off-limits.
EffectDescs: Grants access to back-areas of Rahu for 90 minutes
item_14027.Name: Rahu Visitor's Permit

item_14028.Description: A thin blanket embroidered with a depiction of a beaming sun. This style of blanket is often given out by followers of Arisetsu, the god of warmth and hope.
EffectDescs: Restores 20 Body Heat, Cures Hypothermia and Frostbite (one-time use)
item_14028.Name: Simple Arisetsu Blanket

item_14029.Description: A rotten urak egg. Completely valueless.
item_14029.Name: Unfertilized Dead Urak Egg

item_1403.Description: A glowing eye from a grickling.
item_1403.Name: Grickling Eye

item_14030.Description: A Gazluk officer's key to one of the armory storage chests.
item_14030.Name: Gazluk Armory Key

item_14031.Description: The key to a goblin hoard chest, typically one of several keys needed to unlock it.
item_14031.Name: Gobkey Alpha

item_14032.Description: The key to a goblin hoard chest, typically one of several keys needed to unlock it.
item_14032.Name: Gobkey Beta

item_14033.Description: The key to a goblin hoard chest, typically one of several keys needed to unlock it.
item_14033.Name: Gobkey Gamma

item_14034.Description:
A handwritten note. It says,

"If you're reading this then I didn't make it out alive. Please help my friends, they're still trapped in this horrible cave. Look for the ever-burn campfire. We're camped around it because it keeps the spiders away somewhat.

We came for spider eggs, and the spiders seemed weak enough. But as we climbed higher into the caves to reach the egg-chambers, we found MUCH harder ones. Soum died when a spider exploded out of him... we all freaked out and ran... now we can't escape because of injuries. Help, please! And if you're here for spider eggs, turn back now. - Cole Fensmith"
item_14034.Name: Plea for Help

item_14035.Description: A bone key that fits in the special chest in Serbule for level 70 loot. (Look behind the inn.)
item_14035.Name: Level 70 Event Loot Key

item_14036.Description: This series of books by the goblin sage Muligu details each god that might be able to help you with a knowledge-related question.
item_14036.Name: "The Gods of Knowledge, Vol. 1"

item_14037.Description: This series of books by the goblin sage Muligu details each god that might be able to help you with a knowledge-related question.
item_14037.Name: "The Gods of Knowledge, Vol. 2"

item_14038.Description: This series of books by the goblin sage Muligu details each god that might be able to help you with a knowledge-related question.
item_14038.Name: "The Gods of Knowledge, Vol. 3"

item_14039.Description: This series of books by the goblin sage Muligu details each god that might be able to help you with a knowledge-related question.
item_14039.Name: "The Gods of Knowledge, Vol. 4"

item_1404.Description: This import from the Crone Hegemony doesn't do anything directly -- although the eye in the amulet does follow you around and glare. It is primarily used as a base magic source by magical jewelrycrafters.
item_1404.Name: Glaring Amulet

item_14040.Description: The work of a master stoneshaper, this key is a miniature work of art. It may unlock something somewhere, but even if not, it's an interesting curio.
item_14040.Name: Ranalon Key

item_14043.Description: This ticket entitles the bearer to a free game of Monsters and Mantids at any table in the Red Wing Casino.
item_14043.Name: Monsters and Mantids Free-Play Ticket

item_14044.Description: This ticket entitles the bearer to a free game of Lootmaster Match-3 at the Red Wing Casino.
item_14044.Name: Lootmaster Free-Play Ticket

item_14045.Description: This ticket entitles the bearer to a free game of Cashfall Match-3 at the Red Wing Casino.
item_14045.Name: Cashfall Free-Play Ticket

item_14046.Description: A small runestone that's worth a small fortune at the Red Wing Casino. See Qatik to trade this for 5,000 Councils.
item_14046.Name: Black Windfall Stone

item_14047.Description: A small runestone that's worth a small fortune at the Red Wing Casino. See Qatik to trade this for 7,000 Councils.
item_14047.Name: Green Windfall Stone

item_14048.Description: A small runestone that's worth a small fortune at the Red Wing Casino. See Qatik to trade this for 10,000 Councils.
item_14048.Name: Blue Windfall Stone

item_14049.Description: A small runestone that's worth a small fortune at the Red Wing Casino. See Qatik to trade this for 15,000 Councils.
item_14049.Name: Red Windfall Stone

item_1405.Description: This flask is made of nice metal - pity it has a huge hole in the side.
item_1405.Name: Ruined Metal Flask

item_14050.Description: A small runestone that's worth a small fortune at the Red Wing Casino. See Qatik to trade this for 20,000 Councils.
item_14050.Name: Orange Windfall Stone

item_14051.Description: A small runestone that's worth a small fortune at the Red Wing Casino. See Qatik to trade this for 25,000 Councils.
item_14051.Name: Violet Windfall Stone

item_14052.Description: A small runestone that's worth a small fortune at the Red Wing Casino. See Qatik to trade this for 50,000 Councils.
item_14052.Name: Yellow Windfall Stone

item_14053.Description: This reddish token is made of very thin metal. There are tiny inscrutable symbols painted on the back side. (See Qatik at the Red Wing Casino to trade these tokens for prizes.)
item_14053.Name: Red Wing Token

item_14054.Description: A small plush bear. It's enchanted to give encouraging messages when you're sad.
item_14054.Name: Stuffed Toy Bear

item_14055.Description: See Qatik in the Red Wing Casino to trade this token in for a magical crown!
item_14055.Name: Crown Token

item_14056.Description: A lovely stuffed toy with joyous cymbal-clashing action. It can be deployed periodically to entertain others.
item_14056.Name: Cymbal Monkey

item_14057.Description: A tiny key made of jade.
item_14057.Name: Weird Key

item_14058.Description: Made of an unfamiliar metal, this key has weird lines etched all over it.
item_14058.Name: Alien Key

item_14059.Description: A weird symbol carved into a strange metal.
item_14059.Name: Ratkin Necromancer's Talisman

item_1406.Description: This might have been a treasure map! But it's ruined now.
item_1406.Name: Soggy Map

item_14060.Description: An old key encrusted in slime. Somehow it passed beyond the veil of death! But it's back now.
item_14060.Name: Velmer's Key

item_14061.Description: A small valuable item encased in protective goop. The goblin technique for removing the stuff requires special equipment. Perhaps there's another means to open it.
item_14061.Name: Goblands Transit Pod

item_14062.Description: A fancy key that can open any Minotaur Vault. For security reasons the key is destroyed upon use.
item_14062.Name: Minotaur Vault Master Key

item_14063.Description: A piece of paper that says "This document is worth 1 (one) Sir Johnson Buck, redeemable at participating commissaries. Sir Johnson retains the right to confiscate this document if he thinks you stole it." Beneath the impeccably-handwritten note is an illegible scrawl that you assume is Sir Johnson's signature.
item_14063.Name: Sir Johnson Buck

item_14064.Description: The first volume in a series of travelogues and interviews by the semi-famous mage Reginald.
item_14064.Name: The Sage's Lectern, Vol. 1

item_14065.Description: The second volume in a series of travelogues and interviews by the semi-famous mage Reginald.
item_14065.Name: The Sage's Lectern, Vol. 2

item_14066.Description: The title is dull, but the cover art suggests something... less dull. However, someone has torn out the front half of the book, leaving only appendices.
item_14066.Name: The Origin of 'Tast's Pack'

item_14067.Description: A bone key that fits in the special chest in Serbule for level 80 loot. (Look behind the inn.)
item_14067.Name: Level 80 Event Loot Key

item_14068.Description:
This token can be redeemed with -ADMIN- Jackencola for up to a level 80 max-enchanted ring, necklace or piece of armor of choice.
This token can only be redeemed by the account that won it. The prize is non-transferable.
item_14068.Name: MEGA Raffle Prize Token

item_14069.Description: This token is the special currency of the Crafter's Guild. It seems to have no real Council value to it, but the members of the Crafting Caravan value them for trade among fellow professionals.
item_14069.Name: Crafter's Guild Token

item_1407.Description: This piece of parchment has been folded into the shape of a boat.
item_1407.Name: Paper Boat

item_14070.Description: The strange substance in this bag can keep dying fairies from leaving this plane of existence. It costs 50 Fae Energy to use this item. It smells of honey. (This item is useless to non-fae.)
EffectDescs: Respawns you at this area's entrance (instead of the Fae Realm)
item_14070.Name: Fairy Soul Anchor

item_14071.Description:
This special mixture grants you the ability to carry more stuff at one time, which is essential when out traveling for a long period of time.
This effect does not stack with other inventory expansion potions from Orran and overrides all inventory Words of Power.
item_14071.Name: Orran's Inventory Expander Potion

item_14072.Description:
This special mixture grants you the ability to carry a lot more stuff at one time, which is essential when out traveling for a long period of time.
This effect does not stack with other inventory expansion potions from Orran and overrides all inventory Words of Power.
item_14072.Name: Orran's Super Inventory Expander Potion

item_14073.Description:
This special mixture grants you the ability to carry a whole lot more stuff at one time, which is essential when out traveling for a long period of time.
This effect does not stack with other inventory expansion potions from Orran and overrides all inventory Words of Power.
item_14073.Name: Orran's Ultra Inventory Expander Potion

item_14074.Description: A strange cube. It once held augmentation magic, but it's been damaged beyond repair. You might be able to salvage something from it... if you knew how to open it without shattering it.
item_14074.Name: Broken Augment

item_14075.Description: This crate contains one pet, ready for travel or just some R&R.
item_14075.Name: Caged Pet

item_14076.Description: This token was earned by participating in a live event. The live-event system no longer uses tokens like this, though, and now this token is just a reminder of fun times had.
item_14076.Name: Live Event Memorabilia

item_14077.Description: Part of an abomination. It has an identification mark branded into it. Might be useful to impersonate an abomination... but mostly just junk.
item_14077.Name: Identification Gland

item_14078.Description: A beautiful collar with a unique identification number chiseled into the inside. As well as being made of silver, it might be useful for accessing certain supply crates.
item_14078.Name: Silver Hippogriff Collar

item_1408.Description: A beat up wooden spoon. It's taken some damage.
item_1408.Name: Wooden Spoon

item_14081.Description: An exotic key. As a security mechanism, it self-destructs after a few days.
item_14081.Name: Transport Security Card

item_14082.Description: A special token from Raim to barter for a special advanced item.
item_14082.Name: Raim's Advanced Crafting Token

item_14083.Description: A special token from Moxie to barter for a special advanced item.
item_14083.Name: Moxie's Advanced Crafting Token

item_14084.Description: An old metal key from a dusty old chest you found under Hogan's Keep. Utterly unremarkable.
item_14084.Name: Dusty Key

item_14085.Description: A shiny metal key from a goblin jewelry chest that you found under Hogan's Keep. Very well polished.
item_14085.Name: Shiny Key

item_14086.Description: A scorched metal key you found in the belly of a fire spider under Hogan's Keep. This key has seen some hot action.
item_14086.Name: Scorched Key

item_14087.Description: An antique, encrusted metal key. Unfortunately it appears to be encrusted in bear shit.
item_14087.Name: Bear Key

item_14088.Description: The bleeding end clotted up fast, so this severed goblin thumb is a little less disgusting than it could be.
item_14088.Name: Minizhemu's Severed Finger

item_1409.Description: These are perfect for corking bottles of craftable wine.
item_1409.Name: Corks

item_14090.Description: Teaches you how to summon a vendor fox from a box.
item_14090.Name: Event: Vendor Fox in a Box

item_14091.Description: A small handheld device with a large amethyst set in the center used to teleport the wielder to an attuned location. This device will self destruct when the charge has expired.
item_14091.Name: Personal Teleportation Device - Serbule

item_14092.Description: A small handheld device with a large amethyst set in the center used to teleport the wielder to an attuned location. This device will self destruct when the charge has expired.
item_14092.Name: Personal Teleportation Device - Eltibule

item_14093.Description: A small handheld device with a large amethyst set in the center used to teleport the wielder to an attuned location. This device will self destruct when the charge has expired.
item_14093.Name: Personal Teleportation Device - Kur Mountains

item_14094.Description: A small handheld device with a large amethyst set in the center used to teleport the wielder to an attuned location. This device will self destruct when the charge has expired.
EffectDescs: Teleports wielder to the Ilmari Desert
item_14094.Name: Personal Teleportation Device - Ilmari Desert

item_14095.Description: A small handheld device with a large amethyst set in the center used to teleport the wielder to an attuned location. This device will self destruct when the charge has expired.
item_14095.Name: Personal Teleportation Device - Sun Vale

item_14096.Description: A small handheld device with a large amethyst set in the center used to teleport the wielder to an attuned location. This device will self destruct when the charge has expired.
EffectDescs: Teleports wielder to New Prestonbule in Gazluk
item_14096.Name: Personal Teleportation Device - New Prestonbule

item_14097.Description: A small handheld device with a large amethyst set in the center used to teleport the wielder to an attuned location. This device will self destruct when the charge has expired.
EffectDescs: Teleports wielder to the Fae Realm
item_14097.Name: Personal Teleportation Device - Fae Realm

item_14098.Description: A small handheld device with a large amethyst set in the center used to teleport the wielder to an attuned location. This device will self destruct when the charge has expired.
item_14098.Name: Personal Teleportation Device - Serbule Hills

item_14099.Description: A small handheld device with a large amethyst set in the center used to teleport the wielder to an attuned location. This device will self destruct when the charge has expired.
item_14099.Name: Personal Teleportation Device - Rahu

item_1410.Description: A handful of buttons of all shapes and sizes.
item_1410.Name: Buttons

item_14100.Description: A small handheld device studded with aquamarines that can summon a portal to an attuned location. This device will self destruct when all of the charges have been used up.
EffectDescs: Summons a portal to Kur Tower for 5 minutes
item_14100.Name: Portal Summoning Device - Kur Tower

item_14101.Description: A small handheld device studded with aquamarines that can summon a portal to an attuned location. This device will self destruct when all of the charges have been used up.
EffectDescs: Summons a portal to the Eltibule Goblin Dungeon for 5 minutes
item_14101.Name: Portal Summoning Device - Goblin Dungeon

item_14102.Description: A small handheld device studded with aquamarines that can summon a portal to an attuned location. This device will self destruct when all of the charges have been used up.
EffectDescs: Summons a portal to the Ilmari Labyrinth for 5 minutes
item_14102.Name: Portal Summoning Device - Ilmari Labyrinth

item_14103.Description: A small handheld device studded with aquamarines that can summon a portal to an attuned location. This device will self destruct when all of the charges have been used up.
EffectDescs: Summons a portal to Gazluk Keep for 5 minutes
item_14103.Name: Portal Summoning Device - Gazluk Keep

item_14104.Description: A small handheld device studded with aquamarines that can summon a portal to an attuned location. This device will self destruct when all of the charges have been used up. IMPORTANT: Everyone must have a Transport Security Card in their inventory to use this portal!
EffectDescs: Summons a portal to the Wintertide for 5 minutes
item_14104.Name: Portal Summoning Device - The Wintertide

item_14105.Description: Teaches you how to deploy a special storage box.
item_14105.Name: Event: Small Box of Space

item_14106.Description: A dead starfish. It's covered in a strange goop that stings to the touch.
item_14106.Name: Creepy Starfish

item_14107.Description: An all-purpose token that can be used for various special or live events. To use or redeem this token, please follow the instructions given from the event you acquired it from. Please note that this token could disappear without notice once the associated event has ended.
item_14107.Name: Copper Event Token

item_14108.Description: An all-purpose token that can be used for various special or live events. To use or redeem this token, please follow the instructions given from the event you acquired it from. Please note that this token could disappear without notice once the associated event has ended.
item_14108.Name: Silver Event Token

item_14109.Description: An all-purpose token that can be used for various special or live events. To use or redeem this token, please follow the instructions given from the event you acquired it from. Please note that this token could disappear without notice once the associated event has ended.
item_14109.Name: Gold Event Token

item_1411.Description: These could be worn as small bracelets were it not for the extreme pain they cause when in contact with flesh. They emit a continuous shock.
item_1411.Name: Prickly Metal Rings

item_14110.Description: A token of Ri-Shin's favor. The small branch is still fresh, with quite a few leaves. (See Snowleaf at the Shrine of Ri-Shin in Kur Mountains to trade these tokens for items.)
item_14110.Name: Ri-Shin Token

item_14111.Description: It's just a big sack of money.
item_14111.Name: Pennoc's Pension

item_14112.Description: A special potion that works similar to a Fairy Soul Anchor. Drinking this potion will grant a Fairy immunity from the Fae death penalty in the zone you are anchored to. IMPORTANT: You must drink this potion BEFORE you die! The effect will dispel if you leave the zone you are anchored to or logout.
EffectDescs: Grants temporary Fae death penalty immunity
item_14112.Name: Liquid Soul Anchor

item_14113.Description: When your snoot is just too tender to handle getting booped. Apply moderately to snoot. Reapply every 30 minutes as needed.
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, you suffer 5% less damage from Crushing attacks
item_14113.Name: Anti-Booping Cream

item_14117.Description: An acorn found on an old treant that had been growing in mire for ages. It apparently couldn't grow in that soil, but perhaps there's similar soil elsewhere in Povus that would work?
item_14117.Name: Foul Acorn

item_14118.Description: These notes describe how to use a "genetics analyzer" to discover hidden anatomical secrets of arthropods. It's very technical.
EffectDescs: Teaches you basic Arthropod Genetic Analysis
item_14118.Name: Secrets of Arthropod Genetics

item_14119.Description: An old key coated in purple fungus.
item_14119.Name: Mushroomy Key

item_1412.Description: From an Aktaari rake. They use them to cultivate evu fruit.
item_1412.Name: Broken Rake Handle

item_14120.Description: An old key coated in bright red goo.
item_14120.Name: Blood-Red Key

item_14121.Description: An old key marred by rust.
item_14121.Name: Somewhat Rusted Key

item_14122.Description: The key to a goblin equipment chest.
item_14122.Name: Crusty Gobkey

item_14123.Description: This item exists for validation purposes -- it is the prototypical item that cannot be sent to a saddlebag under any circumstances.
item_14123.Name: Validation Item 1

item_14124.Description: A poorly crafted music box that sounds like a lute for animal forms so they can play music for their plants. This box looks like it is only good for one use before it will break. Don't forget to start it up after you deploy it! IMPORTANT: You must be in beast form for at least 3 hours of in-game time before you can deploy this item. Leaving beast form after deploying will cause you to lose control of the box. Limit one music box deployment per account at a time.
EffectDescs: Deploys a music box that will play for 30 minutes with the effectiveness of a level 15 lute player.
item_14124.Name: Shoddy Music Box

item_14125.Description: A well crafted music box that sounds like a harp for animal forms so they can play music for their plants. This box looks sturdy enough for a few uses before it will break. Don't forget to start it up after you deploy it! IMPORTANT: You must be in beast form for at least 3 hours of in-game time before you can deploy this item. Leaving beast form after deploying will cause you to lose control of the box. Limit one music box deployment per account at a time.
EffectDescs: Deploys a music box that will play for 1 hour with the effectiveness of a level 40 harp player.
item_14125.Name: Sturdy Music Box

item_14126.Description: A fae fruit that can make any piece of equipment look like an entirely different piece of equipment when worn. Just crush it up to absorb its power. [When you use this berry you'll receive one Glamour, and automatically learn the recipe to use Glamours if you don't already know how.]
item_14126.Name: Glamour Berry

item_14127.Description: A voucher for 10 Live Event Credits. Credits will be given to the person that uses this voucher.
EffectDescs: Grants 10 Live Event Credits upon use
item_14127.Name: 10 LEC Voucher

item_14128.Description: A voucher for 25 Live Event Credits. Credits will be given to the person that uses this voucher.
EffectDescs: Grants 25 Live Event Credits upon use
item_14128.Name: 25 LEC Voucher

item_14129.Description: A voucher for 50 Live Event Credits. Credits will be given to the person that uses this voucher.
EffectDescs: Grants 50 Live Event Credits upon use
item_14129.Name: 50 LEC Voucher

item_1413.Description: These were probably part of a child's game set. There are only a handful left.
item_1413.Name: Child's Game Pieces

item_14130.Description: A voucher for 100 Live Event Credits. Credits will be given to the person that uses this voucher.
EffectDescs: Grants 100 Live Event Credits upon use
item_14130.Name: 100 LEC Voucher

item_14131.Description: A small handheld device with a large amethyst set in the center used to teleport the wielder to an attuned location. This device will self destruct when the charge has expired.
item_14131.Name: Personal Teleportation Device - Povus

item_14132.Description: A fae fruit that can make any piece of equipment look like an entirely different piece of equipment when worn. Just smash it open to absorb its power. [When you use this gourd you'll receive one Glamour, and automatically learn the recipe to use Glamours if you don't already know how.]
item_14132.Name: Glamour Gourd

item_14133.Description: A small handheld device studded with aquamarines that can summon a portal to an attuned location. This device will self destruct when all of the charges have been used up. IMPORTANT: You must be friends with Mope in Povus to use this portal!
EffectDescs: Summons a portal to the Fungal Fortress for 5 minutes
item_14133.Name: Portal Summoning Device - Fungal Fortress

item_14134.Description:
This token can be redeemed with -ADMIN- Jackencola for up to a level 85 legendary mastercrafted piece of modded gear.
This token can only be redeemed by the account that won it. The prize is non-transferable.
item_14134.Name: MEGA Raffle Prize Token

item_14135.Description: A magical token that allows access to the lower levels of the Anagoge Records Facility.
item_14135.Name: Proctor's Pass

item_14136.Description: Pop the top and chug it down for 24 hours of getting down! This foul tasting fizzy liquid will grant you super buffs for 24 hours of real time. This liquid will destablize and evaporate 60 days after it is created, so use it quickly! Buffs include: Combat & crafting xp. Extra fish, mushrooms, wood, seeds and fruit. Gardening bonus harvest chance. Survey and mining buffs. Training discount. Meal and snack time buffs. Vendor stall discount. NPC workorder bonus. Faster liver recovery. IMPORTANT!: There is no visible timer on these buffs, so be sure to note the time when you drink this!
item_14136.Name: Liquid Super Buffs! (24 Hours)

item_14137.Description: Pop the top and chug it down for 48 hours of getting down! This foul tasting fizzy liquid will grant you super buffs for 48 hours of real time. This liquid will destablize and evaporate 60 days after it is created, so use it quickly! Buffs include: Combat & crafting xp. Extra fish, mushrooms, wood, seeds and fruit. Gardening bonus harvest chance. Survey and mining buffs. Training discount. Meal and snack time buffs. Vendor stall discount. NPC workorder bonus. Faster liver recovery. IMPORTANT!: There is no visible timer on these buffs, so be sure to note the time when you drink this!
item_14137.Name: Liquid Super Buffs! (48 Hours)

item_14138.Description: Pop the top and chug it down for 24 hours of getting down! This foul tasting fizzy liquid will grant you super buffs for 24 hours of real time. This liquid will destablize and evaporate 60 days after it is created, so use it quickly! Buffs include: Combat & crafting xp. Extra fish, mushrooms, wood, seeds and fruit. Gardening bonus harvest chance. Survey and mining buffs. Training discount. Meal and snack time buffs. Vendor stall discount. NPC workorder bonus. Faster liver recovery. IMPORTANT!: There is no visible timer on these buffs, so be sure to note the time when you drink this!
item_14138.Name: Liquid Super Buffs! (24 Hours)

item_14139.Description: It's a flier about supporting "local fauna", whatever that means. But it's very hard to read because most of the text is mirrored. Very strange.
item_14139.Name: Support Local Fauna Initiative

item_1414.Description: Made by ranalon to feed their pet frogs during low-insect times. They can also be eaten by ranalon in an emergency.
item_1414.Name: Giant Frog Food

item_14140.Description: It's a rough sketch of a bear wearing a pirate hat. It is holding a jug of rum. Along the top are the words "When it's all too much to bear, say yoho!" and along the bottom: "Remga's Raging Rum"
item_14140.Name: Discarded Rum Label

item_14141.Description: It claims that the holder of this letter is entitled to one fiftieth (1/50) of a door opening, or one tenth (1/10) of a free magical scroll. It doesn't say how one would redeem the letter, however.
item_14141.Name: Letter of Authority

item_14142.Description: It claims that the holder of this letter is entitled to nothing. Absolutely nothing.
item_14142.Name: Letter of Futility

item_14143.Description: It's a cracked bottle that stinks of rum. There was a label once, but it's mostly peeled off.
item_14143.Name: Empty Rum Bottle

item_14144.Description: A pile of flaky rock. What could this be for?
item_14144.Name: Orange Hubris

item_14145.Description: A mixture of grains to keep your birds fat, happy and energized.
item_14145.Name: Bird Feed

item_14146.Description: Use this item to summon a temporary trash can that anyone can use. Note: Items thrown in the trash are lost forever!
EffectDescs: Can be deployed briefly for everyone to clean up their trash. Disappears after 5 minutes, and has a 15 minute cooldown.
item_14146.Name: Portable Trash Can

item_14147.Description: Grants a brief period of vincibility to the usually-invincible.
EffectDescs: Your next direct attack will apply anti-invincibility poison to the target for 15 seconds
item_14147.Name: Anti-Invincibility Poison

item_14148.Description: A key for a student's trunk. Ah, the sight of this key takes you back!
item_14148.Name: Trunk Key

item_14149.Description: This writ is redeemable for 1 point during the Writ Challenge event.
EffectDescs: Adds one point to the Writ Challenge score
item_14149.Name: Writ of Unlock

item_1415.Description: Meant to prank your friends, these bombs don't explode. They are rightly disdained by most sentient persons.
item_1415.Name: Prank Bombs

item_14150.Description: This writ is redeemable for 25 points and 250,000 councils during the Writ Challenge event. Use this writ to get a special quest, then see the Writ Master located near the Serbule well to collect your prize.
EffectDescs: Unlocks special quest to redeem a large prize. Only one Golden Writ quest can be active at a time.
item_14150.Name: Golden Writ of Unlock

item_14151.Description: A small handheld device studded with aquamarines that can summon a portal to an attuned location. This device will self destruct when all of the charges have been used up.
EffectDescs: Summons a portal to the Nightmare Caves for 5 minutes
item_14151.Name: Portal Summoning Device - Nightmare Caves

item_14152.Description: A small handheld device with a large amethyst set in the center used to teleport the wielder to an attuned location. This device will self destruct when the charge has expired.
EffectDescs: Teleports wielder to the Level 90 Trainers beneath Povus
item_14152.Name: Personal Teleportation Device - Level 90 Trainers

item_14153.Description: These notes describe how to use a "genetics analyzer" to discover hidden anatomical secrets of non-ruminant ungulates. It's very technical.
EffectDescs: Teaches you basic Non-Ruminant Genetic Analysis
item_14153.Name: Secrets of the Ungulates

item_14154.Description: A thick treatise intended for those interested in breeding horses.
item_14154.Name: The Traits of a Mount

item_14155.Description: Describes the known types of horses, but sadly lacks pictures.
item_14155.Name: Horse Breeds: A Primer

item_14156.Description: A pointy weed. (This item can be used in recipes that call for Mixed Greens.)
item_14156.Name: Spikegrass

item_14157.Description: A toxic weed of dubious utility.
item_14157.Name: Painclover

item_14159.Description: A rubbery weed. (This item can be used in recipes that call for Mixed Greens.)
item_14159.Name: Dew Fern

item_1416.Description: A small wad of stinky swamp vegetation. It can be burned into potash for use in glassblowing, although the process is very unreliable, usually yielding only strange dirt.
item_1416.Name: Swamp Muck

item_14160.Description: A leafy weed. (This item can be used in recipes that call for Mixed Greens.)
item_14160.Name: Satchel-Leaf

item_14161.Description: A smoky-smelling weed. (This item can be used in recipes that call for Mixed Greens.)
item_14161.Name: Robelicus

item_14163.Description: A rather lengthy journal detailing the day-to-day life of its owner. The final passage in it reads: "... As I lie here, the cold grip of my final moments closing in, a single regret consumes me. All these years we've spent together - laughing, fighting, discovering the world - yet you could never see the truth burning in my heart. Lasri, you've always been so blind to the feelings of those around you... to my feelings. If you ever fi- [The rest of the page is too damaged to decipher, the ink smudged by tears long dried.]"
item_14163.Name: Rhaeri's Journal

item_14164.Description: Use this item to deploy a Keg of Love which will explode and spread its love to everyone around it within 20 meters.
EffectDescs: Summons a Keg of Love that will grant +5% Combat and Crafting xp to everyone within 20 meters. This buff does not stack with other kegs.
item_14164.Name: Keg of Love

item_14165.Description: A special token from Riston to barter for a special advanced item.
item_14165.Name: Riston's Advanced Crafting Token

item_14166.Description: A special token from Tryaka to barter for a special advanced item.
item_14166.Name: Tryaka's Advanced Crafting Token

item_14167.Description: A small handheld device with a large amethyst set in the center used to teleport the wielder to an attuned location. This device will self destruct when the charge has expired.
EffectDescs: Teleports wielder to a location in Vidaria
item_14167.Name: Personal Teleportation Device - Vidaria

item_14168.Description: It looks like it fits a heavy stone box.
item_14168.Name: Gemlord's Key

item_14169.Description: A weird container made of crystal. Inside is the essence of knowledge in liquid form. Used by the most advanced crafters.
item_14169.Name: Mnemosyne

item_1417.Description: A cheap tin cup stained with tea.
item_1417.Name: Tin Cup

item_14170.Description: A six-sided die with a hidden gizmo that causes it to land on the "1" side 50% of the time. Due to unwise goblin engineering, there is always 4% chance the die explodes in a shower of acid when rolled.
item_14170.Name: Loaded Die (1's)

item_14171.Description: A six-sided die with a hidden gizmo that causes it to land on the "2" side 50% of the time. Due to unwise goblin engineering, there is always 4% chance the die explodes in a shower of acid when rolled.
item_14171.Name: Loaded Die (2's)

item_14172.Description: A six-sided die with a hidden gizmo that causes it to land on the "3" side 50% of the time. Due to unwise goblin engineering, there is always 4% chance the die explodes in a shower of acid when rolled.
item_14172.Name: Loaded Die (3's)

item_14173.Description: A six-sided die with a hidden gizmo that causes it to land on the "4" side 50% of the time. Due to unwise goblin engineering, there is always 4% chance the die explodes in a shower of acid when rolled.
item_14173.Name: Loaded Die (4's)

item_14174.Description: A six-sided die with a hidden gizmo that causes it to land on the "5" side 50% of the time. Due to unwise goblin engineering, there is always 4% chance the die explodes in a shower of acid when rolled.
item_14174.Name: Loaded Die (5's)

item_14175.Description: A six-sided die with a hidden gizmo that causes it to land on the "6" side 50% of the time. Due to unwise goblin engineering, there is always 4% chance the die explodes in a shower of acid when rolled.
item_14175.Name: Loaded Die (6's)

item_14176.Description: A six-sided die with a hidden gizmo that causes it to land on one side more often than others. You'll have to roll it to figure out what it's weighted for.
item_14176.Name: Loaded Die (Mystery)

item_14177.Description: One year after issuance, the upstanding citizen bearing this document may redeem it at the Statehelm Bank.
item_14177.Name: Statehelm War Bond (1m)

item_14178.Description: One year after issuance, the upstanding citizen bearing this document may redeem it at the Statehelm Bank.
item_14178.Name: Statehelm War Bond (10m)

item_14179.Description: Powdered soap. Used with a bucket of water to remove graffiti.
item_14179.Name: Graffiti Cleaner

item_14181.Description: Can be used to repair a malfunctioning lamp in Statehelm. (Not every broken lamp requires a replacement bulb, but you always need one on hand when trying to repair a lamp. It's just common sense.)
item_14181.Name: Replacement Bulb

item_14182.Description: "The sensational best-selling diary of a maid from the Crone Hegemony. This was saved from obscurity due to one scene that documents the first sabotage attack of the (at-the-time-unrecognized) Night Executioner, the deadly hitman who is STILL. AT. LARGE. item_14246.Name: Book: "Witches, Names, and Power"

item_14247.Description: A thin but colorful volume on ways to irritate a necromancer without actually angering them enough to attack you.
item_14247.Name: Book: "101 Ways To Insult a Necromancer"

item_14248.Description: A book on the societal impact of vampires, focusing on their names and descriptions across cultures. Riveting.
item_14248.Name: Book: "A Vampire By Name"

item_1425.Description: Very finely ground sand mixed with clay. A useful construction sand, but bulky.
item_1425.Name: River Sand

item_1426.Description: This small bag of sand is almost painful to the touch. Its most common use is in crafting magical items, where it is used as a magic insulator during smithing.
item_1426.Name: Antimagic Sand

item_1427.Description: This bulky sack contains sand. It's clean, mid-grain sand.
item_1427.Name: Sandbag

item_1428.Description: A sack of weird-smelling herbs and vegetables. It's a goblin secret formula that supposedly improves mating chances. Best results when given to both the male and female horse.
item_1428.Name: Horse Aphrodisiac

item_1429.Description: A scale from a dragon! Hmm, it'd be a pretty small dragon... or, more likely, some dragon-kin creature.
item_1429.Name: Small Black Dragon Scale

item_1430.Description: The last pulse of blood from a dying mortal taken by a vampire. These few drops of blood contain a sliver of the victim's soul.
item_1430.Name: Lifeblood

item_1431.Description: An elaborate network of nerves that connects the three heads together.
item_1431.Name: Cerberus Brainstem

item_1432.Description: A spiky neck contraption that goes on the dominant head of a cerberus, hopefully preventing it from killing its masters.
item_1432.Name: Cerberus Control Collar

item_1433.Description: This strain of gur-horta is relatively weak, making it a poor choice for refining into combat potions. However, it's popular among orcs that smoke the leaves recreationally due to its vibrant aroma and low side-effects.
item_1433.Name: Vidaria Gur-Horta Leaves

item_1434.Description: This perfectly-preserved snail shell has been infected with demonic essence.
item_1434.Name: Demonic Giant Snail Shell

item_1435.Description: This rock is always painfully hot to the touch.
item_1435.Name: Fire Core

item_1436.Description: A scroll filled to the brim with research notes about demons. To the right person this would be probably be very informative.
item_1436.Name: Scroll of Demonic Research

item_1437.Description: A device that spins continuously when you hold it a certain way.
item_1437.Name: Mechanized Rotor

item_1438.Description: A device that spins furiously when you hold it a certain way.
item_1438.Name: Accelerated Rotor

item_1439.Description: An orcish invention similar to a Dwarven N Core, but much more powerful. It has the same shape and size as the Dwarven version.
item_1439.Name: Orcish N Core

item_1440.Description: The slimy, sticky skin of an icy frog. DO NOT LICK!
item_1440.Name: Icy Frog Skin

item_1441.Description: A potent mixture of magical blood.
item_1441.Name: Hematic Ichor

item_1442.Description: An old, forgotten memory that has been written down so as not to forget it again. This is used to remind certain people about certain events.
item_1442.Name: Memory Note

item_1443.Description: Though it resembles a pearl, it is made of almost-pure Hate. It's too emotional to be used in crafting.
item_1443.Name: Small Hate Pearl

item_1444.Description: Though it resembles a pearl, it is made of almost-pure Hate. It's too emotional to be used in crafting.
item_1444.Name: Big Hate Pearl

item_1446.Description: This coin appeared magically when you solved the semi-destroyed altar in Vidaria. It can be placed back onto the altar to redeem it for a special item, but it may have other uses...
item_1446.Name: Hexacoin

item_1447.Description: A factual statement about demons. Collect enough of these and Ferris Blueheart in Vidaria can turn them into a Scroll of Demonic Research.
item_1447.Name: Demonic Statement

item_1448.Description: A strangely burned bone. It leaves black smudges on everything it touches.
item_1448.Name: Charred Femur

item_1449.Description: A very old goblet that remains cold to the touch even in hot weather. It's made of a strange metal that might be worth studying.
item_1449.Name: Chilling Goblet

item_1450.Description: A weird puff of animated air. It's odd how it doesn't disperse.
item_1450.Name: Wind Heart

item_1452.Description: The slimy, sticky skin of a demonic frog. DO NOT LICK!
EffectDescs: Causes Hellfire Sickness and temporary blindness
item_1452.Name: Infernal Frog Skin

item_1453.Description: Good for making bottles. But not that good: it's not especially pure or clean.
item_1453.Name: Beach Sand

item_1454.Description: This is great for making bottles.
item_1454.Name: Quartz Sand

item_1455.Description: Having been blasted by hellfire, this sand is especially pure. A little cursed, but pure. It's good for magical bottles.
item_1455.Name: Hellblasted Sand

item_1456.Description: Made from the ashes of certain plants, this is useful in glassblowing.
item_1456.Name: Soda Ash

item_1457.Description: Made from the ashes of certain plants, this is useful in glassblowing.
item_1457.Name: Potash

item_1458.Description: A lump of stinking acidic green ooze.
item_1458.Name: Vile Toxic Sludge

item_1459.Description: A big chunk of glass infused with intellect-improving magic. You could use it on yourself to boost your intellect for a while.
item_1459.DynamicCraftingSummary: This can be used in equipment-crafting recipes to create items that have mind-related enchantments.
EffectDescs: Raises Max Power by 50 for 30 minutes
item_1459.Name: Lobe Activator Gem

item_1460.Description: The heart of a demon. While it no longer beats, it still smoulders with some sort of flame.
item_1460.Name: Smouldering Demon Heart

item_1474.Description: A symbol of merit granted by the Church of Arisetsu to the faithful. Sometimes they are given in exchange for donations; other times they are awarded for service.
item_1474.Name: Sun Token

item_1475.Description: Faded print declares that Jasmine's Fiery Blades has now opened in Statehelm. It seems to have closed some time after.
item_1475.Name: Old Advertisement

item_1476.Description: It says "This acts as a receipt to the perpetrator of a crime. __ demerits to _____ for ____." It hasn't been filled out.
item_1476.Name: Blank Fine Receipt

item_1477.Description: A love poem from a young man to a young woman. Apparently the young woman's eyes are like hot diamonds, whatever that means.
item_1477.Name: Love Letter

item_1478.Description: These vouchers were used with the first version of Statehelm's cornucopia, but that was years ago. The newest system is fully automated and these are but souvenirs.
item_1478.Name: Cornucopia Voucher

item_1479.Description: A clay-fired pot. Drinking water from a clay pot is especially refreshing thanks to all the minerals seeping into the water. However, it is unsuitable for purposes requiring clean bottled water.
item_1479.Name: Empty Clay Pot

item_1480.Description: A particularly thick and energized piece of fulgurite. It's valuable for certain recipes, or you can snap it into several regular pieces of fulgurite.
item_1480.Name: Greater Fulgurite

item_1482.Description: A heavy coin. If you listen carefully it sometimes softly weeps.
item_1482.Name: Woe Coin

item_1483.Description: This is a dreamer's conception of what a manticore tail tip would be like. They had only read about manticores and didn't get the proportions right. It seems to be made of solid... fog, maybe? It's cold to the touch.
item_1483.Name: Manticore Tail Tip Conception

item_1484.Description: Unlike a fireproof crucible, this is an especially darkness-proof container, used in necromantic rituals. It's full of darkness, too, but the container is perhaps more interesting.
item_1484.Name: Dark Crucible

item_1485.Description: A talisman from an older time when sages thought one could simply block out hatred with stern willfulness magic. This rune was buried with a corpse and protected it for a few centuries, but ultimately fell to darkness and instead became a corrupting force.
item_1485.Name: Deathblock Rune

item_1486.Description:
A parasitic insect common in the Gob Lands, these can burrow hundreds of miles to find places of strong darkness to lay their eggs. Despite their name, these creatures never feed on souls. The larvae feed on hatred itself, which is good. Unfortunately as adults they prefer to suck blood, and they can phase through walls like a ghost, which is bad.

This one seems to be dead, although it can be hard to tell.
item_1486.Name: Soulbiter Larva

item_1487.Description: The complete set of hand bones from a very powerful undead spell-caster. These carry some latent animosity.
item_1487.Name: Enchanted Phalange Set

item_1488.Description: Perhaps fired by a hero of yore, this arrow once had a very potent magic arrowhead. It seems broken and worthless now.
item_1488.Name: Broken Magic Arrow

item_1489.Description: An elegant hand-whittled hilt leads to a blade made of sharpened bone. It doesn't look viable as a weapon, but you could technically butcher something with it. (Keep it in your inventory and you'll have the option to butcher the corpses of some enemies. -2 Butchering Skill Penalty compared to a traditional Butcher Knife.)
item_1489.Name: Crude Butcher Knife

item_1490.Description: Pulled from the head of a Face of Death, this bodypart is gross and absurdly dangerous.
item_1490.Name: Eye of Death

item_1491.Description: A huge feather that has been curved into a loop. It was once part of a headband.
item_1491.Name: Headband Feather

item_1492.Description: A pot of delicious heavily-mineralized drinking water.
item_1492.Name: Clay Pot of Water

item_14941.Description: A volume of the famous 37-book series describing the history of the gods. This edition includes annotations and commentary from the Council.
item_14941.Name: "The Gods, Vol. XI: Arisetsu"

item_14942.Description: Use this item to claim 1 month of VIP membership.
item_14942.Name: VIP Token

item_15001.Description: It's a taste only an alchemist would call appetizing. "But it has sugar in it!" As if that offset the taste of dirt!
EffectDescs: Boosts maximum health by 10 for 60 minutes
Can encourage unhappy people to feel happier for a time.
item_15001.Name: Pick-Me-Up Juice

item_15002.Description: There's little spider hairs floating on the top. Mmmm. But it'll take the poison down a notch.
EffectDescs: Boosts poison mitigation by 5 for 60 minutes
item_15002.Name: Poison Resistance Potion

item_15003.Description: Consume this fuzzy gel when you're suffering from poison.
