item_15751.Description: The essence of a demon. If you hold it in your hand, you can hear a quiet scream that nobody else can.
item_15751.Name: Demonic Essence

item_15752.Description:
Purified essence of a demon. If you hold it in your hand, you can hear a low hum.

Consuming this essence will cure you of all Hellfire currently infesting your body. This includes Lesser, normal, and Greater Hellfire.
item_15752.Name: Purified Demonic Essence

item_15753.Description: A wisp of demonic essence. Gather enough of these and you can combine their energies into a Demonic Essence.
item_15753.Name: Demonic Wisp

item_15761.Description: Known colloquially as "Heckfreeze", this ointment is applied topically and cures up to 10 stacks of Lesser Hellfire.
item_15761.Name: Weak Hellfreeze Ointment

item_15762.Description: Known colloquially as "Heckfreeze", this concoction is consumed to cure all stacks of Lesser Hellfire.
item_15762.Name: Weak Hellfreeze

item_15763.Description: When applied topically, this ointment cures up to 10 stacks of Hellfire and Lesser Hellfire.
item_15763.Name: Hellfreeze Ointment

item_15764.Description: When consumed, this concoction cures all stacks of Hellfire and Lesser Hellfire.
item_15764.Name: Hellfreeze

item_15765.Description: This industrial-strength Hellfreeze cures up to 10 stacks of Greater Hellfire, Hellfire, and Lesser Hellfire when applied topically.
item_15765.Name: Strong Hellfreeze Ointment

item_15766.Description: This industrial-strength Hellfreeze cures all stacks of Greater Hellfire, Hellfire, and Lesser Hellfire when ingested.
item_15766.Name: Strong Hellfreeze

item_15801.Description: A sweet syrupy potion that warms the throat when drunk.
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, gain +8 mitigation against Cold, Nature, Acid, and Poison damage, both direct and indirect.
item_15801.Name: Toxin Resistance Potion

item_15802.Description: It looks like milk, but stinks like mashed-up spider bits.
EffectDescs: Boosts direct and indirect poison mitigation by 3 and raises Max Health +15 for 60 minutes
item_15802.Name: Poison Protection Potion

item_15804.Description: Just pulped-up spider bits in a jar.
EffectDescs: For 60 minutes, your out-of-combat Sprint Speed is +1
item_15804.Name: Spider Speed Potion

item_15805.Description: Bits of ground-up stinger are floating in it.
EffectDescs: Boosts direct and indirect fire, cold, and electricity mitigation by 5 for 60 minutes
item_15805.Name: Energy Resistance Potion

item_15806.Description: It tastes like pureed salad. And since you use it by applying it to your skin, you too will smell like pureed salad.
EffectDescs: Boosts damage vs. creatures with the Fish anatomy type +10% for 60 minutes
item_15806.Name: Gillpuncher Ointment

item_15807.Description: A topical balm beloved by ranalon, who apply it to their skin continuously. Its effects are much weaker when applied to non-ranalon, but it is, at least, safe to use.
EffectDescs: For one hour, boosts Max Bodyheat +20 and Breath Restored (on land or partial water) +5/sec
item_15807.Name: Moistening Cream

EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Fire Magic attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15808.Name: Fire Magic Boost Potion 20%

EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Ice Magic attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15809.Name: Ice Magic Boost Potion 20%

item_15810.Description: An unpleasant substance that activates every area of your tongue at once.
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Mentalism attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15810.Name: Mentalism Boost Potion 20%

item_15811.Description: A terrible-smelling liquid that actually only tastes unpleasant, not terrible.
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Psychology attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15811.Name: Psychology Boost Potion 20%

item_15812.Description: It tastes like orange juice! Kind of!
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Priest attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15812.Name: Priest Boost Potion 20%

item_15813.Description: Tastes like furry eyeballs but it makes all your motions feel crisp and sharp.
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Sword attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15813.Name: Sword Boost Potion 20%

item_15814.Description: It tastes crunchy and unpleasant. As a side-effect, it's extremely difficult to relax while under the effect of this potion.
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Knife attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15814.Name: Knife Boost Potion 20%

item_15815.Description: You don't want to think about the taste... it's best to drink something strong afterwards.
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Unarmed attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15815.Name: Unarmed Boost Potion 20%

item_15816.Description: Weirdly cold and soupy, but not unpleasant to taste.
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Staff attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15816.Name: Staff Boost Potion 20%

item_15817.Description: Smells like entrails. Tastes like entrails... but with an extremely unpleasant crunch.
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Hammer attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15817.Name: Hammer Boost Potion 20%

item_15818.Description: Smells foul but doesn't really taste bad (for an alchemy potion).
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Battle Chemistry attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15818.Name: Battle Chemistry Boost Potion 20%

item_15819.Description: Sniff that? Smells like feathers and hate. Definitely an archery potion.
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Archery attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15819.Name: Archery Boost Potion 20%

EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Bard attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15820.Name: Bard Boost Potion 20%

EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Shield attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15821.Name: Shield Boost Potion 20%

item_15822.Description: This liquid is viscous and gross.
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Animal Handling attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15822.Name: Animal Handling Boost Potion 20%

item_15823.Description: Smells of sulfur and tastes of hair. Typical alchemy nonsense.
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Werewolf skill attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15823.Name: Werewolf Boost Potion 20%

item_15824.Description: Thick and crunchy, like any good potion.
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Spider skill attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15824.Name: Spider Boost Potion 20%

item_15825.Description: Pigs drinking this are advised not to think about the ingredients lest they become depressed. And possibly very angry.
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Pig skill attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15825.Name: Pig Boost Potion 20%

item_15826.Description: A little tastier than usual potions, perhaps. (But not good-tasting, to be clear.)
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Deer skill attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15826.Name: Deer Boost Potion 20%

item_15827.Description: Milky. Hmm. Turns out that's not really a good thing when it comes to describing potion taste.
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Cow skill attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15827.Name: Cow Boost Potion 20%

EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Giant Bat skill attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15828.Name: Giant Bat Boost Potion 20%

item_15829.Description: It smells awful and it leaves your tongue completely numb. So that's something.
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Rabbit skill attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15829.Name: Rabbit Boost Potion 20%

item_15830.Description: A vaguely meat-flavored swill made all the more horrid with the addition of lumps of fur.
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Warden skill attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15830.Name: Warden Boost Potion 20%

item_15831.Description: A few berries floating in a ghostly liquid.
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Spirit Fox skill attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15831.Name: Spirit Fox Boost Potion 20%

item_15832.Description: Sparks of electricity dance within the otherwise plain-looking water. There's no way that's safe, right?
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your Weather Witching skill attacks deal +20% base damage
item_15832.Name: Weather Witching Boost Potion 20%

item_15841.Description: Named for the god of knowledge, this potion lets you see a few seconds into the future! It is permanent, however, and some scribes of Imatia have been driven insane by what they see.
EffectDescs:
You can perceive where new monsters will spawn. They will appear as purple energy for 2 seconds before they actually appear.

This effect does not wear off, but whenever you die there's a 5% chance that it will end.
item_15841.Name: Imatia's Sight Potion

item_15842.Description: This pleasant beverage helps you digest cheese.
EffectDescs: Regenerate +10 power every 5 seconds (both in and out of combat). Lasts 1 hour or until no cheese is in your system, whichever comes first.
item_15842.Name: Mild Ratkin Digestif

item_15843.Description: This tasty beverage helps you digest cheese.
EffectDescs: Regenerate +20 power every 5 seconds (both in and out of combat). Lasts 1 hour or until no cheese is in your system, whichever comes first.
item_15843.Name: Potent Ratkin Digestif

item_15844.Description: This delicious beverage helps you digest cheese.
EffectDescs: Regenerate +30 power every 5 seconds (both in and out of combat). Lasts 1 hour or until no cheese is in your system, whichever comes first.
item_15844.Name: Amazing Ratkin Digestif

item_15845.Description: An appetizer intended to be eaten before the cheese course.
EffectDescs: Causes cheese effects to last 20 minutes longer. (Must be drunk before cheese is eaten!)
item_15845.Name: Simple Ratkin Aparatif

item_15846.Description: An appetizer intended to be eaten before the cheese course.
EffectDescs: Causes cheese effects to last 40 minutes longer. (Must be drunk before cheese is eaten!)
item_15846.Name: Tasty Ratkin Aparatif

item_15847.Description: An appetizer intended to be eaten before the cheese course.
EffectDescs: Causes cheese effects to last 60 minutes longer. (Must be drunk before cheese is eaten!)
item_15847.Name: Delicious Ratkin Aparatif

item_15848.Description: An extremely secret formula used by ratkin sages to predict when and where rodents will appear.
EffectDescs:
You can perceive newly-spawned rodents and rodent-kin 10 seconds before they actually appear.

The effect does not wear off, but whenever you die there's a 5% chance that it will end.
item_15848.Name: Potion of Rat Detection

EffectDescs: Recovers 1 health per second for 30 seconds.
item_15849.Name: Potion of Least Regeneration

item_15850.Description: A delayed-action potion which is tricky to use in stressful situations, and also tastes like bile.
item_15850.Name: Potion of Casual Healing

item_15851.Description: This was obviously intended to be a Potion of Universal Resistance, but the ingredients were added in the wrong order, resulting in a revolting soup with an unpredictable effect.
EffectDescs: Boosts mitigation of a random damage-type by 5 for 60 minutes. The effect mimics other potions and does not stack with them. (For instance if this potion boosts Poison resistance, it does not stack with a Potion of Poison Resistance.)
item_15851.Name: Potion of Random Resistance

item_15852.Description: A thick black paste that requires an iron stomach to drink. If you can keep it down, the potion protects from all types of damage, and even better, it can be combined with potions that protect against specific damage types.
EffectDescs: Boosts mitigation of all damage-types 5 for 60 minutes. This effect stacks with potions that provide resistance to a specific damage-type.
item_15852.Name: Potion of Universal Resistance

item_15853.Description: A delayed-action potion which is tricky to use in stressful situations, and also tastes like wet cardboard.
item_15853.Name: Potion of Casual Armoring

item_15854.Description: The not-quite-dead remains of an ooze. It's mainly used as an ingredient in other potions, but it does have a healing effect when drunk -- assuming you have the gastronomic experience to tolerate the flavor without vomiting.
item_15854.Name: Magic Ooze Syrup

item_15855.Description:
This healing potion can be drunk many times. Just leave a drop in the bottom and it will refill right before your eyes! The secret? It's made with a still-living ooze. Unfortunately, the ooze is so thick that the average person can't manage to drink it. Also unfortunately, the ooze takes a few seconds to take effect.

This potion is best known as the favorite drink of Grita the Arbitrarily Murderous, the feared rakshasa pirate. She says the potion is light on the stomach, allowing her to drink far more of it than regular healing potions. But she's a pirate (and a rakshasa to boot), so most people take that with a grain of salt.
item_15855.Name: Infinite Potion of Healing

item_15856.Description: This potion alters your eyes so they work better when there's not much light. It's an ancient recipe that's quite effective, but the revolting taste has kept it from becoming too popular.
EffectDescs: For 60 minutes, you can see better in low-light environments.
item_15856.Name: Potion of Night Vision

item_15857.Description: Useful primarily to mages, this apple-flavored potion causes explosions to be a little more particular about what they hit.
EffectDescs: For 60 minutes, you gain +10% Burst Accuracy
item_15857.Name: Potion of Burst Accuracy

item_15858.Description: This potion helps you think like an animal. If you have an animal companion this lets you communicate a bit more efficiently.
EffectDescs: For 60 minutes, all Animal Handling abilities cost 10% less Power to use.
item_15858.Name: Potion of Swift Animal Handling

item_15859.Description: Most people can't tell that this does anything at all. But it does have magic. Just not very good magic.
EffectDescs: For 60 minutes, any Minor Healing abilities used on you restore +1 Health
item_15859.Name: Potion of Extremely Minor Healing Receptiveness

item_15860.Description: This potion increases the size of your stomach by a very small amount. (This is usually not something to get too excited about.)
EffectDescs: For 60 minutes, you gain +10 Max Metabolism
item_15860.Name: Minor Stomach Expander Potion

item_15861.Description: A flask of flammable liquid. It doesn't deal much damage, but any flame will keep trolls from regenerating, and this flame lasts a long time.
EffectDescs: If used immediately before an attack, the attack will cause the target(s) to be covered in mild but long-burning flame.
item_15861.Name: Trollbane Oil

item_15862.Description: Blessed by a high priest of Au-Shin, this tube of liquid glows like a light.
EffectDescs: Boosts Max Health by 300% for 15 minutes. Must be an animal.
item_15862.Name: Warden Strength Drink

item_15863.Description: This clear liquid has bubbles in it that never seem to pop.
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, you lose Breath Meter half as quickly while underwater.
item_15863.Name: Water Breathing Potion

item_15864.Description: A slimy gunk that lets you move like an eel. (Swimming buff does not stack with other swimming-buff potions.)
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your underwater fast-swim speed is +6 and you gain +6 mitigation against Electricity
item_15864.Name: Eel Potion

item_15865.Description: Stinky sludge that lets you move like a shark. (Swimming buff does not stack with other swimming-buff potions.)
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes, your underwater fast-swim speed is +7 and your Max Breath is +10
item_15865.Name: Shark Potion

item_15866.Description:
A dollop of cold, fruit-flavored magical liquid that will change your wing-stype permanently. This item can melt.

NOTE: this changes an aspect of your character's appearance PERMANENTLY. Think before you drink!
EffectDescs: For fairies: randomly chooses a new wing shape and color from among a few possible styles.
item_15866.Name: Fae Wing-Change Potion (Types A&B)

item_15867.Description:
A dollop of cold, fruit-flavored magical liquid that will change your hairstyle permanently. This item can melt.

NOTE: this changes an aspect of your character's appearance PERMANENTLY. Think before you drink!
EffectDescs: For races with multiple hair styles: randomly chooses a new hair style. (Hair color is unchanged.)
item_15867.Name: Fae Hair Style Potion

item_15868.Description:
A dollop of cold, fruit-flavored magical liquid that will change your hair color permanently. This item can melt.

NOTE: this changes an aspect of your character's appearance PERMANENTLY. Think before you drink!
EffectDescs: For races with multiple hair colors: randomly chooses a new hair color. (Hair style is unchanged.)
item_15868.Name: Fae Hair Color Potion

item_15869.Description:
A dollop of cold, fruit-flavored magical liquid that will change your beard style permanently. This item can melt.

NOTE: this changes an aspect of your character's appearance PERMANENTLY. Think before you drink!
EffectDescs: For race/sex combinations with multiple beard styles: randomly chooses a new beard style. (Beard color is unchanged.)
item_15869.Name: Fae Beard Style Potion

item_15870.Description:
A dollop of cold, fruit-flavored magical liquid that will change your beard color permanently. This item can melt.

NOTE: this changes an aspect of your character's appearance PERMANENTLY. Think before you drink!
EffectDescs: For race/sex combinations with multiple beard colors: randomly chooses a new beard color. (Beard style is unchanged.)
item_15870.Name: Fae Beard Color Potion

item_15871.Description:
A dollop of cold, fruit-flavored magical liquid that will change your skin or fur color permanently. This item can melt.

NOTE: this changes an aspect of your character's appearance PERMANENTLY. Think before you drink!
EffectDescs: For races with multiple skintones: randomly chooses a new skintone.
item_15871.Name: Fae Skin Color Potion

item_15872.Description: A blend of fairy wings and secret ingredients that are quite difficult to digest due to their repulsiveness. It is banned in half of the fairy courts, and readily available in the other half.
EffectDescs: For fairies: restores up to 10 fae energy, but cannot raise fae energy above 20.
item_15872.Name: Thin Fae Energy Potion

item_15873.Description: A blend of fairy wings and secret ingredients that are quite difficult to digest due to their repulsiveness. It is banned in half of the fairy courts, and readily available in the other half.
EffectDescs: For fairies: restores up to 20 fae energy, but cannot raise fae energy above 20.
item_15873.Name: Thick Fae Energy Potion

item_15874.Description:
A dollop of cold, fruit-flavored magical liquid that will change your wing-style permanently. This item can melt.

NOTE: this changes an aspect of your character's appearance PERMANENTLY. Think before you drink!
EffectDescs: For fairies: randomly chooses a new wing shape and color from among a few possible styles.
item_15874.Name: Fae Wing-Change Potion (Types C&D)

item_15875.Description:
A dollop of cold, fruit-flavored magical liquid that will change your wing-style permanently. This item can melt.

NOTE: this changes an aspect of your character's appearance PERMANENTLY. Think before you drink!
EffectDescs: For fairies: randomly chooses a new wing shape and color from among a few possible styles.
item_15875.Name: Fae Wing-Change Potion (Types E&F)

item_15876.Description:
A dollop of cold, fruit-flavored magical liquid that will change your wing-style permanently. This item can melt.

NOTE: this changes an aspect of your character's appearance PERMANENTLY. Think before you drink!
EffectDescs: For fairies: randomly chooses a new wing shape and color from among a few possible styles.
item_15876.Name: Fae Wing-Change Potion (Types G&H)

item_15877.Description:
A dollop of cold, fruit-flavored magical liquid that will change your wing-style permanently. This item can melt.

NOTE: this changes an aspect of your character's appearance PERMANENTLY. Think before you drink!
EffectDescs: For fairies: randomly chooses a new wing color (of a certain style).
item_15877.Name: Fae Wing-Change Potion (Type I)

item_15878.Description: A lotion created by Moxie of the Crafting Caravan in order to make long distance fluttering less stressful when applied directly to the wings. Unfortunately, this formula only works on Fae.
EffectDescs: For fairies: Decreases flight power costs in and out of combat while gaining +1 flight speed for 2 hours.
item_15878.Name: Moxie's Flutter Butter

item_15879.Description:
A lotion created by Moxie of the Crafting Caravan in order to make long distance flight less stressful when applied directly to the wings. Unfortunately, this formula only works on druidic bird forms.
WARNING: Leaving bird form will cancel the effects of this lotion!
EffectDescs: For druidic bird forms: Decreases flight power costs in and out of combat while gaining +1 flight speed for 2 hours.
item_15879.Name: Moxie's Birdie Butter

item_15880.Description:
A lotion created by Moxie of the Crafting Caravan in order to make long distance flight less stressful when applied directly to the wings. Unfortunately, this formula only works on giant bats. Also, since giant bat wings are so large, the bottle contains fewer doses than the other butters, but it's more effective, too.
WARNING: Leaving giant bat form will cancel the effects of this lotion!
EffectDescs: For giant bats: Decreases flight power costs in and out of combat while gaining +2 flight speed for 2 hours.
item_15880.Name: Moxie's Bat Butter

item_15881.Description: A blend of fairy wings and secret ingredients that are quite difficult to digest due to their repulsiveness. It is banned in half of the fairy courts, and readily available in the other half.
EffectDescs: For fairies: restores up to 30 fae energy, but cannot raise fae energy above 30.
item_15881.Name: Gooey Fae Energy Potion

item_15882.Description: A blend of fairy wings and secret ingredients that are quite difficult to digest due to their repulsiveness. It is banned in half of the fairy courts, and readily available in the other half.
EffectDescs: For fairies: restores up to 40 fae energy, but cannot raise fae energy above 40.
item_15882.Name: Foamy Fae Energy Potion

item_15883.Description: A small metal cylinder with liquid sealed inside. There's a pull-tab on top to open it. The cylinder bears an image of a smiling Spring fairy. If you stare for a moment, she seems to mouth the cryptic words "Rez and Shine, You Live Again! Original Honey Flavor!"
EffectDescs: For fairies: raises Max Health +40. Restores 5 fae energy, but cannot raise fae energy above 50.
item_15883.Name: Rez and Shine

item_15884.Description: A time-bending drink that allows one to perceive fairies before they exist.
EffectDescs:
You can perceive newly-spawned fairies and fae creatures 10 seconds before they actually appear.

The effect does not wear off, but whenever you die there's a 5% chance that it will end.
item_15884.Name: Potion of Fae Sight

item_15885.Description: A syrup of exotic tree seeds that will better attune your senses to the plant realm.
EffectDescs:
You can perceive newly-spawned plant creatures 10 seconds before they actually appear.

The effect does not wear off, but whenever you die there's a 5% chance that it will end.
item_15885.Name: Potion of Plantsight

item_15886.Description: A small stone covered in special moss. Licking the moss gives ranalon a potent hallucinogenic effect. Other creatures experience a less-dramatic effect, but it's still notable.
EffectDescs: For one hour, boosts Max Power +50, Max Breath +3, Burst Evasion +10%, and Automatic Miss Chance +5%
item_15886.Name: Licking Moss

item_15887.Description: A rock-hard fruit covered in ashy powder. It looks magical, but poisonous. Very poisonous.
EffectDescs: Boosts your Max Health +200 for one hour, or until you die. Then kills you instantly.
item_15887.Name: Treant Apple

item_15888.Description: This acrid topical ointment is an effective way to remove swamp parasites.
EffectDescs: Instantly removes all ticks and leeches.
item_15888.Name: Swamp Balm

item_15889.Description: A psychic enhancement that lets you harness your formidable skeletal knowledge into a weapon. Tastes like chalk.
EffectDescs: For 30 minutes you can use the ability Disperse Skeleton. (Drinking this potion teaches you the ability if you don't already know it.)
item_15889.Name: Skeleton Dispersal Fluid

item_15890.Description: Why do acid resistance potions always have to TASTE like acid?
EffectDescs: Boosts acid mitigation by 15 for 60 minutes
item_15890.Name: Potent Acid Resistance Potion

item_15891.Description: A dollop of liquid that seems like it's hissing from inside the glass.
EffectDescs: Boosts acid mitigation by 25 for 60 minutes
item_15891.Name: Extreme Acid Resistance Potion

item_15892.Description: It stinks of death but has a mild, pleasant taste.
EffectDescs: For 60 minutes, gain +7 Max Breath underwater
item_15892.Name: Fruitbreath Potion

item_15893.Description: A sarcastically-named elven drink that replenishes tempest energy. (For easy cleanup, the teapot magically biodegrades when the tea is consumed.)
item_15893.Name: Tempest in a Teapot

item_15894.Description: An elf-only tea that boosts the chance of anatomy critical hits with archery attacks. (For easy cleanup, the teapot magically biodegrades when the tea is consumed.)
EffectDescs: For 15 minutes, boosts Anatomy Critical-Hit Chance +8%
item_15894.Name: Serene Precision Tea

item_15897.Description: It's either very cold or very warm to the touch... it's hard to tell which.
EffectDescs: Boosts cold mitigation by 15 and Max Body Heat by 40 for 60 minutes

item_18429.Description: A pretty big gem with dark green bands, it's well known for aiding magical communication. This particular gem has been infused with a rune that attunes it to cattle when used in crafting.
item_18429.DynamicCraftingSummary: This can be used in equipment-crafting recipes to create items that have Cow enchantments. When you use a Massive crystal like this to craft items, there's a chance you will have a Crafting Epiphany, which grants bonuses.
item_18429.Name: Massive Cow Malachite

item_18430.Description: A pretty big gem with dark green bands, it's well known for aiding magical communication. This particular gem has been infused with a rune that attunes it to the needs of deer when used in crafting.
item_18430.DynamicCraftingSummary: This can be used in equipment-crafting recipes to create items that have Deer enchantments. When you use a Massive crystal like this to craft items, there's a chance you will have a Crafting Epiphany, which grants bonuses.
item_18430.Name: Massive Deer Malachite

item_18431.Description: A pretty big gem with dark green bands, it's well known for aiding magical communication. This particular gem has been infused with a rune that attunes it to pigs when used in crafting.
item_18431.DynamicCraftingSummary: This can be used in equipment-crafting recipes to create items that have Pig enchantments. When you use a Massive crystal like this to craft items, there's a chance you will have a Crafting Epiphany, which grants bonuses.
item_18431.Name: Massive Pig Malachite

item_18432.Description: A pretty big gem with dark green bands, it's well known for aiding magical communication. This particular gem has been infused with a rune that attunes it to spiders when used in crafting.
item_18432.DynamicCraftingSummary: This can be used in equipment-crafting recipes to create items that have Spider enchantments. When you use a Massive crystal like this to craft items, there's a chance you will have a Crafting Epiphany, which grants bonuses.
item_18432.Name: Massive Spider Malachite

item_18433.Description: A big dark red stone, known for its curative properties. This particular stone has been attuned to the First Aid skill if used in crafting.
item_18433.DynamicCraftingSummary: This can be used in equipment-crafting recipes to create items that have First Aid enchantments. When you use a Massive crystal like this to craft items, there's a chance you will have a Crafting Epiphany, which grants bonuses.
item_18433.Name: Massive First Aid Garnet

item_18434.Description: A big crystal made up of black and white bands. Used in magic, it guards against physical dangers. This particular onyx has been attuned to Armor Patching when used in crafting.
item_18434.DynamicCraftingSummary: This can be used in equipment-crafting recipes to create items that have Armor Patching enchantments. When you use a Massive crystal like this to craft items, there's a chance you will have a Crafting Epiphany, which grants bonuses.
item_18434.Name: Massive Armor Patching Onyx

item_18435.Description: A pretty big gem with dark green bands, it's well known for aiding magical communication. This particular gem has been infused with a rune that attunes it to bats when used in crafting.
item_18435.DynamicCraftingSummary: This can be used in equipment-crafting recipes to create items that have Giant Bat enchantments. When you use a Massive crystal like this to craft items, there's a chance you will have a Crafting Epiphany, which grants bonuses.
item_18435.Name: Massive Bat Malachite

item_18436.Description: A pretty big gem with dark green bands, it's well known for aiding magical communication. This particular gem has been infused with a rune that attunes it to rabbits when used in crafting.
item_18436.DynamicCraftingSummary: This can be used in equipment-crafting recipes to create items that have Rabbit enchantments. When you use a Massive crystal like this to craft items, there's a chance you will have a Crafting Epiphany, which grants bonuses.
item_18436.Name: Massive Rabbit Malachite

item_18437.Description: A big yellow topaz. An incredibly versatile magical stone. This particular piece has been infused with a rune that attunes it to Fairy Magic, giving crafted items a chance to include one or more Fairy Magic powers (with the rest being Mentalism powers).
item_18437.DynamicCraftingSummary: This can be used in equipment-crafting recipes to create items that have Fairy Magic enchantments. When you use a Massive crystal like this to craft items, there's a chance you will have a Crafting Epiphany, which grants bonuses.
item_18437.Name: Massive Fairy Magic Topaz

item_18438.Description: A big soft blue rock. It's useful in curatives and curse removal potions. This particular gem has been infused with a rune that attunes it to foxes when used in crafting.
item_18438.DynamicCraftingSummary: This can be used in equipment-crafting recipes to create items that have Spirit Fox enchantments. When you use a Massive crystal like this to craft items, there's a chance you will have a Crafting Epiphany, which grants bonuses.
item_18438.Name: Massive Spirit Fox Lapis

item_19001.Description: Rita asked you to deliver this soap to Helena, who lives in the ruins of Castle Eltibule.
item_19001.Name: Herbal Soap

item_19002.Description: This bean has little prongs growing out of it that kind of look like horns.
item_19002.Name: Demon Bean

item_19003.Description: A rooty vegetable heart. Would probably be great in a salad.
item_19003.Name: Salmpo Heart

item_19005.Description: A small sack of foul-smelling white dust. Echur instructed you not to eat it, but that shouldn't be a problem.
item_19005.Name: Unrefined Cranium Powder

item_19006.Description: A handful of odorous twinkling flowers. Cute, but a little too gimmicky.
item_19006.Name: Flitterbies

item_19007.Description: A pack full of extremely small woman's clothing, plus blankets and some costume jewelry.
item_19007.Name: Sarina's Backpack

item_19008.Description: A grisly paw hacked off of The Mauler.
item_19008.Name: The Mauler's Claw

item_19010.Description: Mu asked you to deliver this to a Myconian named Poe.
item_19010.Name: Mu's Message Spore

item_19012.Description: This bundle of sporelings should be delivered to a myconian named Yoy.
item_19012.Name: Backup Sporelings

item_19013.Description: It's a partially-acid-melted shield without any straps to keep it on.
item_19013.Name: Melted and Broken Shield

item_19014.Description: It's a note to Landri the Cold, an elf in Kur Mountains. It reads, "You have not met me, and I cannot reveal myself, but I am a fellow theoretician, and I beg your help. I believe I can tap a portal to other planes of existence, and the plane of ice is very accessible here. I intend to use the Galkun technique to open the wormhole, and power it via ordinary ice lichen." (The note goes on for some length, in increasing technical detail, before ending with a perfunctory request for verification of the plan.)
item_19014.Name: Letter to Landri the Cold

item_19015.Description: A lead cup with a hefty weight and some cheap jewels on it. As you hold it, it grows unnaturally warm to the touch.
item_19015.Name: Necromancer's Goblet

item_19016.Description: A chunk of a weird giant mushroom. It reeks of death, and you're pretty sure it has no practical use.
item_19016.Name: Giant Mushroom Sample

item_19017.Description: A small poorly-made tiara, sized for a large rat or smallish dog. It seems utterly non-magical.
item_19017.Name: Squeaky's Tiara

item_19018.Description: It's an official letter from Praetor Ballard, demanding that a Human named Charles Thompson leave Serbule's surroundings forever... or face death.
item_19018.Name: Praetor's Orders

item_19020.Description: A sack of millet from a strange plant.
item_19020.Name: Gratflower Millet

item_19021.Description: A rakshasa's tail ring. It's not magical. It is inscribed, "to Sinda, the explorer supreme."
item_19021.Name: Sinda's Tail Ring

item_19022.Description: A sage's personal diary. It doesn't contain any useful lore or anything, it's just ramblings about his personal life.
item_19022.Name: Journal of Sir Villas Wake

item_19023.Description: A lovely navel ring with a tourmaline in it, apparently designed to calm intense anger.
item_19023.Name: Oritania's Navel Ring

item_19024.Description: The skull of a dead necromancer.
item_19024.Name: Lomas's Skull

item_19025.Description: A large gear that came out of a very large golem. It's bent and has no obvious purpose.
item_19025.Name: Cranial Gear

item_19026.Description: A small piece of bone inscribed with a dwarven rune for eternal sleep. It doesn't look very useful to you.
item_19026.Name: Preservative Rune

item_19027.Description: The skull of a ghoul that invaded from a realm of evil.
item_19027.Name: Skull of Maligno

item_19028.Description: A prism that has been inscribed with weird symbols. You don't think it would be useful for regular prism-related activities.
item_19028.Name: Archaic Prism

item_19029.Description: It's an old note. "Relamir: if you read this, get out of here! The frog men came again... and they killed the guests and staff. There's nobody left but me, and I'm leaving. Fuck this island, fuck this whole inn idea, fuck money, fuck the ocean, fuck everything. I'll pay you the money I owe you within a decade, I promise. - Roolaustus"
item_19029.Name: Old Owner's Note

item_19030.Description:
It's very light, and very cold, and very fragile.

(Note: if this item is held by someone not on the appropriate quest, it will quickly evaporate.)
item_19030.Name: Lydia's Soul

item_19031.Description:
A ring that can be used to 'sign' messaging stones as Lord Eltibule.

(Note: if this item is held by someone not on the appropriate quest, it will crumble to dust.)
item_19031.Name: Eltibule's Signet Ring

item_19032.Description: It's labeled 'bear repellent.' It smells spicy. You opt not to taste it.
item_19032.Name: Bear Repellent

item_19033.Description: A stinky flower. It's not going to be useful in bouquets, that's for sure.
item_19033.Name: Rotflower

item_19034.Description: A letter written by Sirine. You're supposed to give it to Yetta in Eltibule.
item_19034.Name: Letter to Yetta

item_19035.Description:
"Payment: 3 RTC
To: Tal-Saka (outcast rakshasa)
Reason: assistance in interpreting notes about Transmutation."

It's been formally approved by a Lt. Flakis.
item_19035.Name: Invoice for Tal-Saka

item_19037.Description: It's a large, gaudy belt buckle with a hand-painted scene of a man chopping lumber.
item_19037.Name: Paul's Lucky Buckle

item_19038.Description: A bottle with five small areas to hold dirt.
item_19038.Name: Soil Sample Container

item_19039.Description: It's an old worn shovel with a small handle. It doesn't seem very special to you.
item_19039.Name: "Spadey"

item_19040.Description: A brooch with an emerald inlaid in the middle. It's too dinged up to be valuable, but it's still pretty.
item_19040.Name: Emerald Brooch

item_19041.Description: A delicate glass star painted red and gold.
item_19041.Name: Stolen Tree Star

item_19042.Description: A tuft of fur from a manticore 'mane'.
item_19042.Name: Manticore Mane

item_19043.Description: A hacked-off piece of a rakshasa's ear.
item_19043.Name: Rakshasa Ear

item_19044.Description: A chapter from an adventure novel.
item_19044.Name: 'Leeka and the Blade Trials' Chapter 1

item_19045.Description: A chapter from an adventure novel.
item_19045.Name: 'Leeka and the Blade Trials' Chapter 2

item_19046.Description: A chapter from an adventure novel.
item_19046.Name: 'Leeka and the Blade Trials' Chapter 3

item_19047.Description: A chapter from an adventure novel.
item_19047.Name: 'Leeka and the Blade Trials' Chapter 4

item_19048.Description: A chapter from an adventure novel.
item_19048.Name: 'Leeka and the Blade Trials' Chapter 5

item_19049.Description: A chapter from an adventure novel.
item_19049.Name: 'Leeka and the Blade Trials' Chapter 6

item_19050.Description: Bits of ground up hippo hair. Very itchy.
item_19050.Name: Itching Powder

item_19051.Description: It doesn't seem to do anything, but it's definitely magical. Huh.
item_19051.Name: Spoon of Necromancy

item_19052.Description: These were probably decent tassels at some point -- for what, it's impossible to say -- but now they're covered in blood and pus and other fluids.
item_19052.Name: Tassels of Gulagra

item_19053.Description: A translucent handkerchief from a ghost. It should have turned into ectoplasm when separated from the ghost, but somehow it hasn't. Eerie.
item_19053.Name: Ghostly Handkerchief

item_19055.Description: A drop of blood from a gnasher.
item_19055.Name: Bloodsoaker's Blood

item_19056.Description: The mandibles from a particularly nasty insect.
item_19056.Name: Chitterface's Mandibles

item_19057.Description: The teeth of a very mean bear.
item_19057.Name: Grottofang's Teeth

item_19058.Description: A pebble found on a yeti.
item_19058.Name: Urraghur's Lucky Rock

item_19059.Description: It says, "Karnag, your family loves you. Please don't do this to yourself! There must be another way. You will miss your son's first words..." the rest is scribbled out except a bit at the bottom written in a different style, "Karnag Has Graduated Wizard School! Signed my mother."
item_19059.Name: Karnag's Imaginary Diploma

item_19060.Description: It's covered in gibberish -- there are words, but they don't seem to make sentences.
item_19060.Name: Elerimon's Notes

item_19063.Description: The perfumed note says, "W: My love for you grows each night I spend alone. I long to touch you. Your beard, your lips, your... tee hee... meet me tonight behind the kennels. I cannot survive another night without your touch! And don't worry -- the messenger is safe. - E"
item_19063.Name: Note to Willem

item_19064.Description: It's a tooth from a huge Tor-Urak.
item_19064.Name: Fluffy's Tooth

item_19065.Description: A drop of magical darkness, trapped in a vial.
item_19065.Name: Mote of Darkness

item_19066.Description: A keg of Troll's Lip, one of the cheapest and vilest beers in all the Council Lands.
item_19066.Name: Troll's Lip Beer Keg

item_19067.Description: The heart of a desert-living drakeworm.
item_19067.Name: Vurrkan's Heart

item_19068.Description: A delicate flower that seems simultaneously warm and cold.
item_19068.Name: Coldkiss Flower

item_19069.Description: An ordinary Council that's had weird little marks etched into it.
item_19069.Name: Cursed Coin

item_19070.Description: A magical bottle that analyzes water. Use it while standing in the center of a pool of water.
item_19070.Name: Water Sample Analyzer

item_19071.Description: Full of anatomical drawings of rat-people, and musings in arcane Goblinese.
item_19071.Name: Bogaku's Sixteenth Notebook

item_19072.Description: Looks like meat. Gross meat, but ... just meat.
item_19072.Name: Escaped-Snail Meat

item_19073.Description: An organ cut out of a large scorpion.
item_19073.Name: Scorpion Poison Gland

item_19074.Description: A gross dead scorpion. It's very heavy.
item_19074.Name: Decently-Scary Scorpion Corpse

item_19075.Description: It says, "I hereby acknowledge that Vangreef's debt to me is paid." It has an elven signature symbol and the letters "SS". Then at the bottom is another note by the author: "Don't waste that spell, Vangreef. Even if you could afford a second casting, I can't recast it until the moon waxes anew. Be smart and fast or your whole gang WILL die down there. And nobody will be able to rescue you."
item_19075.Name: Spell Receipt

item_19076.Description: The shell of a dead scorpion. It's very smelly.
item_19076.Name: Scorpion Carapace

item_19077.Description: A small vial that reeks of urine and other unpleasant chemicals. This is an unadulterated "pure" dose of the drug, straight from the alchemists' workbench.
item_19077.Name: Telka's Teeth (Clean Sample)

item_19078.Description: A sticky blob of "silk" from a sand worm. It's not what you'd call silky.
item_19078.Name: Sand Worm Silk

item_19079.Description: It seems like an ordinary giant spider leg.
item_19079.Name: Tornado Spider Leg

item_19080.Description: A plate-like protrusion from a carnivine.
item_19080.Name: Carnivine Tooth

item_19081.Description: A thorny protrusion from a spriggan weed or plant.
item_19081.Name: Spriggan Weed Tooth

item_19082.Description: A freeze-dried beetle of some sort.
item_19082.Name: Candied Ice Beetle

item_19084.Description: The horn of a fae rhino.
item_19084.Name: Chipped Fae Rhino Horn

item_19085.Description: A hot piece of magical crystal.
item_19085.Name: Fiery Sound Crystal

item_19086.Description: A cold piece of magical crystal.
item_19086.Name: Icy Sound Crystal

item_19087.Description: A warm piece of magical crystal.
item_19087.Name: Natural Sound Crystal

item_19088.Description: An old book written by an elf about how to use dwarven engineering in elven designs.
item_19088.Name: Dwarven Circuit Principles and Applications for Elven Dweomers, 5th Edition

item_19089.Description: A care package including some clover, salt licks, sealed documents, and a strange device you don't recognize.
item_19089.Name: Care Package for Suspicious Cow

item_19090.Description: A care package including mushroom substrate, a bag of beads, and several paper notes.
item_19090.Name: Care Package for Norbert

item_19091.Description: A care package including sacks of Councils, odd-colored dyes, and a note.
item_19091.Name: Care Package for Lumpfuzz

item_19092.Description: A care package consisting entirely of mushrooms.
item_19092.Name: Care Package for Trekker

item_19093.Description: The beak of a very large turkey.
item_19093.Name: Gobblejack's Beak

item_19094.Description: A butterfly that's been captured alive. It doesn't look happy... but it's alive!
item_19094.Name: Stunned Rose-Mourning Butterfly

item_19095.Description: A net designed to catch and contain Rose-mourning butterflies. (Keep this in your inventory when harvesting the butterflies to capture them alive.)
item_19095.Name: Rose-Mourning Butterfly Net

item_19096.Description: These extra-large flower seeds are coated in sticky honey, which is in turn coated in pollen.
item_19096.Name: Honeyed Seeds

item_19098.Description: A shark fin, freshly hacked off.
item_19098.Name: Sacrificial Shark Fin

item_19099.Description: A lump from a very large ooze.
item_19099.Name: Sacrificial Ooze

item_19100.Description: The heart of a massive snail.
item_19100.Name: Sacrificial Snail Meat

item_19101.Description: The lung of a newly-sacrificied mega scray. (NOTE: not yet implemented; does nothing!)
item_19101.Name: Sacrificial Lung

item_19102.Description: A special pemphredo eye adjusted to receive messages from a nearby source, instead of a distant one.
item_19102.Name: Asterion's Eye

item_19103.Description: These pages of parchment are covered in symbols that make no sense to you.
item_19103.Name: Claudia's Notes

item_19104.Description: A ghostly document. It hasn't quite reverted to ectoplasm yet. Unfortunately it's completely illegible.
item_19104.Name: Ghostly Letter

item_19105.Description: It looks like a key, but it's made of semi-solid ectolasm. It couldn't possibly unlock anything; it's too mushy!
item_19105.Name: Ghostly Key

item_19106.Description: A key that once belonged to a rakshasa named Kimeta.
item_19106.Name: Kimeta's Key

item_19107.Description: An extremely large, extremely docile frog. It's alive for now, but you should deliver it soon.
item_19107.Name: Miss Fly-Hater

item_19108.Description: A chunk of rock from a cave deep under Eltibule.
item_19108.Name: Ore Sample

item_19109.Description: It's a mechanical arm with a strange wand tip at one end.
item_19109.Name: Portal Attachment Mechanism

item_19110.Description: It's a large hollow crystal. Or rather, a crystalline jar that looks like a crystal?
item_19110.Name: Crystal Adjunct Housing

item_19111.Description: It's warm to the touch. Dwarven safety runes indicate that it's explosive, poisonous, and ... there's one other danger symbol that you don't recognize.
item_19111.Name: Polarity-Bisected N Core

item_19112.Description: It's a hollow crystal with some things inside that rattle around.
item_19112.Name: Nexus Adjunct Matter Aligner

item_19113.Description: A heavy key that looks unused. It's still polished to a shine.
item_19113.Name: Dwarven Key

item_19114.Description: A bundle of rough phlogiston that has carefully sealed up and labeled "Semi-Sturdy Phlogiston".
item_19114.Name: Semi-Sturdy Phlogiston

item_19115.Description: These are ledgers, orders, and addresses. Pretty waterlogged.
item_19115.Name: Cleo's Books

item_19116.Description: Perhaps there's a slimy lock somewhere that this opens? It doesn't look like it will last too long... [Note: this key does not yet unlock anything.]
item_19116.Name: Slimy Key

item_19118.Description: It's solid glass with a fish embedded in it.
item_19118.Name: Fishy Crystal Ball

item_19119.Description: It's a sealed letter addressed to "High Stormmaster Merriana."
item_19119.Name: Letter from Sir Arif

item_19120.Description: It's clearly magical: it feels cold to the touch. But nothing seems to happen otherwise.
item_19120.Name: Frosty Crystal Ball

item_19121.Description: This once-magical crystal ball seems depleted and cracked.
item_19121.Name: Dusty Crystal Ball

item_19122.Description: It's a hollow crystal with some things inside. Sarina the fairy fixed it for you.
item_19122.Name: Nexus Adjunct Matter Aligner

item_19123.Description: A bottle of squid ink that's gone bad. It's leaking from the top.
item_19123.Name: Rancid Ink

item_19125.Description: Even the slugs' eggs are poisonous!
item_19125.Name: Poisonous Slug Egg

item_19126.Description: A fae fish that's been genetically altered to survive here and slowly kill the ocean. It's cold to the touch, and quite inedible.
item_19126.Name: Invasive Ice Fish

item_19127.Description: The cork came out of this bottle of blade poison and the liquid inside froze. It doesn't look useful as a weapon anymore, although it could still make fish sick.
item_19127.Name: Frozen Poison Vial

item_19128.Description: Looks like regular seaweed. Smells even worse, though. Apparently it's toxic.
item_19128.Name: Toxic Seaweed

item_19129.Description: Apparently this starfish is especially problematic to local fish.
item_19129.Name: Predatory Starfish

item_19130.Description: Hmm. Could this be part of some weird magical globe?
item_19130.Name: Orrery Orienter

item_19131.Description: Hmm. Could this be part of some weird magical globe?
item_19131.Name: Lunar Aligner

item_19132.Description: This lens looks like it fits into a stargazing contraption.
item_19132.Name: Stargazer Lens

item_19133.Description: This key is made of cork! It seems quite fragile.
item_19133.Name: Cork Key

item_19134.Description: These are strings for a magical stringed instrument -- a particularly BIG instrument.
item_19134.Name: Enchanted Instrument Strings

item_19135.Description: Hey, this isn't a real skull! It's wood that's been painted to resemble stone. Or perhaps bone.
item_19135.Name: Prop Skull

item_19136.Description: This key fell out of a fake skull. The cuts in the key are clearly decorative; if this opens anything at all, it wouldn't be a normal chest. Probably magic.
item_19136.Name: Prop Skull Key

item_19137.Description: This key was found on the corpse of a hag.
item_19137.Name: Lady Eleanor's Key

item_19138.Description: A small key. It must fit something...
item_19138.Name: Rusty Lockbox Key

item_19139.Description: There are three parts to this weird key.
item_19139.Name: Tripartite Key, Part 1

item_19140.Description: There are three parts to this weird key.
item_19140.Name: Tripartite Key, Part 2

item_19141.Description: There are three parts to this weird key.
item_19141.Name: Tripartite Key, Part 3

item_19142.Description: This looks to be a piece of mummy wrapping.
item_19142.Name: Stolen Wrapping

item_19143.Description: It's a metal spike with various probes and buttons. It makes odd sounds when the buttons are pressed.
item_19143.Name: Spike of Autonomy

item_19144.Description: It's the lens Truxartis asked you to find. It should repair the "blood well".
item_19144.Name: Missing Hematic Lens

item_19145.Description: The brain of a swarmer demon.
item_19145.Name: Swarmer Brain

item_19146.Description: Blood, or at least some sort of blood-like ichor, extracted from the wings of a demonic flapskull.
item_19146.Name: Demonic Flapskull Blood

item_19147.Description: The brain of a demon soldier.
item_19147.Name: Demon Soldier Brain

item_19148.Description: A rather heavy sack. It's hard to tell what's inside.
item_19148.Name: Heavy Sack

item_19149.Description: This notebook contains arcane sigils in a strange code.
item_19149.Name: Khyrulek's Planar Planner

item_19150.Description: It's covered in mold. Perhaps the cork failed?
item_19150.Name: Moldy Potion

item_19151.Description: It looks like cheese, smells like ammonia, and stings like a jellyfish.
item_19151.Name: Waxy Goo

item_19152.Description: This notebook contains arcane sigils in a strange code.
item_19152.Name: Planar Planner (inaccurate)

item_19153.Description: This notebook contains arcane sigils in a strange code. The sage Elmetaph has scribbled out some of the sigils and written in new ones.
item_19153.Name: Planar Planner (accurate)

item_19154.Description: A sludgey liquid. The label suggests it's used in alchemy.
item_19154.Name: Refined Hematic Platelets

item_19155.Description: The label indicates that it's some sort of alchemical byproduct of "soul darkening", whatever that is.
item_19155.Name: Elongated Darkness (Faint)

item_19160.Description: Seems like a normal skeletal arm.
item_19160.Name: Arm of the "First Thrall"

item_19161.Description: Blood from a crazed vampire thrall, said to be especially tasty. (But tastes like blood to you.)
item_19161.Name: Fresh Thrall Blood

item_19162.Description: Used by vampires to "clean" blood so it can be used in alcoholic drinks. This one's antique.
item_19162.Name: Antique Blood Diffuser

item_19163.Description: It says it's a recipe for a mixed drink, but there are no ingredients... Just weird pictograms.
item_19163.Name: Recipe for Blood Whiskey

item_19164.Description: An ancient vase of unknown origin. Bring this to someone who understands Flower Arrangements and they may be able to identify it for you.
item_19164.Name: Ancient Vase

item_19165.Description: An ancient painting of something natural. Bring this to someone who appreciates nature and they may be able to identify it for you.
item_19165.Name: Ancient Painting

item_19166.Description: An ancient crest of unknown origin. Bring this to someone knowledgeable about the past and they may be able to identify it for you.
item_19166.Name: Ancient Crest

item_19167.Description: Several pages of notes written entirely in Orcish. There are a few drawings and diagrams depicting a rotational device.
item_19167.Name: Crall's Mining Device Notes

item_19168.Description: A sheet of paper with some kind of mapping between different characters of the Orcish alphabet.
item_19168.Name: Orcish Cipher Key

item_19169.Description: A very old book. It looks to be a hand-scribed copy of a book called the Mnemonix Index for the Superficially Undead.
item_19169.Name: Mnemonic Index

item_19170.Description: The pineal gland of an ancient droach.
item_19170.Name: Droach Pineal Gland

item_19171.Description: An oversized ring with bumps that seem to uniquely identify a specific demon.

item_21801.Description: A very rough alcoholic beverage. Some say you grow to like the taste, but others say that's just your tastebuds dying from the pain.
item_21801.Name: Potato Vodka

item_21802.Description: Apple brandy, with a distinctive apple taste and a strong kick. A longtime favorite of rural humans.
item_21802.Name: Applejack

item_21803.Description: A sweet, relatively palatable variety of vodka. Although it's a traditional dwarven drink, it long ago fell out of favor, and these days dwarves only use it for cooking.
item_21803.Name: Beet Vodka

item_21804.Description: Sweet and strong, with the distinctive odor of molasses. In far-off lands, ranalon produce and drink rum in tremendous quantities, but it's less common -- and less delicious -- in Alharth.
item_21804.Name: Pale Rum

item_21805.Description: A simple variety of whisky made from barley. It's drinkable and has a tolerable flavor.
item_21805.Name: Whisky

item_21806.Description: Fermented cactus juice with a complex taste. This variety has been aged to make it more drinkable. (It's "more" drinkable, but still not "very" drinkable -- it's an acquired taste.) The stereotypical drink of rakshasa desert bandits.
item_21806.Name: Tequila

item_21807.Description: Pleasant, slightly citrusy, but with a distinctive bitterness too. It's said to be the favorite hard liquor of elves, but since elves mostly drink wine, that's not much praise.
item_21807.Name: Dry Gin

item_21808.Description: Made from fermented corn mash, this is very mellow and drinkable. This is the favored drink of Councilwoman Sereel "The Steel" Avenbule. She holds a bourbon competition each year in Vidaria.
item_21808.Name: Bourbon

item_21809.Description: This variety of cider is made from sour apples and has a complex array of taste sensations. Pity you won't remember the taste after blacking out from it...
item_21809.Name: Cider

item_21851.Description: Although there might be delicious varieties of strawberry wine out there somewhere, this is not it: the strawberry flavor is undermined by a grassy taste.
item_21851.Name: Strawberry Wine

item_21852.Description: A drinkable wine, but with a slightly musky taste and odor. This is definitely not the kind of wine that elves drink in Verta! But it's not horrible.
item_21852.Name: Concord Wine

item_21853.Description: With notes of citrus and sweetness, this is a decent table wine.
item_21853.Name: Orange Wine

item_21854.Description: Given that it was made from carrots, this wine is... surprisingly good!
item_21854.Name: Carrot Wine

item_21855.Description: A buttery, banana-flavored wine that's quite a mouthful.
item_21855.Name: Banana Wine

item_21857.Description: A very dry wine that's quite drinkable.
item_21857.Name: Rice Wine

item_21858.Description: A dry wine. It has a slightly piney smell, but the aroma is not pleasant.
item_21858.Name: Juniper Wine

item_21890.Description: A refreshing summer wine. When prepared by a master brewer, this is the perfect outdoor party wine.
item_21890.Name: Cantaloupe Wine

item_22001.Description: A chunk of ore that could be used to make silver equipment and jewelry. It can also be used in formulas that augment jewelry.
item_22001.Name: Silver Ore

item_22002.Description: A chunk of fool's gold. It has many alchemical uses, and is great for making costume jewelry. It is often used in formulas that augment jewelry.
item_22002.Name: Pyrite

item_22003.Description: A chunk of ore that could be used to make gold equipment and jewelry. It is also used in formulas that augment jewelry.
item_22003.Name: Gold Ore

item_22004.Description: A chunk of dense (yet brittle) iridium. It's used in the creation of acid-proof armor and strange robotic constructs. It can also be used to augment jewelry.
item_22004.Name: Iridium

item_22005.Description: A tiny bit of unrefined ore. You'd need a bunch of these to make anything useful from them.
item_22005.Name: Gold Nugget

item_22006.Description: A chunk of weird ore. It's a potent conductor of certain magics and is used in specialized armor and weapons.
item_22006.Name: Paladium

item_22007.Description: A chunk of brittle ore. It is extremely hard to smith, but alchemists have found some uses for it.
item_22007.Name: Tungsten

item_22008.Description: A chunk of soft metal. While it's not particularly strong, it's very easy for smiths to work with, so it has uses in specialized armors and weapons. Fletchers use it to create dense arrows.
item_22008.Name: Copper Ore

item_22009.Description: A soft strange metal, quite magical, and very poisonous. It has many uses.
item_22009.Name: Cinnabar

item_22010.Description: A chunk of pointy ore. Its most common use is by blacksmiths, who can add fireproofing to armor with it.
item_22010.Name: Stibnite

item_22011.Description: A chunk of weird ore that can conduct powerful magics, but requires extreme skill to craft with.
item_22011.Name: Rhodium

item_22012.Description: A chunk of metal with magic-amplification properties. It is used as a form of currency among some goblins due to hyper-inflation of goblin paper money.
item_22012.Name: Xedrite

item_22013.Description: A small lump of metal said to form in areas of high latent magic. It can be combined with other ores for advanced smithing, and alchemists have their own strange uses for it.
item_22013.Name: Molybdenum

item_22014.Description: Some strips of strange metal with strange properties. It is used by armorsmiths.
item_22014.Name: Orichalcum

item_22015.Description: A small lump of a soft, whitish mineral. You can easily crumble it to a very fine powder that has no smell or taste.
item_22015.Name: Gypsum

item_22016.Description: A hunk of lead ore. Used in alchemy, advanced metallurgy, and art.
item_22016.Name: Lead

item_22051.Description: A type of stone often found near demonspawn.
item_22051.Name: Thommarite

item_22052.Description: It's a leaf -- a non-demonic leaf -- encased in an otherworldly variety of amber.
item_22052.Name: Demonic Amber

item_22053.Description: A curious side-effect of demonic magic. The protrusions on this rock vaguely resemble teeth.
item_22053.Name: Demon's Tooth

item_22054.Description: Seems like it's just a rock. The name was coined by Plaudius the Wise who posited that the Forthragarian homeworld might be paved with such stones. This has since recently been proven incorrect, but the name is unlikely to change.
item_22054.Name: Hell Gravel

item_22055.Description: A tiny chunk of magma that has been magically prevented from cooling. Very weird.
item_22055.Name: Timestopped Magma

item_22056.Description: A weird mineral found near the rubywall crystals; the origin is completely unknown, and the name seems to be a misnomer.
item_22056.Name: Cerberus Tear

item_23202.Name: Translated Builder Instructions

item_23203.Description: This is an old battle plan for some intra-goblin skirmish. It might be worth something to somebody... but probably not much in any case.
item_23203.Name: Translated Battle Plan

item_23204.Description: This is sloppily transliterated goblin poetry. It scans poorly, the similes make no sense after translation, and the topic of the poem is toenails. But it is poetry, technically.
item_23204.Name: Translated Goblin Poetry

item_23301.Description: A simple scroll written in both Orcish and Human. The Human title is "Demands of the Deceased".
item_23301.Name: "Demands of The Deceased"

item_23302.Description: A simple scroll with both Orcish and Human words on it.
item_23302.Name: Orcish Language Reference

item_23303.Description: A simple scroll written in Orcish, with images of sword techniques.
item_23303.Name: Orcish Scroll About Swords

item_23304.Description: A simple book in Orcish. It has lots of pictures of weapons.
item_23304.Name: Orcish Book On Weapons

item_23305.Description: A simple book in Orcish. It seems to contain many prayers or chants, plus woodcut images of orcish armies killing people.
item_23305.Name: Orcish Book With Prayers

item_23306.Description: A simple book in Orcish. It looks like it might be a fiction novel -- very rare among orcs!
item_23306.Name: Orcish Novel

item_23308.Description: A book written in Orcish. It has many pictures of spears, polearms, and swords.
item_23308.Name: Orcish Weaponry Treatise

item_23310.Description: A scroll in Orcish. It seems to be about orcish wizards.
item_23310.Name: Orcish Scroll About Thaumaturges

item_23311.Description: A book written in Orcish. It's clearly a guide to first aid.
item_23311.Name: Orcish Field Medicine Guide

item_23312.Description: A book written in Orcish. The woodcuts appear to depict the other major races such as humans, elves, and dwarves.
item_23312.Name: Orcish Race Guide

item_23313.Description: A scroll in Orcish. There is one picture depicting a human wizard.
item_23313.Name: Orcish Scroll About Magic

item_23315.Description: A book written in Orcish. It seems to show techniques for the knife.
item_23315.Name: Orcish Book On Knife Tricks

item_23316.Description: A book written in Orcish. From the diagrams, it seems to be about magic.
item_23316.Name: Orcish Book About Thaumaturgy

item_23317.Description: A book written in Orcish. In the title, you recognize the orcish word for Gotkul, a famous orc general that commands a massive army in the Crone Hegemony.
item_23317.Name: Orcish Book About Gotkul

item_23318.Description: A book written in Orcish. It seems to be about war machines.
item_23318.Name: Orcish Book About Trebuchets

item_23319.Description: A book written in Orcish. Judging by the pictures, it seems to be about Tast, the god of war and armies.
item_23319.Name: Orcish Book About Tast

item_23321.Description: A book written in Orcish. It's very long and there are very few pictures.
item_23321.Name: Orcish Treatise

item_23322.Description: A book with Orcish phrases translated into several languages.
item_23322.Name: Orcish Military Phrasebook

item_23323.Description: A book written in Orcish. The occasional diagrams and woodcut illustrations suggest that it's about orcish mages that perform weird rituals.
item_23323.Name: Orcish Book About Weird Mages

item_25001.Description:
Attaching this ribbon to your reins will make you go faster during races. Slightly. Very, very slightly.

This item is attached to Reins or a Saddle via a recipe. Using this item will teach you the recipe if necessary.
item_25001.Name: Participation Ribbon: Land Speed

item_25002.Description:
Attaching this ribbon to your reins will make you learn a bit more from each race you undertake.

This item is attached to Reins or a Saddle via a recipe. Using this item will teach you the recipe if necessary.
item_25002.Name: Participation Ribbon: Learning

item_25021.Description:
Attaching this medal to your gear will boost your mount's jumping capability during races.

This item is attached to Reins or a Saddle via a recipe. Using this item will teach you the recipe if necessary.
item_25021.Name: Racing Medal: Leaping

item_25022.Description:
Attaching this medal to your gear will make your mount slightly braver during races.

This item is attached to Reins or a Saddle via a recipe. Using this item will teach you the recipe if necessary.
item_25022.Name: Racing Medal: Bravery

item_25041.Description:
Attaching this enchanted medal to your gear will boost your mount's jumping capability during races... If it doesn't explode during installation, that is.

This item is attached to Reins or a Saddle via a recipe. Using this item will teach you the recipe if necessary.
EffectDescs: Chance that Installing Will Accidentally Destroy Item: 8%
item_25041.Name: Racing Gem: Leaping

item_25042.Description:
Attaching this enchanted medal to your gear will boost your mount's maximum land speed during races. Or it'll explode your gear.

This item is attached to Reins or a Saddle via a recipe. Using this item will teach you the recipe if necessary.
EffectDescs: Chance that Installing Will Accidentally Destroy Item: 8%
item_25042.Name: Racing Gem: Land Speed

item_25043.Description:
Attaching this enchanted medal to your gear will boost your mount's bravery during races... If it doesn't explode during installation.

This item is attached to Reins or a Saddle via a recipe. Using this item will teach you the recipe if necessary.
EffectDescs: Chance that Installing Will Accidentally Destroy Item: 8%
item_25043.Name: Racing Gem: Bravery

item_25044.Description:
Attaching this enchanted medal to your gear will boost your learning from races. Or it will explode during installation.

This item is attached to Reins or a Saddle via a recipe. Using this item will teach you the recipe if necessary.
EffectDescs: Chance that Installing Will Accidentally Destroy Item: 8%
item_25044.Name: Racing Gem: Learning

item_2530.Description: A ponderous volume wherein an anonymous rakshasa mage explores the idea that the 'old' rakshasa form is somehow still locked within each 'new' rakshasa body. The author posits that certain potions might do the trick, and then explores numerous alchemical hypotheses, none of which pan out too well, but one complex recipe catches your eye.
item_2530.Name: On Becoming Great Again
