item_40002.Description: Sturdy and fashionable, if not especially protective.
item_40002.Name: Basic Boots

item_40003.Description: These have been perfectly worn in! Nice. But still very smelly.
item_40003.Name: Comfortable Ancient Shoes

item_40005.Description: These boots have been hand-painted, but are still pretty ugly.
item_40005.Name: Sturdy Boots

item_40006.Description: These were worn by a dainty goblin.
item_40006.Name: Goblin Slippers

item_40007.Description: These were worn by a tough goblin.
item_40007.Name: Goblin Stompers

item_4001.Description: A simple autopsy kit for beginning pathologists. (Keep it in your inventory and you'll be given the option to autopsy corpses.)
item_4001.Name: Autopsy Kit

item_40010.Description: When you put these slippers on, your whole body feels lighter.
item_40010.Name: Featherweights

item_40011.Description: These boots have been dyed red and given a preposterous name.
item_40011.Name: Hateboots

item_40013.Description: Strong general-purpose footwear, with metal outside for protection, wool inside for insulation.
item_40013.Name: Ruggedized Boots

item_40015.Description: Handmade by a fairy, these make you especially light on your feet.
item_40015.Name: Flower Dainties

item_40017.Description: Horseshoes, but fitted for a cow's hooves.
item_40017.Name: Cow Shoes

item_40018.Description: Horseshoes, but fitted for a pig's hooves.
item_40018.Name: Pig Shoes

item_40019.Description: A pair of simple boots. Echur says that they help one connect with the world around them, whatever that means.
item_40019.Name: Echur's Boots

item_4002.Description: A fancy autopsy kit for advanced pathologists. (+3 to your effective skill when autopsying a corpse.)
item_4002.Name: Forensic Inspection Kit

item_40020.Description: Horseshoes, but fitted for a deer's hooves.
item_40020.Name: Deer Shoes

item_40021.Description: These boots are abysmal, leaky, and humiliating to wear.
item_40021.Name: Shoddy Leather Boots

item_40022.Description: Well, they're hand-made shoes. Not everything that's hand-made is good quality, though, it turns out.
item_40022.Name: Rough Leather Boots

item_40023.Description: Hideous foot wrappings covered in excess leather to provide protection - but not comfort. Expect gigantic blisters.
item_40023.Name: Crude Leather Boots

item_40024.Description: The sort of boots you might imagine if you tried to visualize leather boots in your head. Fairly generic.
item_40024.Name: Decent Leather Boots

item_40025.Description: Boots with a fair amount of reinforcement in the heel, and padding to prevent blisters. Still not elegant, but fairly effective in combat.
item_40025.Name: Nice Leather Boots

item_40026.Description: These boots are pretty nice to wear, and seem like they'll last a long time, too.
item_40026.Name: Quality Leather Boots

item_40027.Description: These are so soft to touch that you almost feel criminal wearing them out into the mud and gore.
item_40027.Name: Great Leather Boots

item_40028.Description: These boots breathe better than most leather garments, so your feet don't get quite as stinky. Plus, they have double-reinforced laces!
item_40028.Name: Amazing Leather Boots

item_40029.Description: This shoe has been heavily over-engineered, with secret cushions and odd snaps to ensure a perfect fit for any foot size.
item_40029.Name: Astounding Leather Boots

item_4003.Description: A fancier autopsy kit for advanced pathologists. (+5 to your effective skill when autopsying a corpse.)
item_4003.Name: Forensic Analysis Kit

item_40030.Description: These are like an extension of your feet, they're so comfortable!
item_40030.Name: Awesome Leather Boots

item_40031.Description: Impossibly comfortable for leather. Stylish too!
item_40031.Name: Incredible Leather Boots

item_40032.Description: A bastion of basic-shoe quality in a sea of basic-shoe sadness.
item_40032.Name: Marvelous Leather Boots

item_4004.Description: An autopsy kit made of ice and fairy dust. (Keep it in your inventory and you'll be given the option to autopsy corpses.)
item_4004.Name: Enchanted Autopsy Kit

item_40041.Description: Farmers typically don't feel compelled to shod a cow. But some cows are more violent and adventurous than others.
item_40041.Name: Shoddy Cow Shoes

item_40042.Description: Your violent cow will be made all the more violent by these uncomfortable shoes!
item_40042.Name: Rough Cow Shoes

item_40043.Description: A crude cow will love these crude shoes.
item_40043.Name: Crude Cow Shoes

item_40044.Description: Decent shoes for a cow that's not too shabby.
item_40044.Name: Decent Cow Shoes

item_40045.Description: Comfortable shoes that make a violent cow feel free as the wind.
item_40045.Name: Nice Cow Shoes

item_40048.Description: These horseshoes - err, cow shoes - are practically supernaturally lovely.
item_40048.Name: Amazing Cow Shoes

item_40049.Description: Wow, someone put way too much effort into these cow shoes!
item_40049.Name: Astounding Cow Shoes

item_4005.Description: A very complicated device that can help with tricky pathology inquiries. (+10 to your effective skill when autopsying a corpse.)
item_4005.Name: Carbon-form Scrutinizer Array

item_40050.Description: If you know anything about cowshoe craftsmanship, you know you're looking at a masterpiece right here.
item_40050.Name: Awesome Cow Shoes

item_40051.Description: You thought you'd seen a cow-shoe masterpiece before, but this just reset your expectations!
item_40051.Name: Incredible Cow Shoes

item_40052.Description: A sudden transition is seen here: from elegant but large cowshoes to whisper-thin and unobtrusive ones. The secret is in the fit: it's marvelous.
item_40052.Name: Marvelous Cow Shoes

item_40061.Description: Deer seem to get along fine in nature without having metal hammered into their hooves, but not all deer are content with the life of a passive ungulate.
item_40061.Name: Shoddy Deer Shoes

item_40062.Description: The nails are too long for the deer's small hooves, causing considerable pain while wearing.
item_40062.Name: Rough Deer Shoes

item_40063.Description: A crude deer will love these crude shoes.
item_40063.Name: Crude Deer Shoes

item_40064.Description: Decent shoes for a deer that's not too shabby.
item_40064.Name: Decent Deer Shoes

item_40066.Description: Comfortable shoes that make a violent deer feel free as the wind.
item_40066.Name: Quality Deer Shoes

item_40068.Description: These horseshoes - err, deer shoes - are practically supernaturally lovely.
item_40068.Name: Amazing Deer Shoes

item_40069.Description: Wow, someone put way too much effort into these deer shoes!
item_40069.Name: Astounding Deer Shoes

item_40070.Description: If you know anything about deershoe craftsmanship, you know you're looking at a masterpiece right here.
item_40070.Name: Awesome Deer Shoes

item_40071.Description: If a cow needed to be shod for some reason, it is surely not with these wooden, splinter-laced bits of junk.
item_40071.Name: Shoddy Wooden Cow Shoes

item_40072.Description: Basically just chunks of wood nailed to a cow's feet. Which makes them sound more comfortable than they really are.
item_40072.Name: Rough Wooden Cow Shoes

item_40073.Description: Not generally considered a good choice, shodding a cow with bits of wood. These crude shoes are... crude.
item_40073.Name: Crude Wooden Cow Shoes

item_40074.Description: If all you're looking for is some horseshoe-shaped pieces of wood to nail to your cow's feet, you're in luck.
item_40074.Name: Decent Wooden Cow Shoes

item_40075.Description: Elegantly whittled and reinforced wooden shoes. They can easily withstand the weight of an angry heiffer.
item_40075.Name: Nice Wooden Cow Shoes

item_40076.Description: Made by someone with decent working knowledge of wood, these seem fairly comfortable if you have hooves for feet.
item_40076.Name: Quality Wooden Cow Shoes

item_40077.Description: You'd almost think these were metal, that's how great these bits of wood are!
item_40077.Name: Great Wooden Cow Shoes

item_40078.Description: These wooden footguards are a work of art. Avant garde art, where you nail wood to cows' feet.
item_40078.Name: Amazing Wooden Cow Shoes

item_40079.Description: Wow, someone put way too much effort into these wooden cow shoes!
item_40079.Name: Astounding Wooden Cow Shoes

item_40080.Description: A masterpiece of wood-nailed-to-cow-hoof design! Comfortable and stylish. Well, stylish for a cow. They have different sensibilities than people.
item_40080.Name: Awesome Wooden Cow Shoes

item_40081.Description: If a deer needed to be shod for some reason, it is surely not with these wooden, splinter-laced bits of junk.
item_40081.Name: Shoddy Wooden Deer Shoes

item_40082.Description: Basically just chunks of wood nailed to a deer's feet. Which makes them sound more comfortable than they really are.
item_40082.Name: Rough Wooden Deer Shoes

item_40083.Description: Not generally considered a good choice, shodding a deer with bits of wood. These crude shoes are... crude.
item_40083.Name: Crude Wooden Deer Shoes

item_40084.Description: If all you're looking for is some horseshoe-shaped pieces of wood to nail to your deer's feet, you're in luck.
item_40084.Name: Decent Wooden Deer Shoes

item_40085.Description: Elegantly whittled and reinforced wooden shoes. They can easily withstand the weight of an angry buck.
item_40085.Name: Nice Wooden Deer Shoes

item_40086.Description: Made by someone with decent working knowledge of wood, these seem fairly comfortable if you have hooves for feet.
item_40086.Name: Quality Wooden Deer Shoes

item_40087.Description: You'd almost think these were metal, that's how great these bits of wood are!
item_40087.Name: Great Wooden Deer Shoes

item_40088.Description: These wooden footguards are a work of art. Avant garde art, where you nail wood to the feet of an unsuspecting ungulate.
item_40088.Name: Amazing Wooden Deer Shoes

item_40089.Description: Wow, someone put way too much effort into these wooden deer shoes!
item_40089.Name: Astounding Wooden Deer Shoes

item_40090.Description: A masterpiece of wood-nailed-to-deer-hoof design! Comfortable and stylish. Well, stylish for a deer. They have different sensibilities than people.
item_40090.Name: Awesome Wooden Deer Shoes

item_40091.Description: Comfortable, and perfectly fitting in with deer fashion sense.
item_40091.Name: Incredible Wooden Deer Shoes

item_40092.Description: Sacrificing flair for elegance, these are an understated masterpiece.
item_40092.Name: Marvelous Wooden Deer Shoes

item_40094.Description: These make it seem easy to make comfortable wooden shoes for cows. (It's not.)
item_40094.Name: Incredible Wooden Cow Shoes

item_40095.Description: Thanks to their near-invisible size, these marvelous cowshoes say almost nothing about the cow that wears them. Friend, foe, demon? These shoes give no clues to the observer.
item_40095.Name: Marvelous Wooden Cow Shoes

item_40096.Description: Wow. Now you KNOW you've seen deer-shoe craftsmanship. These tiny things are delicate, yet indestructible.
item_40096.Name: Incredible Deer Shoes

item_40097.Description: Four out of five talking shoe-wearing deer agree: these are the nicest ones they've ever seen.
item_40097.Name: Marvelous Deer Shoes

item_40101.Description: Special deer-fitted horseshoes made of an otherworldly metal.
item_40101.Name: Shadow Trotters

item_40102.Description: Thick layers of hide and fur make these boots quite warm.
item_40102.Name: Insulated Boots

item_40103.Description: Although they're leather instead of metal, these insulated boots are made for protection, not grace or mobility.
item_40103.Name: Orcish Rugged Boots

item_40104.Description: It's hard to imagine, but once these boots were the height of fashion.
item_40104.Name: Discarded Boots

item_40105.Description: These fancy boots have been digested by a slime creature, leaving mostly just metal behind. Don't worry about them being uncomfortable, though: there's tons of ooze in there to keep your feet cozy.
item_40105.Name: Slimy Shoes

item_40106.Description: These boots have clearly been the birthing spot for baby spiders in the past. You can clean them off, but can you ever really get the image out of your head?
item_40106.Name: Web-Encrusted Shoes

item_40107.Description: A werewolf wore these boots while transforming a few too many times. The armor quality is totally shot, but it still has some value.
item_40107.Name: Ruined Shifter's Boots

item_40109.Description: Profoundly uncomfortable and rather awkward to move in, but very stylish.
item_40109.Name: Elven Plate Boots

item_40110.Description: Made of a bizarre metal, these uncomfortable boots seem to clench your feet with malice.
item_40110.Name: Boots of the Winter Court

item_40111.Description: Common apparel from the Serbule Revolt, 1500 years ago. These boots are so over-engineered that they look brand new. But the smell is pretty bad.
item_40111.Name: Dwarven Soldier Boots

item_40112.Description: The evil creature Ciervos wore these for thousands of years. Must be lucky! Hmm, but he died wearing them. Maybe they're unlucky...
item_40112.Name: Ciervos's Anklets

item_40113.Description: Makeshift fae armor crafted from repurposed Winter Court armor. It doesn't have quite the style or powers of Summer Court armor, but it's not bad.
item_40113.Name: Boots of the Summer Court

item_40114.Description: Designed by a spiteful necromancer bent on conquering a city, these cloth foot coverings seethe with hatred. And it turns out that pure hatred is pretty warm, providing mild protection against the cold.
item_40114.Name: Booties of Hateful Comeuppance

item_40115.Description: When thousands of Rakshasa warriors arrived on Alharth, they wore boots like these, designed to accommodate all environments. The secret to their crafting is lost to the Rakshasa living here now.
item_40115.Name: Ravana Soldier Boots

item_40116.Description: Popular with elven messengers, these elegant cloth footwraps make your feet move much faster! But they don't protect your feet very well, so you'll need significant endurance to tolerate the numerous stubbed toes and sprained ankles.
item_40116.Name: Windstep Shoes

item_40117.Description: Sturdy and fashionable, if not especially protective.
item_40117.Name: Basic Boots

item_40118.Description: These boots have been hand-painted, but are still pretty ugly.
item_40118.Name: Sturdy Boots

item_40120.Description: A bit of leaves, a bit of bark, and a lot of magic.
item_40120.Name: Spring Fairy Shoes

item_40121.Description: Part of the ancient uniform of Dwarven Stalwarts, the elite warriors entrusted with protecting the most important Dwarven secrets. Quality-wise, they're very protective, but very uncomfortable.
item_40121.Name: Stalwart Boots

item_40122.Description: A pair of old cloth shoes that are much, much tougher than they look.
item_40122.Name: Tough Old Shoes

item_40123.Description: These are shoddy boots that have had sections of their protective armor removed to make them a little more agile. The holes let moisture in, and they quickly stink beyond fathoming.
item_40123.Name: Crude Evasion Boots

item_40124.Description: Reasonable boots that have been oiled and softened to let the wearer dash and dart about. Kinda comfortable, but not really.
item_40124.Name: Decent Evasion Boots

item_40125.Description: Someone with competence put together these nimble leather boots. Only a small amount of protection is lost in exchange for nimble dodging ability.
item_40125.Name: Nice Evasion Boots

item_40126.Description: Quality stuff! These are the sort of evasion boots you'd see in a storefront window, if there was a store specifically for evasion boots, which there is not.
item_40126.Name: Quality Evasion Boots

item_40127.Description: Great stuff! These are the sort of evasion boots you'd see in a storefront window, if there was a store specifically for evasion boots, which there is not.
item_40127.Name: Great Evasion Boots

item_40128.Description: Amazing stuff! These are the sort of evasion boots you'd see in a storefront window, if there was a store specifically for evasion boots, which there is not.
item_40128.Name: Amazing Evasion Boots

item_41002.Name: Basic Pants

item_41003.Description: Sure they're gross, but they're already worn in, and the caked-on dirt provides extra resilience.
item_41003.Name: Comfortable Ancient Pants

item_41005.Description: Gold! With little white frill things. Reasonably protective, too.
item_41005.Name: Sturdy Pants

item_41006.Description: A protective garment that also keeps you light on your feet. The goblin smell, unfortunately, doesn't wash out.
item_41006.Name: Goblin Skirt

item_41007.Description: Strong pants made of leather. You don't want to think about what creature the leather may have come from.
item_41007.Name: Goblin Leggings

item_41008.Description: Made from the skin of abominations, these pants seem to constantly fondle your legs as you wear them. It's really quite disturbing, but the armor is tough...
item_41008.Name: Nightmare Pants

item_41009.Description: The "quality" in the title refers to the defensive merits, not the fashion statement.
item_41009.Name: Quality Pants

item_41011.Description: Crafted by elves who were too homesick to get out of bed, the Pants of the Yearning Sea are sorrow incarnate. But these sure are comfy. Plus, the tears that dripped onto the fabric have made it extra bouncy!
item_41011.Name: Pants of the Yearning Sea

item_41012.Description: Once worn by Makopa the semi-legendary goblin boss.
item_41012.Name: Makopa's Pants

item_41013.Description: They're supernaturally slimming! Plus they have a hidden dimensional pocket inside that can fit a few extra items.
item_41013.Name: Rita's Disturbing Dimensional Panties

item_41014.Description: Created by an alchemist/farmer to protect her legs in the fields, these pants are great at keeping nature off of you. Too bad about the odor...
item_41014.Name: Ivyn's Family Pants

item_41015.Description: Full of wool! Way too much wool. You'd get heatstroke if it was too hot!
item_41015.Name: Ukorga's Experimental Pants

item_41016.Description: These once-amazing pants aren't amazing anymore. They're torn and mangled. But there's still some armor on them... could be worse! A hand-sewn tag inside says "To General Lawyr, may you remember me always, your Kello."
item_41016.Name: General Lawyr's Pants

item_41020.Description: Apparently Rita gave these to Sir Coth, who has since discarded them.
item_41020.Name: Sir Coth's Discarded Gift

item_41021.Description: Somebody has worn these undergarments previously without washing them. Hopefully that person was you. But you're not sure. Anyway, they reek, plus they provide no armor.
item_41021.Name: Crude Underwear

item_41022.Description: Someone was buried in these, apparently. They're caked with dust, but don't seem the worse for wear.
item_41022.Name: Ancient Slacks

item_41023.Description: Any beauty these leggings once possessed has long faded. But they still have an inner beauty, right?
item_41023.Name: Long-Lost Leggings

item_41024.Description: There's a big hole in these, but a decade of spiderweb build-up kind of seals the hole. Kind of.
item_41024.Name: Web-Encrusted Pants

item_41025.Description: These cotton undergarments are possibly the least interesting piece of clothing possible.
item_41025.Name: Cotton Long Underwear

item_41026.Description: These are just cotton underclothes, but they're really well made!
item_41026.Name: Long Stockings

item_41027.Description: Leather armor with a thin layer of strong metal inside.
item_41027.Name: Orcish Greaves

item_41028.Description: During the Elf-Dwarf wars, Dwarven mages created leather-evaporation magic, rendering elves' usual armor obsolete. These ceremonial plate leggings were hurried into battle. Although they're impressively protective, they're still pretty uncomfortable.
item_41028.Name: Elven Plate Leggings

item_41029.Description: The metal is always freezing cold, but you'll soon become numb to such trivial irritations.
item_41029.Name: Greaves of the Winter Court

item_41030.Description: It's been about 15 centuries since the Serbule Revolt, but these dwarven leggings don't seem a day over 450. Their preservative magic is quite strong.
item_41030.Name: Dwarven Soldier Leggings

item_41031.Description: Made from repurposed Winter Court armor in an imperfect process. This somehow conveys the warmth of summer while still being quite cold to the touch.
item_41031.Name: Greaves of the Summer Court

item_41032.Description: Designed by a spiteful necromancer bent on conquering a city, these airy pants seethe with hatred. And it turns out that pure hatred is pretty warm, providing mild protection against the cold.
item_41032.Name: Pants of Hateful Comeuppance

item_41033.Description: When thousands of Rakshasa warriors arrived on Alharth, they wore suits of armor like this, designed to accommodate all environments. The secret to their crafting is lost to the Rakshasa living here now.
item_41033.Name: Ravana Soldier Leggings

item_41034.Description: This kilt is part of the uniform of the dwarven Idealist's Guild. Members produce a substance they call "optimism", which is sold in the form of addictive crystals.

item_41283.Description: You would never realize these pants were crafted by treants... if indeed they were crafted by treants. (Followers of Ri-Shin constantly lie about how many things are crafted by treants. Most likely, it was elves.)
item_41283.Name: Amazing Ri-Shin Pants

item_41284.Description: A pant-shaped conglomeration of plant material. Sometimes a bit of moss is exposed, but they mostly work great.
item_41284.Name: Astounding Ri-Shin Pants

item_41285.Description: Silky leaves, soft moss ... These things are almost comfortable!
item_41285.Name: Awesome Ri-Shin Pants

item_41301.Description: Worn leather pants with metal meticulously inserted into them. Whoever made these lacked skill in leatherworking, but made up for it with time and attention to detail.
item_41301.Name: Desert Vagabond Pants

item_41302.Description: This is the latest masterpiece of rakshasa leatherworking, designed to replace the old Ravana armor they can no longer create. In many ways, this surpasses anything from their homeworld, a testament to rakshasa skill... and the toughness of beasts in Alharth.
item_41302.Name: Rakshasian Elite Leggings

item_41303.Description: Thick matted hair combined with spider silk. These feel great. No, really. They don't look great, but they feel great.
item_41303.Name: Yeti Leggings

item_41304.Description: Nice greaves. Vaguely stylish yet vaguely protective.
item_41304.Name: Basic Pants

item_41305.Description: The isolated elf colony of Sedgewick Forest prefers armor of this type because it reminds them of their home in Verta. It's been explained to them that nobody in Verta dresses this way anymore, but they don't seem to care. An outdated version of the Symbol of Arisetsu can be found on the front.
item_41305.Name: Thentree Skirt

item_41306.Description: A protective garment that also keeps you light on your feet. The goblin smell, unfortunately, doesn't wash out.
item_41306.Name: Goblin Kilt

item_41307.Description: Used by the typical troops of the Crone Hegemony.
item_41307.Name: Peltast Kilt

item_41308.Description: Not really that comfortable unless you're in a blizzard, but then they are really cozy.
item_41308.Name: Insulated Pants

item_41309.Description: It's amazing that these awkwardly-riveted pieces of scorpion and beetle carapace give you any mobility at all. But they do! Just don't sit down too quickly, and you'll be fine.
EffectDescs: You reflect 5% of any physical attack damage (Slashing, Piercing, or Crushing) back at the attacker.
item_41309.Name: Scorpiclaw Leggings

item_41310.Description: The terrifying Onkara lord wore these pants all the time. Like, nonstop. But they don't smell. Eerie.
EffectDescs: You reflect 5% of any physical attack damage (Slashing, Piercing, or Crushing) back at the attacker.
item_41310.Name: General Pask's Leggings

item_41311.Description: The stitching on these leather pants is awful. And the quality of the leather sub-par. But goblins forced to buy their own armor often choose these for cost reasons.
item_41311.Name: Cheap Goblin Leggings

item_41312.Description: It's unclear what sort of leather was used in these greaves, but it's not cow leather. Something thicker.
item_41312.Name: Orcish Military Greaves

item_41313.Description: Worn by the elite Snowblood orcs that take care of problematic situations in battle. They're hard to maintain, but impressively protective.
item_41313.Name: Snowblood Misery Trooper Leggings

item_41314.Description: Worn by orcish mages after they've been promoted to 'Magic Trooper', which is the highest rank they can expect to reach, given mages' glass ceiling in orcish society.
item_41314.Name: Orcish Magic Trooper Pants

item_41315.Description: The brutish barbarians known as the 'McNasty clan' are known for their fearlessness almost as much as for their malodorous grooming habits. These crude metal pants are certainly not clean. But they are strong.
item_41315.Name: McNasty Pants

item_41316.Description: This red-tinted armor is worn by Gazluk City's front-line soldiers, known as "Death Troopers". Their armor enhances their strength and melee prowess.
item_41316.Name: Death Trooper Leggings

item_41317.Description: This blue-tinted armor is worn by Gazluk City's support soldiers, known as "Misery Troopers". Their armor is strong while also providing survival protection in harsh weather.
item_41317.Name: Misery Trooper Leggings

item_41318.Description: This green-tinted armor is worn by Gazluk City's gadgeteers and tacticians, known as "Treachery Troopers". Their armor protects them from battlefield conditions and enhances their tricky combat techniques.
item_41318.Name: Treachery Trooper Leggings

item_41319.Description: This gold-tinted armor is worn by the highest battlefield officers in Gazluk City's army. It is versatile and strong, like its wearer.
item_41319.Name: Gazluk Officer Leggings

item_41320.Description: This cloth armor is worn by the few Gazluk wizards who have become officers. It is designed to aid powerful spellcasters.
item_41320.Name: War-Wizard Officer Pants

item_41321.Description: The terrifying orcish cult known as the Mutterers wear these garments.
item_41321.Name: Mutterer Necromancer Pants

item_41322.Description: The terrifying orcish cult known as the Mutterers wear these garments.
item_41322.Name: Mutterer Cabalist Pants

item_41323.Description: While not exactly beautiful, it's definitely elegant and comfortable. The early work of an up-and-coming master tailor, perhaps.
item_41323.Name: Elegant Cotton Skirt

item_41324.Description: About a million of these enchanted pants were made by the Crone Hegemony for ratkin revolutionaries who said they were going to overthrow their gob-land masters. Ultimately the revolutionaries freed themselves and their friends, then called it quits and traded their armor away.
item_41324.Name: Ratkin Revolutionist Leggings

item_41325.Description: Designed to be worn by either orcs or humans, these pants feature several cinch-points to make them comfortable for any leg girth. With clever manipulation of these belts you store a few small items in them... although that wouldn't be very comfortable.
item_41325.Name: Council Pathfinder Leggings

item_41326.Description: Extraordinarily light armor that is very cold to the touch.
item_41326.Name: Winter Court Battle-Greaves

item_41327.Description: When you don this strange glowing metal suit, you can feel your sense of empathy and community diminish. All the better to kill without remorse!
item_41327.Name: Winter Court Murder-Greaves

item_41328.Description: The leather in these pants has been been partially transformed into wood bark, which is profoundly uncomfortable.
item_41328.Name: Birch Pants

item_41329.Description: Made of giant seashells stitched together with seaweed rope. Surprisingly, they don't stink. (Includes random level 35 enchantments.)
item_41329.Name: Seashell Leggings

item_41330.Description: Made of giant seashells stitched together with seaweed rope. Surprisingly, they don't stink. (Includes random level 40 enchantments.)
item_41330.Name: Fancy Seashell Leggings

item_41331.Description: Made of giant seashells stitched together with seaweed rope. Surprisingly, they don't stink. (Includes random level 45 enchantments.)
item_41331.Name: Extra-Fancy Seashell Leggings

item_41333.Description: Skintight tights worn by ranalon. Their creation method is a mystery to outsiders.
item_41333.Name: Kelp Leggings

item_41334.Description: Skintight tights worn by ranalon. Their creation method is a mystery to outsiders.
item_41334.Name: Tough Kelp Leggings

item_41335.Description: A system of belts and harnesses worn around the hips and legs. Keeps equipment close at hand!
EffectDescs: When wearing 3+ pieces of Fae Military armor, you gain +100% death avoidance (per 15 minutes)
item_41335.Name: Fae Navy Harness

item_41336.Description: A customized system of harnesses worn around the hips and legs. Armor-enhancing nanodispensers are hidden behind the knee guards.
EffectDescs: When wearing 3+ pieces of Fae Military armor, you gain +100% death avoidance (per 15 minutes)
item_41336.Name: Captain Evergloam's Harness

item_41337.Description: Produced in Povus right up until the day the town was attacked. While stylish, they unfortunately lack pockets.
item_41337.Name: "Povus Special" Leggings

item_41338.Description: Uncomfortable tights made of scray skin. When a scray dies, ranalon often make pants like these to honor them by using all the parts of the corpse.
item_41338.Name: Scray-Skin Leggings

item_41339.Description: Peeled from the legs of a dead fungus-man, these form-fitting "leggings" are made of fungus.
item_41339.Name: Fungus-Man Leggings

item_41340.Description: Sized for a very large goblin, or slightly-large human.
item_41340.Name: Hobgoblin Leggings

item_41341.Description: During the Elf-Orc war, dwarven priests of Umrad made tens of thousands of these for their elven allies.

item_41345.Name: Delceri's Brown Pants

item_41346.Description: These silk pants are uncomfortably warm at all times.
item_41346.Name: Saigneir's Blasting Pants

item_41347.Description: The... err... "backside" of these sturdy leather pants doesn't seem to be part of the original design. Some previous owner has sewn in a thick leather square to ensure full body coverage.
item_41347.Name: Wonkman's Beefcake Pantihose

item_41348.Description: This metal armor can shift the wearer's weight automatically to ensure they don't fall over.
item_41348.Name: Ledaig's Everstanding Battle Breeches

item_41349.Description: Pants that aren't quite all there... Weird.

item_41350.Description: Made of a stretchy yet tight-fitting material and adorned with belts and harnesses. Keeps equipment close at hand!
EffectDescs: When wearing 3+ pieces of Fae Military armor, you gain +100% death avoidance (per 15 minutes)

item_4161.Name: Basic Bait

item_4162.Description: A more complex kind of bait that can be used with angling.
item_4162.Name: Good Bait

item_4163.Description: A complex kind of bait that can be used with angling.
item_4163.Name: Expert Bait

item_4164.Description: The most complex kind of bait that can be used with angling.
item_4164.Name: Fishmonger's Bait

item_4171.Description:
A typical orcish-style fishing device. A very long string is stored on a winchable spool. Bizarre.

(Keep this in your inventory in order to use Angling abilities.)
item_4171.Name: Angling Pole

item_4181.Description: A delicate tool for grinding orcish wheat into flour. (Using this item will teach the recipe if needed.)
item_4181.Name: Orcish Wheat Grinder

item_42002.Description: Pretty shoddy workmanship... but hey, it's armor.
item_42002.Name: Basic Breastplate

item_42003.Description: This is the grossest possible thing. But all the blood smears make it harder for monsters to tell where to stab you.
item_42003.Name: Comfortable Ancient Shirt

item_42005.Description: This simple platemail has sufficient protection, but it could do with more padding. Very uncomfortable!
item_42005.Name: Sturdy Shirt

item_42006.Description: Strong enough for a Human, but made for a Goblin. By slaves who toil in very poor working conditions.
item_42006.Name: Goblin Breastplate

item_42007.Description: This is good armor, but rather uncomfortable if you have chest hair... lots of pinching.
item_42007.Name: Goblin Chain Shirt

item_42009.Description: Strong armor with a strong statement to make: "I like red!"
item_42009.Name: Quality Breastplate

item_4201.Description: For healing minor injuries. Used by First Aid abilities.
item_4201.Name: Simple First Aid Kit

item_42010.Description: The breastplate features a perfectly preserved Giant Snail shell.
item_42010.Name: Snail Plate Armor

item_42011.Description: Sacrificing armor for killing power, these robes are popular with wizards. A Necromancy Gem is woven into the chest.
item_42011.Name: Robes of Malediction

item_42012.Description: Imbued with potent magic, the ever-patching shirt is constantly fixing itself.
item_42012.Name: Everpatching Shirt

item_42013.Description: The best armor ever! Oh, except it rusts easily, squeaks a lot, is hot in the summer and cold in the winter, very uncomfortable, and particularly prone to lightning damage. And also it's not the best armor in terms of armor capacity. But ... but it's not bad.
item_42013.Name: Knight's Armor

item_42014.Description: It was in the bedding of Old Fangsworth's lair.
item_42014.Name: Tiger-Urine-Encrusted Shirt

item_42015.Description: Lawara the amnesiac was wearing this when she first awoke. It clearly used to be something special, but now it's barely holding together.
item_42015.Name: Lawara's Mangled Platemail

item_42017.Description: Another piece of once-ceremonial armor that was retrofitted for combat during the Elf-Dwarf wars. The suit has since become a favorite of elven warriors thanks to its handy odor-repulsion magic. And also, of course, its insane amount of protection.
item_42017.Name: Elven Ceremonial Suit

item_4202.Description: For healing moderate injuries. Used by First Aid 2 (and other abilities).
item_4202.Name: Basic First Aid Kit

item_42023.Description: Woven with fairy magic, this lovely shirt regenerates its leaves continuously. Unfortunately it is extremely itchy to wear. But noone said safety and comfort had to go hand in hand, so stop complaining.
item_42023.Name: Leafy Shirt

item_42027.Description: This gross shirt smells of urine. It provides no armor protection, and it's also very itchy.
item_42027.Name: Crude Undershirt

item_42028.Description: This simple platemail has sufficient protection, but it could do with more padding. Very uncomfortable!
item_42028.Name: Sturdy Shirt

item_42029.Description: Simple in design, but heavy on the armor plating.
item_42029.Name: Extra-Sturdy Shirt

item_4203.Description: For healing serious injuries. Used by First Aid 3 (and other abilities).
item_4203.Name: Good First Aid Kit

item_42030.Description: Rust damage has taken a heavy toll on this breastplate. It's still functional, but you'll probably get rust stains all over yourself.
item_42030.Name: Corroded Breastplate

item_42031.Description: Somehow this breastplate got stuck onto a spider via sticky web! What are the odds? Unfortunately, spider acid has filled it with holes, but what a great story!
item_42031.Name: Spider-Worn Coat

item_42032.Description: This breastplate is very old, and a sequence of enchantments has been laid atop it to protect it from the elements. An active symbol of Arisetsu is barely visible under layers of rust and paint.
item_42032.Name: Hunter's Breastplate

item_42033.Description: It's cotton! Breathable, pleasant, cotton. Yep. Cotton.
item_42033.Name: Cotton Undershirt

item_42034.Description: Inlaid with beautiful silver filigree, this cozy shirt looks gorgeous. A universal holy symbol is embroidered inside, allowing priests of Arisetsu, Saledar, or Kirad to enforce their wills.
item_42034.Name: Silver-Threaded Shirt

item_42035.Description: This tough leather armor is interwoven with magical threads that supposedly keep psionic attacks at bay.
item_42035.Name: Orcish Coat

item_42036.Description: When you don this strange metal suit, you can feel your sense of empathy and community diminish. All the better to kill without remorse!
item_42036.Name: Coat of the Winter Court

item_42037.Description: When the dwarves were holed up under Serbule so many centuries ago, they didn't have a lot to do but make really resilient armor. The resiliency magic bleeds over to the wearer.
item_42037.Name: Dwarven Soldier Breastplate

item_42038.Description: Makeshift Summer armor. It grants empathy to the wearer, though only those who are attuned to such things will notice.
item_42038.Name: Coat of the Summer Court

item_42039.Description: Designed by a spiteful necromancer bent on conquering a city, these robes seethe with hatred. And it turns out that pure hatred is pretty warm, providing mild protection against the cold.
item_42039.Name: Robes of Hateful Comeuppance

item_4204.Description: For healing debilitating injuries. Used by First Aid 4 (and other abilities).
item_4204.Name: Expert's First Aid Kit

item_42040.Description: When thousands of Rakshasa warriors arrived on Alharth, they wore suits of armor like this, designed to accommodate all environments. The secret to their crafting is lost to the Rakshasa living here now.
item_42040.Name: Ravana Soldier Coat

item_42041.Description: The rings of this chain suit are ridiculously thick, resulting in a very protective garment that is pretty ugly -- and very conductive of cold and electricity.
item_42041.Name: Thickened Chainmail Shirt

item_42042.Description: Pretty shoddy workmanship... but hey, it's armor.

item_42043.Description: This simple platemail has sufficient protection, but it could do with more padding. Very uncomfortable!

item_42044.Description: Strong armor with a strong statement to make: "I like red!"
item_42044.Name: Quality Breastplate

item_42045.Description: Itchy and viney, but the magic is impressively resilient.
item_42045.Name: Spring Fairy Top

item_42046.Description: This thick and ungainly thing was the preferred armor of the ancient Dwarven Stalwarts. It's easy to see why: this armor is very... stalwart.
item_42046.Name: Stalwart Breastplate

item_42047.Description: A strange mechanism that can augment an arthropod's venomous attack capabilities. (Only wearable by spiders.)
item_42047.Name: Harness of Poisons

item_42048.Description: Cozy and warm, with lots of fur trim.

item_42073.Description: These coats were a gift from the Crone Hegemony to Gob-land guerillas who were trying to free enslaved ratkin. Since the Hegemony is not against slavery in general, it's generally assumed they were just trying to stir up disharmony in the Gob-lands... but perhaps there was an ulterior motive. Anyway, they're still in pretty good shape a decade later.

item_42074.Description: Created by the orcs of Gazluk as part of a short-lived coalition with the neighboring Council Lands. The "Pathfinders of Kur" initiative would have been a mixed-race team of orcs and humans that patrolled and mapped the vast mountain range. Unfortunately one of the human diplomats to Kur drunkenly revealed that the Council cared little about Kur itself, but mostly wanted this opportunity to work cooperatively with the orcs and perhaps build comeraderie. The orcs perceived it as "manipulative human trickery", killed the diplomat, and called the alliance off. But the armor had already been delivered. It's pretty good.

Elaborate necromantic symbols have been inscribed inside; the dye of the symbols is long-faded by they can still be detected by the resonant angst one feels when touching the inside of the garment. A slightly newer inscription inside says "Protect your sanity lest you succumb to the hatred."

item_42703.Description: While many bards lamented Tennenbrandt University's shift away from music and toward combat magic, Lostt reveled in a newfound spotlight, for his music was known across many realms as being offensively bad.

item_43014.Description: Thick smelly gloves that have been through a few fights

item_43021.Name: Shoddy Leather Gloves

item_43022.Description: Although clearly intended to be gloves, these are little more than wads of leather in vaguely-hand-shaped form. Expect immense amounts of palm sweat!
item_43022.Name: Rough Leather Gloves

item_43023.Description: The craftsmanship of these gloves is adequate, but the material is poor, resulting in a functional pair of gloves that aren't much fun to wear.

item_44012.Description: Knights love this sort of thing. Hope they don't go out in a thunderstorm though...

item_44020.Name: Elven Officer's Helm

item_44021.Description: While vaguely protective, this lopsided helmet is so unbalancing that you're almost better off just going into combat without a helm at all.
item_44021.Name: Shoddy Leather Helmet

item_44022.Description: Designed to protect from concussions and minor scrapes, this helmet has the serious drawbacks of reduced visibility, unpleasant odor, and terrible craftsmanship.
item_44022.Name: Rough Leather Helmet

item_44023.Description: While the craftsmanship is adequate, the materials are not, and this helmet looks more like a dead beaver than a helm.
item_44023.Name: Crude Leather Helmet

item_44024.Description: A well-made helmet that will keep you alive in combat. But you'll sweat profusely in it, and you don't want to know what it's going to do to your hair.
item_44024.Name: Decent Leather Helmet

item_44025.Description: A comfy helmet that is almost (but not quite) attractive, too!
item_44025.Name: Nice Leather Helmet

item_44026.Description: Good materials and great craftsmanship combine in a helmet that breathes easy and protects from nearly any injury.
item_44026.Name: Quality Leather Helmet

item_44027.Description: A helmet that's stylish and also functional! Great.
item_44027.Name: Great Leather Helmet

item_44028.Description: This helmet goes beyond mere adequacy. It says "adequate isn't enough!" It takes it one step farther, all the way to more-than-adequate.
item_44028.Name: Amazing Leather Helmet

item_44029.Description: A hat you wouldn't be embarrassed being seen in, and so light and protective! Anti-odor components keep it smelling fresh all day, too.

item_44205.Name: Helm of the Summer Court

item_44206.Description: Designed by a spiteful necromancer bent on conquering a city, this hood seethes with hatred. And it turns out that pure hatred is pretty warm, providing mild protection against the cold.
item_44206.Name: Hood of Hateful Comeuppance

item_44207.Description: Fae blacksmiths have infused the metal of this helm with the essence of eternity, meaning that this helm has never not existed. Don't think about it too much.
item_44207.Name: Indestructible Fae Knight's Helm

item_44208.Description: When thousands of Rakshasa warriors arrived on Alharth, they wore suits of armor like this, designed to accommodate all environments. The secret to their crafting is lost to the Rakshasa living here now.

item_44209.Description: This ugly leather thing is supposed to be worn on the head, apparently.

item_44215.Description: It's a tough helmet that was once used by the elite Dwarven Stalwarts. But that was many years ago, and more recent wearers have not been big on armor maintenance. It's still a great helm, but you imagine it was once even more impressive.
item_44215.Name: Stalwart Helmet

item_44216.Description: Worn leather with metal meticulously inserted into it. Whoever made this lacked skill in leatherworking, but made up for it with time and attention to detail.
item_44216.Name: Desert Vagabond Cap

item_44217.Description: This is the latest masterpiece of rakshasa leatherworking, designed to replace the old Ravana armor they can no longer create. In many ways, this surpasses anything from their homeworld, a testament to rakshasa skill... and the toughness of beasts in Alharth.
item_44217.Name: Rakshasian Elite Helm

item_44218.Description: Thick matted hair combined with spider silk. The silk gets all in your hair and eyes and is rather uncomfortable, but it's really warm.

item_44304.Name: Orbiting Gem

item_44305.Description: Warm, warm, warm. A little smelly. But warm!
item_44305.Name: Insulated Hood

item_44306.Description: A freakish mask crafted by an unliving malevolence.

item_44307.Description: A garnet that floats around your head and emits light. Not especially well-made, but it's still vaguely impressive.
item_44307.Name: Rohina's Mind Gem

item_44308.Name: Monger's Boon

EffectDescs: You reflect 4% of any physical attack damage (Slashing, Piercing, or Crushing) back at the attacker.
item_44310.Name: General Pask's Helm

item_44311.Description: A subpar goblin helm, dented and worn.
item_44311.Name: Cheap Goblin Helmet

item_44312.Description: Perfect for the pig that wishes it were something else. A symbol of Arisetsu has been hidden inside.
item_44312.Name: Pig's Disguise Kit

item_44313.Description: This clever costume is perfect for cows that need to go undercover. A symbol of Arisetsu has been hidden inside.
item_44313.Name: Cow's Disguise Kit

item_44314.Description: Deer can use this handy disguise to appear less conspicuous. A symbol of Arisetsu has been hidden inside.
item_44314.Name: Deer's Disguise Kit

item_44315.Description: A large shell has been lined with sharkskin and netting. It takes some practice to fight with this on!  (Includes random level 35 enchantments.)
item_44315.Name: Seashell Helm

item_44316.Description: A large shell has been lined with sharkskin and netting. It takes some practice to fight with this on!  (Includes random level 40 enchantments.)
item_44316.Name: Fancy Seashell Helm

item_44317.Name: Extra-Fancy Seashell Helm

item_44318.Name: Ever-Hateful Jack O' Lantern

item_44319.Description: This tiny gourd floats around your head and emits evil light.
item_44319.Name: Ever-Glaring Jack O' Lantern

item_4432.Description: A versatile knife for skinning, butchering, oyster-opening, or skull extraction. (Keep it in your inventory and you'll be given the option to skin, butcher, shuck, and/or extract the skull of some enemies.)
item_4432.Name: Multipurpose Knife

item_44320.Description: Where did all these bugs come from?
item_44320.Name: Cloud of Fireflies

item_44321.Description: A helmet sized for a large sow, with a simple but extremely durable design. It's hard to fathom why this exists, but it does.
item_44321.Name: Pig Soldier Helm

item_44322.Description: This dwarven-made pig helm was no doubt worn in an illicit pig-fighting competition. The powerful combat runes are carefully hidden on the inside of the band.
item_44322.Name: Pig Horned Helm

item_44323.Description: The horn of a deceased unicorn. Alicorns have many medicinal uses, but in the right hooves, they have formidable combat uses as well. This particular alicorn looks like it would fit on a deer's head quite nicely, bonding to the skull and enhancing their abilities.
item_44323.Name: Alicorn

item_44324.Description: This oversized hat was created by fairy magic for an unknown purpose. It's too large to fit on a human's head, but it would fit a cow's head perfectly.
item_44324.Name: Twee Cow Sun Hat

item_44325.Description: The horn of a unicorn, enhanced with some sort of dark metal. It looks like it would fit on a deer's head, bonding to the skull and enhancing their abilities.
item_44325.Name: Dark Alicorn

item_44327.Description: Sewn by Eveline Rastin for a friend.
item_44327.Name: Eveline's Comfy Cowl

item_44328.Description: Once used by ratkin guerillas, these cowls were later repurposed for cheese-storage, then un-purposed for that and re-repurposed as armor. As a result they smell a lot like cheese, which the ratkin consider a feature.
item_44328.Name: Ratkin Revolutionist Cowl

item_44329.Description: Foul-smelling and poorly-maintained, yet quite dangerous. Like ratkin homes.
item_44329.Name: Ratkin Necromancer Headdress

item_4433.Description: A bulky knife designed to pry oysters open. (Keep in your inventory to allow oyster-opening. Also provides a 7% chance for a bonus pearl.)
item_4433.Name: Oyster Knife

item_44330.Description: After his brother burned to death, Vagreef spent years mastering Fire Magic to create suits of fire-resistance armor. He planned to manufacture these suits for his entire gang of bandits, but he only managed to make one prototype suit before he was murdered. This was his helmet.
item_44330.Name: Vagreef's Anti-Burn Hat

item_44331.Description: This helmet was crafted by orcs, but was intended to be worn by both orcs and humans. The quality is excellent, but the most interesting feature is definitely the custom ear guard: the creators apparently believed that human ears are especially vulnerable, so they provided special removable padding to give them extra security. No-one knows why the orcs felt this was necessary, and the decision is somewhat troubling.
item_44331.Name: Council Pathfinder Helm

item_44332.Description: Apparently intended to be a gift to Ursula's mother, this cowl is very poorly made and offers no real protection. It has been enchanted with an apprentice-level spell that would normally not be very effective, but the enchantment has been repeated thousands of times over many years, and this has somehow cohered into a decent level of magic.
item_44332.Name: Ursula's Ri-Shin Gift

item_44333.Description: Although it would appear to leave the wearer completely blind, the magical helmet allows perfect visibility.

item_44334.Description: This bizarre glowing helmet affects the mind of the wearer ever so slightly. Just a touch.

item_44335.Description: This hat was digested by something unnatural, and now it exists only in the abstract.

item_44338.Description: Flexible kelp material worn by ranalon. It smells exactly like you'd expect.

item_44341.Name: Fae Navy Communicator

item_44502.Name: Snowblood Misery Trooper Helm

item_44505.Description: This red-tinted armor is worn by Gazluk City's front-line soldiers, known as "Death Troopers". Their armor enhances their strength and melee prowess.
item_44505.Name: Death Trooper Helm

item_44506.Description: This blue-tinted armor is worn by Gazluk City's support soldiers, known as "Misery Troopers". Their armor is strong while also providing survival protection in harsh weather.
item_44506.Name: Misery Trooper Helm

item_44507.Description: This green-tinted armor is worn by Gazluk City's gadgeteers and tacticians, known as "Treachery Troopers". Their armor protects them from battlefield conditions and enhances their tricky combat techniques.
item_44507.Name: Treachery Trooper Helm

item_44508.Description: This gold-tinted armor is worn by the highest battlefield officers in Gazluk City's army. It is versatile and strong, like its wearer.
item_44508.Name: Gazluk Officer Helm

item_44509.Description: This cloth armor is worn by the few Gazluk wizards who have become officers. It is designed to aid powerful spellcasters.
item_44509.Name: War-Wizard Officer Cowl

item_4551.Description: A small glass jar used to hold dye indefinitely. It is not reusable.
item_4551.Name: Dye Pot

item_4552.Description: A clamp and a delicate hammer for turning gems into powder.
item_4552.Name: Gem Crusher

item_45521.Description: A poisoner's blade that's seen better days.
item_45521.Name: Rusty Knife

item_45533.Description: An ugly and not-especially-sharp weapon made of cold iron. Goblins use them when hunting fairies for capture.
item_45533.Name: Cold-Iron Knife

item_45541.Description: This beautiful knife is used in the elvish custom of Surreto Silosi, where young heartbroken elves impale themselves under the oversight of a healer. This rite of passage signals their entrance into the second of three stages of elven maturity. The knife is usually kept as a memento.
item_45541.Name: Lovelorn Blade

item_45553.Description: This is a favorite of goblin healers, who use it as a surgical tool more often than as a weapon. A universal holy symbol attunes it to priests of Saledar, Arisetsu, or Kirad.
item_45553.Name: Goblin Lifekeeper

item_45554.Description: This style of dwarven weapon has been in use for centuries. It makes an excellent stabbing weapon but lacks versatility.
item_45554.Name: Dwarven Gouger

item_45561.Description: A goblin soldier's backup weapon. The hilt guard provides protection at the expense of killing power.
item_45561.Name: Backup Dagger

item_45562.Description: A magically sharp dagger with complex weighting that makes it difficult for neophytes to master. A necromancy gem has been fastened to the handle by its previous owner.
item_45562.Name: Carving Dagger

item_45571.Description: A military dagger used as a close-quarters weapon by some armies in the Crone Hegemony.
item_45571.Name: Soldier's Pugeo

item_45573.Description: Enchanted with cold magic, this weapon is uncomfortable to hold at first, but after a while your hand goes numb and it stops being so bothersome... as long as you don't need to use your hand in combat for anything else.
item_45573.Name: Freezing Blade

item_45581.Description: The signature blade of the human assassin guild called the Shadow Keepers, this weapon design is now found across the continent. Whenever nefarious types scheme, a venomizer is likely at hand.
item_45581.Name: Venomizer

item_45582.Description: These excellent daggers are standard-issue for the Stalwarts, but few dwarves actually use them. They are routinely lost in gambling matches and then reported as stolen, leading to the dwarven idiom "goblins stole your dagger", which is essentially synonymous with "you have a serious gambling problem."
item_45582.Name: Stalwart Dagger

item_45591.Description: An ancient weapon from the War of Froliac, used by elves who were very, very angry. It is etched with an image of the elven begonia, a symbol of trust broken and secrets defiled. Unfortunately, other races don't understand the symbolism and seem to think it's kind of sissy.
item_45591.Name: Elven Dagger

item_45592.Description: Supposedly coated in blood from over 100 different sacrificed creatures, this knife emanates hatred and can lead to unwanted thoughts of murder. A necromancy gem is embedded in the hilt.
item_45592.Name: Controller's Stiletto

item_45601.Description: Made from a giant scorpion tail, this weapon is difficult to use deftly, but poisoners love it.
item_45601.Name: Scorpion's Revenge

item_45602.Description: Supposedly used by the Rakshasa forces that first arrived on Alharth, this weird weapon is definitely not typical.
item_45602.Name: Ravana Soldier Dagger

item_45621.Description: The freakish orcish spellcasters known as Mutterers use these ornate blades to enhance their spells.
item_45621.Name: Mutterer's Blade

item_45622.Description: A small but very sharp blade inlaid with ivory. The craftsmanship is very high.
item_45622.Name: Sirine's Ivory Blade

item_45623.Description: The favored close-quarters weapon of orcish archers.
item_45623.Name: Military Khopis

item_45624.Description: Fashioned after the long knife used by the Executrix of Command, the terrifying head of the Council's personal defenses. This is no match for the real Executrix's knife, but it is still an incredible weapon.
item_45624.Name: Executrix Blade

item_45625.Description: The preferred blade of elvish courtesans in non-elvish lands, this sneaky knife can be concealed almost anywhere. The hilt has symbols of Arisetsu and Errana.
item_45625.Name: Courtesan's Blade

item_45626.Description: An orcish chef used this to chop vegetables... and any drunk orcs that got out of line. Sharpened via an unknown technique, it cleaves through anything with ease.
item_45626.Name: Gut-Ache's Chopper

item_45627.Description: Designed by blacksmith-in-hiding Torgan, this cruel knife rewards the foolish warrior who dares bring a knife to a melee.
item_45627.Name: Torgan's Stiletto

item_45628.Description: A thin and non-descript blade that's been designed to maximize the impact of applied poisons.
item_45628.Name: Rick's Sticker

item_45629.Description: A weapon whose appearance belies the skill of the ratkin crafter. Making a blade this sharp out of junk metal isn't easy.
item_45629.Name: Ratkin Dagger

item_45630.Description: A common backup weapon for many types of fairies.
item_45630.Name: Fairy Dagger

item_45631.Description: A standard Ranalon utility knife that's also a dangerous weapon. (Acts as an Oyster Knife.)
item_45631.Name: Ranalon Dagger

item_45632.Description: A standard Ranalon utility knife that's also a dangerous weapon. (Acts as an Oyster Knife.) (With random level 35 enchantments.)
item_45632.Name: Tough Ranalon Dagger

item_45633.Description: A standard Ranalon utility knife that's also a dangerous weapon. (Acts as an Oyster Knife.) (With random level 40 enchantments.)
item_45633.Name: Fancy Ranalon Dagger

item_45634.Description: A standard Ranalon utility knife that's also a dangerous weapon. (Acts as an Oyster Knife.) (With random level 45 enchantments.)
item_45634.Name: Extra-Fancy Ranalon Dagger

item_45635.Description: This is a favorite of goblin healers, who use it as a surgical tool more often than as a weapon. A universal holy symbol attunes it to priests of Saledar, Arisetsu, or Kirad.
item_45635.Name: Goblin Lifekeeper

item_45637.Description: When held, this weapon seems to freeze the very air around it. A weapon of elite Winter Court troops.
EffectDescs: Knife abilities that normally deal Slashing damage instead deal Cold damage
item_45637.Name: Autofreeze Knife

item_45638.Description: The hilt of this magical blade has been coated in tiny gemstones. They almost completely obscure the necromantic symbols on the pommel.
item_45638.Name: Bedazzled Dagger

item_45639.Description: Actually made by dwarven priests in New Aufghel and rebranded by Povus smiths, who did not specialize in weaponry.
item_45639.Name: "Povus Special" Dagger

item_45640.Description: Wielded by the mad assassin Nopec who wished to bring about Endless Nights in the name of Fenna, goddess of Dusk and Innocence. Fenna was repulsed by this idea, but that didn't stop Nopec's spree of murder.
item_45640.Name: Nopec's Dreaded Dagger of Endless Nights

item_45641.Description: This deadly knife is made from the fang of a Winter Dragon. (Thus making it contraband in Council cities, where dragon parts are forbidden.) It has been augmented to allow the casting of ice magic.
EffectDescs: Knife abilities that normally deal Slashing damage instead deal Cold damage
item_45641.Name: Icesnake

item_45642.Description: The blade of one who has lost graces in elvish court and sunken to depraved lows.
item_45642.Name: Ex-Courtesan's Blade

item_45643.Description: An exotic filleting tool, only for fishing experts.
item_45643.Name: Karamasha's Fishing Knife

item_45701.Description: A long knife held in the off-hand.
item_45701.Name: Basic Dirk

item_45702.Description: A long knife held in the off-hand.
item_45702.Name: Basic Dirk

item_45703.Description: A long knife held in the off-hand. It was once very sharp, but now not so much.
item_45703.Name: Rusty Dirk

item_45704.Description: A simple but robust off-hand blade.
item_45704.Name: Sturdy Dirk

item_45705.Description: A simple but robust off-hand blade.
item_45705.Name: Sturdy Dirk

item_45706.Description: A long knife held in the off-hand.
item_45706.Name: Goblin Dirk

item_45707.Description: A simple off-hand knife that's been crafted to exacting standards.
item_45707.Name: Quality Dirk

item_45708.Description: A simple off-hand knife that's been crafted to exacting standards.
item_45708.Name: Quality Dirk

item_45709.Description: An old dwarven tool. While unexceptional by dwarven standards, it's quite impressive to many other races, who use it as an off-hand weapon.
item_45709.Name: Dwarven Maintenance Blade

item_45710.Description: A strangely-weighted off-hand knife that's good for bashing as well as stabbing.
item_45710.Name: Heavy Dirk

item_45712.Description: An off-hand blade favored by some elven fencers, who use it in conjunction with a longsword.
item_45712.Name: Elven Dirk

item_45713.Description: A gimmicky off-hand knife with a spring mechanism to increase thrusting damage. The mechanism gets gunked up a lot, but on the plus side, the knife is VERY sharp.
item_45713.Name: Stabmaster

item_45714.Description: An off-hand knife used as a personal-defense weapon by some mages. It has a tiny warding glyph that diminishes damage.
item_45714.Name: Safety Dirk

item_45715.Description: An off-hand weapon with nasty barbs to cause as much traumatic damage as possible.
item_45715.Name: Bleeder Shiv

item_45716.Description: An ancient dirk that has been altered by dark magic. But don't worry, it's still sharp.
item_45716.Name: Corrupted Blade

item_45717.Description: This dirk has never not existed and will never stop existing. It was removed from the timestream by Romast, the god of Martial Arts, who is ironically long-dead.
item_45717.Name: Timeless Dirk

item_45718.Description: A sneaky ratkin weapon designed for poison use.
item_45718.Name: Ratkin Dirk

item_45719.Description: A common backup weapon for Spring Fairies that's beginning to find popularity among Winter as well.
item_45719.Name: Fairy Dirk

item_45720.Description: An old dwarven tool. While unexceptional by dwarven standards, it's quite impressive to many other races, who use it as an off-hand weapon.
item_45720.Name: Dwarven Maintenance Blade

item_45721.Description: Wielded by the more sinister variety of Winter Court fae assassins, this shiv freezes everything it touches.
EffectDescs: Knife abilities that normally deal Slashing damage instead deal Cold damage
item_45721.Name: Autofreeze Shiv

item_45722.Description: Styled after the blade of the notorious vampire Ruxandra, who publicly forsook blood-drinking, but was nevertheless hunted and defanged by a mob of angry humans. She took her revenge, using this dirk to feed on the blood of those she deemed unworthy of life.
item_45722.Name: Ruxandra's Bite

item_46001.Description: Well, it's still got a pointy end and a handle. It should work fine.
item_46001.Name: Moldy Ancient Sword

item_46002.Description: It's a sword! Looks pretty sharp.
item_46002.Name: Basic Sword

item_46003.Description: The hilt has been worn smooth with use, leaving indentations that make it easier for neophytes to know how to hold it properly.
item_46003.Name: Battle-Hardened Sword

item_46005.Description: This is a basic sword that Joeh custom-modded over the years. It has a unique hilt and "speed stripes" painted on the blade. Joeh had an entire joke routine planned for when someone asked him what the stripes were for, but nobody ever did.
item_46005.Name: Joeh's Old Sword

item_46006.Description: This sword is sharp. Really sharp. As sharp as you can probably get without imbuing it with magic.
item_46006.Name: Quality Sword

item_46007.Description: Forged by the most skilled goblin weaponsmiths in the tri-county area.
item_46007.Name: Goblinblade

item_46008.Description: Crafted by dwarven blacksmith (and notorious druid-hater) Goh Rastuk. It was going to be imbued with anti-nature magic, but Goh didn't get around to it. It's still a nice sword, though.
item_46008.Name: Naturebane

item_4601.Description: A rock for sharpening the blades of tools.
item_4601.Name: Sharpening Stone

item_46010.Description: Stained with blood, ash, and lightning scars, this dark, evil sword is cold to the touch. Which is kind of creepy. But it's surprisingly well-maintained, and wonderfully sharp! A necromancy gem is embedded in the hilt.
item_46010.Name: Blackened Sword

item_46011.Description: An old style of blade, favored by some werewolves but not many others.
item_46011.Name: Wolfbite

item_46012.Description: Silver is a poor metal for making weapons, and this pocked and marred blade shows it. But its effect against lycanthropes is quite pronounced.
item_46012.Name: Simple Silver Knife

item_46013.Description: An iron sword with a thick coat of silver on top.
item_46013.Name: Silvered Sword

item_46014.Description: Each orc is given a xiphos upon their attainment of adulthood. Made of cold iron, it has a broad blade that slightly favors strength over finesse.
item_46014.Name: Xiphos

item_46015.Description: It's a sword! Looks pretty sharp.
item_46015.Name: Basic Sword

item_46016.Description: This sword is sharp. Really sharp. As sharp as you can probably get without imbuing it with magic.
item_46016.Name: Quality Sword

item_46017.Description: This sword was stuck to a big spider. It's not really in good shape, but the holes in the blade make a neat whistling sound when you swing it.
item_46017.Name: Acid-Addled Blade

item_46018.Description: The  rune etchings in this blade were made by Elven masters. It is rare to find these so far from Elven homelands.
item_46018.Name: Elven Longsword

item_46019.Description: A very old style of Dwarven sword design.
item_46019.Name: Ancient Dwarven Blade

item_4602.Description: A rock for sharpening the blades of advanced tools or small blades.
item_4602.Name: Whetstone

item_46020.Description: A blade that has been in the Sedgewick family line for generations.
item_46020.Name: Sedgewick's Honor

item_46022.Description: Goblin-made, with a focus on sharpness over all else.
item_46022.Name: Goblin Cutlass

item_46023.Description: Rust has taken its toll on this blade, but it's better than nothing.
item_46023.Name: Rusty Sword

item_46024.Description: It has an inscription: "Ensorcelled by Official Council Battlemages. Not for use by Rakshasa upon penalty of triple-death."
item_46024.Name: Council Trooper Sword

item_46025.Description: This is a really old weapon design! They don't make 'em like this anymore, for better or for worse.
item_46025.Name: Antique Spatha

item_46026.Description: This short sword is fairly terrible for anything except gutting livestock. But it does that really well!
EffectDescs: Melee attacks deal +5 damage to pigs
item_46026.Name: Pig Sticker

item_46027.Description: The hilt has been worn smooth with use, leaving indentations that make it easier for neophytes to know how to hold it properly.
item_46027.Name: Battle-Hardened Sword

item_46028.Description: This goblin-made weapon uses a manticore tail as a powerful injector. It's not a very good sword, but it's a great poisoning tool.
item_46028.Name: Gouging Stiletto

item_46029.Description: Stained with blood, ash, and lightning scars, this dark, evil sword is cold to the touch. Which is kind of creepy. But it's surprisingly well-maintained, and wonderfully sharp! A necromancy gem is embedded in the hilt.
item_46029.Name: Blackened Sword

item_46030.Description: An Elven Longsword that has been customized and modified by an expert. Dozens of little lines have been scratched into the blade, suggesting perhaps that the weapon has been used to kill a great many of something.
item_46030.Name: Janet Lew's Old Longsword

item_46031.Description: A rapier-like weapon that also holds a strong cutting edge, this blade is the invention of Lord ErDrick, who was known for his expertise in defensive swordsmanship.
item_46031.Name: Lord ErDrick's Blade

item_46032.Description: Made for orcish armies by dwarven smiths under an ancient treaty.
item_46032.Name: Orcish Spatha

item_46033.Description: An evil weapon forged in a dark fire. A necromancy gem rests in the hilt like a gaudy bauble.
item_46033.Name: Fiendish Rapier

item_46034.Description: This odd weapon was made specifically for chopping attacks. The weighting makes it difficult to use for piercing.
item_46034.Name: Chopping Sword

item_46036.Description: Used by Gazluk orcs to inspire courage and/or fear.
EffectDescs: Sword Slash, Riposte, Windstrike, Finishing Blow, Debilitating Blow and Heart Piercer deal direct Fire damage. All Sword abilities apply Flaming Sword damage for 10 seconds.
item_46036.Name: Flaming Gazluk Sword

item_46037.Description: Designed by blacksmith-in-hiding Torgan, this heavy blade yearns to spill blood.
item_46037.Name: Torgan's Spatha

item_46038.Description: A weapon design from a far-away land.
item_46038.Name: Aktaari Cutlass

item_46039.Description: A sturdy military weapon made for ratkin. Thanks to impressive magic, it seems undamaged by years of extreme misuse.
item_46039.Name: Ratkin Revolutionist Sword

item_46040.Description: Etched with the symbol of a long-lost elven family.
item_46040.Name: Lordling's Spatha

item_46041.Description: As soon as you wield this blade, you can sense its eagerness: it wants to be your partner in murder! Of course, good partnerships require sacrifice from both partners...
item_46041.Name: Bendith's Blade

item_46042.Description: An Orichalcum blade with a seashell motif. (With random level 35 enchantments.)
item_46042.Name: Shellmaster's Blade

item_46043.Description: An Orichalcum blade with a seashell motif. (With random level 40 enchantments.)
item_46043.Name: Fancy Shellmaster's Blade

item_46044.Description: An Orichalcum blade with a seashell motif. (With random level 45 enchantments.)
item_46044.Name: Extra-Fancy Shellmaster's Blade

item_46045.Description: A strange weapon made by trolls in a distant realm.
EffectDescs: Finishing Blow dispels one fire effect on you (up to 35 damage/tick) and restores 65 health
item_46045.Name: Murdebok's Blade

item_46046.Description: An extraordinarily light weapon. The entire blade weighs less than the gaudy gem in the hilt.
item_46046.Name: Fae Rapier

item_46047.Description: This quality weapon has been adorned with tiny jewels and acid-etched with subtle, elegant patterns.
item_46047.Name: Bedazzled Spatha

item_46048.Description: It carries the seal of Jerahd, the only swordsmith in Povus (now deceased). It feels oddly unsettling in the hand.
item_46048.Name: "Povus Special" Longsword

item_46049.Description: Wielded by the warrior-priests of Saledar, the goblin god of Societal Cooperation.
item_46049.Name: Hobgoblin Peacemaster Sword

item_46050.Description: A new sword made in a very old dwarven style. It has a glyph that must be the Eltibule crest.
item_46050.Name: James Eltibule's Sword

item_46051.Description: The life's work of dwarven blacksmith Jott Battlestar, who claimed it contains a shred of the essence of a star.
EffectDescs: Sword Slash, Riposte, Windstrike, Finishing Blow, Debilitating Blow and Heart Piercer deal direct Fire damage. All Sword abilities apply Flaming Sword damage for 10 seconds.
item_46051.Name: Jott's Blazing Star Sword

item_46052.Description: While arguably not as effective as a super-sharp normal sword, Prognek's flaming design is fun for pyromaniacs.
EffectDescs: Sword Slash, Riposte, Windstrike, Finishing Blow, Debilitating Blow and Heart Piercer deal direct Fire damage. All Sword abilities apply Flaming Sword damage for 10 seconds.
item_46052.Name: Prognek's Flaming Sword

item_46053.Description: Though now best known as a captain of the splinter group known as the Alharth Rebels, Tabor first gained fame in the Sand War, wielding this blade in the name of the Council.
item_46053.Name: Tabor's Blade of Supremacy

item_46054.Description: This broadsword was enchanted with the sole goal of taking off heads.
item_46054.Name: Mankiller Sword

item_46055.Description: A strange weapon made by trolls in a distant realm.
EffectDescs: Finishing Blow dispels one fire effect on you (up to 35 damage/tick) and restores 65 health
item_46055.Name: Murdebok's Blade

item_46056.Description: A blade that has been in the Sedgewick family line for generations.
item_46056.Name: Sedgewick's Honor

item_46057.Description: The  rune etchings in this blade were made by Elven masters. It is rare to find these so far from Elven homelands.
item_46057.Name: Elven Ceremonial Longsword

item_46058.Description: It's unclear what this sword is made of, or who might have smithed it. The edge is so sharp that it can cut flesh from three inches away.
item_46058.Name: Dragon's Strike

item_46059.Description: While inarguably well-made, it seems somewhat ceremonial: the blade isn't even sharp! But it is very, very, VERY hot, which might count for something. There is an inscription: "The Bearer Is Worthy"
EffectDescs: Sword Slash, Riposte, Windstrike, Finishing Blow, Debilitating Blow and Heart Piercer deal direct Fire damage. All Sword abilities apply Flaming Sword damage for 10 seconds.
item_46059.Name: Vanquisher's Blade

item_46060.Description: A Veilmoor clan promotional weapon. The blade psychically screams on contact with enemies.
EffectDescs: Sword abilities apply Psychic scream damage for 10 seconds.
item_46060.Name: Rapier Wit

item_46061.Description: The result of a supremely hateful undead gripping a magic sword for too long while not moving. Hatred slowly heats the blade, and since hatred doesn't dissipate naturally, it remains fiery hot.
EffectDescs: Sword Slash, Riposte, Windstrike, Finishing Blow, Debilitating Blow and Heart Piercer deal direct Fire damage. All Sword abilities apply Flaming Sword damage for 10 seconds.
item_46061.Name: Hatebright Sword

item_46101.Description: A professional-grade broadsword made for slicing and injuring.
item_46101.Name: Quality Military Sword

item_46102.Description: A professional-grade broadsword made for slicing and injuring.
item_46102.Name: Great Military Sword

item_46103.Description: A professional-grade broadsword made for slicing and injuring.
item_46103.Name: Amazing Military Sword

item_46104.Description: An exquisite broadsword made for slicing and injuring.
item_46104.Name: Astounding Military Sword

item_46105.Description: An exquisite broadsword made for slicing and injuring.
item_46105.Name: Awesome Military Sword

item_46106.Description: An exquisite broadsword made for slicing and injuring.
item_46106.Name: Incredible Military Sword

item_46107.Description: An exquisite broadsword made for slicing and injuring.
item_46107.Name: Marvelous Military Sword

item_4611.Description: A grindstone for sharpening swords and other large weapons.
item_4611.Name: Weapon Whetstone

item_4612.Description: Tools for refining the balance and movement of weapons. Includes restringing kit.
item_4612.Name: Precision Reweighting Kit

item_4613.Description: When grip precision is crucial, this paper has the perfect level of abrasiveness.
item_4613.Name: Weapons-Grade Sandpaper

item_4614.Description: From burs to brushes, screws to setting tools, it's all in here.
item_4614.Name: Jeweler's Maintenance Kit

item_4615.Description: A bit of enchanted chainmail that can help protect the weak spots in metal armor.
item_4615.Name: Arcane Gousset

item_4616.Description: A conditioning oil that breaks down encrusted negative magic which can interfere with armor's protectiveness, range of motion, and (in the case of sentient armor) morale.
item_4616.Name: Hexbreak Unguent

item_4617.Description: A thick goo that seems to make armor more "alive". The mechanism of action is poorly understood, leading to outlandish theories.
item_4617.Name: Thaumic Vibrifier

item_4618.Description: Impressively thin fabric that can be sewn into armor to better connect the material to the magic of the world around it.
item_4618.Name: Prismatic Netting

item_4619.Description: A tiny metal wedge that can be installed in footwear. It improves comfort and corrects gait problems which can dramatically improve survivability. It's also magical and does magic things.
item_4619.Name: Enchanted Shim

item_46503.Description: The fretboard is reinforced with steel to keep it from breaking at an inopportune moment.
item_46503.Name: Sturdy Bard Lute

item_46504.Description: The fretboard is reinforced with steel to keep it from breaking at an inopportune moment.
item_46504.Name: Sturdy Bard Lute

item_46505.Description: This once-high-quality Trancelute was left out in the elements. No amount of tuning will make it very effective.
item_46505.Name: Moldy Trancelute

item_46506.Description: This bardic instrument has a lovely, uplifting sound that makes it fun to play.
item_46506.Name: Jolly Lute

item_46507.Description: Mass-produced by competent artisans, there is nothing special -- or especially wrong -- about this lute.
item_46507.Name: Quality Bard Lute

item_46508.Description: Mass-produced by competent artisans, there is nothing special -- or especially wrong -- about this lute.
item_46508.Name: Quality Bard Lute

item_46509.Description: Made for goblins by craftsman slaves. It seems fairly old, and has a nice sound quality.
item_46509.Name: Goblin Lute

item_4651.Description: A customized hammer used by toolsmiths and weaponsmiths.
item_4651.Name: Peening Hammer

item_46510.Description: Augmented with magical sigils that enhance the lute's hypnotic properties. (The magic isn't strong, but it's noticeable.) One of the sigils happens to be a symbol of Arisetsu, enabling priest magic.
item_46510.Name: Trancelute

item_46511.Description: This ancient doomlute was severely damaged and then repaired by an expert. It still holds a bit of its magic.
item_46511.Name: Refurbished Doomlute

item_46512.Description: This is slightly louder than a normal lute, allowing more effective rallying.
item_46512.Name: Leader's Lute

item_46513.Description: Made by an expert craftsman in Rahu. The body is imported hardwood, the strings are high-quality grimalkin gut, and the unusual enchantments give it a deep luxurious sound quality. Not for beginners!
item_46513.Name: Rakshasa Lute

item_46514.Description: The strange symbols etched into this lute seem to represent constellations, but not ones you're immediately familiar with.
item_46514.Name: Starlute

item_46515.Description: Resonance sigils give this bardic weapon a potent boom.
item_46515.Name: Withering Lute

item_46516.Description: An ancient dwarven instrument from a long-lost age.
item_46516.Name: Doomlute

item_46517.Description: A gift from Rappanel, the elven bard. It has something of his signature sound.
item_46517.Name: Daisy

item_46518.Description: Made of wood from a world that you will never see (and if you did, all the trees are extinct anyway). It's a little small, but serviceable.
item_46518.Name: Fairy Lute

item_46519.Description: A rebranded lute that was actually made in Rahu.
item_46519.Name: "Povus Special" Lute

item_4652.Description: A customized hammer used by armorsmiths.
item_4652.Name: Dishing Hammer

item_46520.Description: A grandiose sound comes from this rather hefty lute.
item_46520.Name: Grelp's Grandiose Lute

item_46521.Description: A practice tool used by bards during their studies.
EffectDescs: You can use the ability Hymn of Resurrection. (Equipping this item will teach you the ability if needed.)
item_46521.Name: Resuscitation Lute

item_4653.Description: A customized hammer used by smiths.
item_4653.Name: Shaping Hammer

item_4654.Description: A customized hammer used by smiths.
item_4654.Name: Tack Hammer
