item_4655.Name: Delicate Tack Hammer

item_4656.Description: A customized hammer used by smiths.
item_4656.Name: Grand Shaping Hammer

item_4657.Description: A customized hammer used by chefs.
item_4657.Name: Meat Tenderizer

item_4658.Description: A customized hammer used by armor and jewelry crafters.
item_4658.Name: Microdishing Hammer

item_4659.Description: A customized hammer used by master smiths.
item_4659.Name: Mastershaping Hammer

item_46701.Description: A simple instrument made of animal horn.
item_46701.Name: Basic Bard Horn

item_46702.Description: A simple instrument made of animal horn.
item_46702.Name: Blowing Horn

item_46703.Description: A musical instrument made of ram's horn.
item_46703.Name: War Shofar

item_46704.Description: Made of a large animal horn and enchanted with magics that enhance its volume.
item_46704.Name: Blast Horn

item_46705.Description: Carved from a ram's horn by an artisan in Statehelm.
item_46705.Name: Quality Ocarina

item_46706.Description: Carved from a ram's horn by an artisan in Statehelm.
item_46706.Name: Quality Ocarina

item_46707.Description: A wooden instrument that was invented by lumberjacks in Sedgewick Forest to ward off treant saplings.
item_46707.Name: Stickhorn

item_46708.Description: Made of stone, this traditional dwarven instrument requires much skill to use.
item_46708.Name: Stonebugle

item_46709.Description: A wooden instrument with terrible and toxic enchantments. Even touching it to your lips causes slight pain.
item_46709.Name: Death Lur

item_4671.Description: A tiny batch of adhesive. It's used by crafters such as carpenters and fletchers.
item_4671.Name: Basic Wood Glue

item_46710.Description: Made from a sea-snail shell, this instrument has an ominous tone.
item_46710.Name: Leader's Conch

item_46711.Description: Made of a secret elven wood (not oak, despite the name), this horn has a warm but somber quality.
item_46711.Name: Oakhorn

item_46712.Description: A simple horn instrument that's been enchanted to make listeners more nimble.
item_46712.Name: Weaver's Ocarina

item_46713.Description: An instrument made of two ram horns, one embedded inside the other. The sound is terrible, so it is exclusively used as a weapon.
item_46713.Name: Echo Horn

item_46714.Description: This horn is made of shell and enchanted with protective runes.
item_46714.Name: Infallible Conch

item_46715.Description: This sort of instrument is said to be used by elves when they go to war. The last elven war is a distant memory, however, so it's unclear who's making these horns.
item_46715.Name: War Ocarina

item_46716.Description: Made from the horn of the extinct Destiny Ram, this instrument is illegal in six countries, including Verta. But it sounds great!
item_46716.Name: Destiny Horn

item_46719.Description: A white-label horn sold as part of Povus's product line. It's unclear who actually created it.
item_46719.Name: "Povus Special" Horn

item_4672.Description: A tiny batch of adhesive. It's used by crafters such as carpenters and fletchers.
item_4672.Name: Advanced Wood Glue

item_46720.Description: Grimly fashioned from a mythical rhino's horn. It has a sound like... a dying rhino.
item_46720.Name: Everhorn

item_46722.Description: An inscription on this beautiful instrument claims that it was used by Ultimator to wake up a drunken company of troops at the Battle of Buttocks' End. If true, this battle has been lost to the ages. The instrument primarily excels at low fart-like noises.
item_46722.Name: The Blasting Ultimator

item_46723.Description: An inscription claims "Fame and Fortune are Fleeting..."
EffectDescs: Core attacks hasten the current reuse timer of Virtuoso's Ballad by 5 seconds
item_46723.Name: Faie's Fickle Fife

item_4673.Description: A tiny batch of adhesive. It's used by crafters such as carpenters and fletchers.
item_4673.Name: Expert Wood Glue

item_46734.Description: A shell that can make noise.
EffectDescs: Equipping this item grants you basic proficiency in wind instrument performance.
item_46734.Name: Decent Musical Conch

item_46735.Description: A beautiful shell with a mellow sound.
EffectDescs: Equipping this item grants you basic proficiency in wind instrument performance.
item_46735.Name: Nice Musical Conch

item_46736.Description: A lovely shell that's perfect for bardic performances.
EffectDescs: Equipping this item grants you basic proficiency in wind instrument performance.
item_46736.Name: Quality Musical Conch

item_46737.Description: An exceptional instrument that's too complex for amateurs. This shell's intricate fingering is best left to bards.

item_4681.Description: A simple knife designed for beginning knife-throwers. (Used with the Knife combat skill.)
item_4681.Name: Simple Throwing Knife

item_4682.Description: A knife designed for throwing. (Used with the Knife combat skill.)
item_4682.Name: Basic Throwing Knife

item_4683.Description: A well-balanced knife designed for throwing. (Used with the Knife combat skill.)
item_4683.Name: Good Throwing Knife

item_4684.Description: A carefully-made knife designed for expert knife-throwers. (Used with the Knife combat skill.)
item_4684.Name: Expert's Throwing Knife

item_4685.Description: A masterfully-made throwing knife. (Used with the Knife combat skill.)
item_4685.Name: Master's Throwing Knife

item_4686.Description: An exceptionally well-made throwing knife. (Used with the Knife combat skill.)
item_4686.Name: Amazing Throwing Knife

item_4687.Description: An exceptionally well-made throwing knife. (Used with the Knife combat skill.)
item_4687.Name: Astounding Throwing Knife

item_4688.Description: An exceptionally well-made throwing knife. (Used with the Knife combat skill.)
item_4688.Name: Superb Throwing Knife

item_47001.Description: This staff has seen so much. Thankfully it can't talk.
item_47001.Name: Moldy Ancient Staff

item_47003.Description: It's charred and black from tossing hundreds of fireballs over the years, but it's still really comfortable to use.
item_47003.Name: Battle Hardened Staff

item_47004.Description: This was enchanted by a competent apprentice, but it's nothing special.
item_47004.Name: Sturdy Staff

item_47005.Description: An inscription in Elven reads "To my lovely Velkort, thanks for a great evening."
item_47005.Name: Velkort's Hand-Me-Down

item_47006.Description: This was made by an advanced apprentice, perhaps. While not a masterpiece, it avoids all the classic blunders of staff-making.
item_47006.Name: Quality Staff

item_47007.Description: Designed for inquisitive fire mages who like to explore new ways to burn things.
item_47007.Name: Inquisitor's Staff

item_47008.Description: The original Fatestick was created in a bygone age by Jessandra the Cruel, who used it to save an orphanage from frost bees. Afterwards she declared that the staff had somehow tricked her into being kind and discarded it.
item_47008.Name: Fatestick

item_47009.Description: So named because it makes a sort of swishing noise. Nobody said weapons crafters were good at naming things.
item_47009.Name: Swishystick

item_47010.Description: Well-suited for staff-fighting, but a reasonable fire staff as well. Versatility!
item_47010.Name: Balanced Battlestaff

item_47011.Description: Hogan the staff-fighter's masterpiece... Well, a reasonable facsimile.
item_47011.Name: Hogan's Crippler

item_47012.Description: The lich Khyrulek crafted this wand during her centuries as a living corpse. It works better for the undead, but it's still pretty good for living people. (Not suitable for use as a fighting staff. This only works for fire magic.)
item_47012.Name: The Galvanizer

item_47013.Description: Handmade by a fairy, this staff is embarrassingly dainty.
item_47013.Name: Jesina's Staff

item_47015.Description: Very sturdy, but with a hollow core that gives it a strange heft when swung.
item_47015.Name: Goblin Staff

item_47016.Description: Made of burned bones, this staff is great for necromancers or fire mages. Less great for staff fighting, because burned bones aren't exactly quality building material. It's topped with a necromancy gem.
item_47016.Name: Necromancer's Training Staff

item_47017.Description: A plain stick topped with a necromancy gem. Also works for Fire Magic and Staff Fighting.
item_47017.Name: Necromancy Test Staff

item_47018.Description: Elves create these staves when they're feeling old. The feeling usually passes after a few decades, though, and then the elves give them away.
item_47018.Name: Elven Staff

item_47019.Description: Honed to perfection by a staff expert who slowly went mad from Lycanthropy. It's a powerful weapon, though it is marred by long ugly claw marks.
item_47019.Name: Elerimon Staff

item_47020.Description: Infused with arcane protective rituals. While technically usable by fire Fire Mages and Staff Fighters, this weapon is designed to be wielded by those who fancy themselves healers.
item_47020.Name: Yagreet's Staff

item_47021.Description: Infused with arcane protective rituals. While technically usable by fire Fire Mages and Staff Fighters, this weapon is designed to be wielded by those who fancy themselves healers.
item_47021.Name: Yagreet's Staff

item_47022.Description: Given to neophyte druids to help them hone their powers.
item_47022.Name: Druidic Training Stick

item_47023.Description: This was the favored match-stick of a minor flame spirit.
item_47023.Name: Bonfire Summoner

item_47024.Description: This was enchanted by a competent apprentice, but it's nothing special.
item_47024.Name: Sturdy Staff

item_47025.Description: This was made by an advanced apprentice, perhaps. While not a masterpiece, it avoids all the classic blunders of staff-making.
item_47025.Name: Quality Staff

item_47026.Description: Orloaka the goblin sage augmented this staff by filling its hollow core with tears collected from dying unicorns. Unicorns that he burned alive! (They were actually rhinos, not unicorns, though, so the enchantment isn't all that great.)
item_47026.Name: Orloaka's Staff

item_47027.Description: Used by dwarves who must venture onto the battle field to aid fallen comrades.
item_47027.Name: Dwarven Medic Staff

item_47028.Description: This wooden staff is icy cold to the touch.
item_47028.Name: Freezing Staff

item_47029.Description: This seems to be made of enchanted ice. Kind of neat.
item_47029.Name: Staff of Ice

item_47030.Description: It doesn't have any sand magic or anything. It's just been in the sand a long time.
item_47030.Name: Sandy Staff

item_47031.Description: A staff with modest enchantments and modest grip and modest... well, let's just say the whole thing is 'modest'. In a 'not very good' kind of way.
item_47031.Name: Adequate Staff

item_47032.Description: A traditional druidic training staff has been augmented with dozens of arcane sigils and then dipped in ... something waxy. Probably something organic. Best not to contemplate.
item_47032.Name: Druidic Assault Staff

item_47033.Description: It's charred and black from tossing hundreds of fireballs over the years, but it's still really comfortable to use.
item_47033.Name: Battle Hardened Staff

item_47034.Description: It's charred and black from tossing hundreds of fireballs over the years, but it's still really comfortable to use.
item_47034.Name: Battle Hardened Staff

item_47035.Description: Inscribed with ancient rakshasa runes, this staff taps magic from another world, making it quite hot. A recent owner also attuned it to Arisetsu, further heating it to the point that wielding the staff is a bit painful.
item_47035.Name: Sun Warden

item_47036.Description: A customized staff with heavy weights on each end.
item_47036.Name: Roshun's Heavy Hitter

item_47037.Description: Originally popularized by the terrifying harpy mages known as the Winged Witches.
item_47037.Name: Winged Witch Staff

item_47038.Description: A weapon for experienced staff-fighters who wish to get a little more oomph out of their lunges.
item_47038.Name: Lunging Staff

item_47039.Description: This potent battle staff was used by the thaumaturges of Gazluk to train their pet hippogriff.
item_47039.Name: Hippogriff Prod

item_47040.Description:
Used by the elite Gazluk orcish tacticians.

Note: this halberd is considered a Staff, but it cannot be used to cast spells.
EffectDescs: Staff abilities that normally deal Crushing damage instead deal Slashing damage
item_47040.Name: Tactician's Halberd

item_47041.Description: Designed by blacksmith-in-hiding Torgan, this staff is weighted very oddly, rewarding users for truly committing to each attack.
item_47041.Name: Torgan's Staff

item_47042.Description:
The traditional weapon of Ranalon Guardians. This model is pretty basic, but still very effective.
Note: this weapon is considered a Staff.
EffectDescs: Staff abilities that normally deal Crushing damage instead deal Slashing damage
item_47042.Name: Guardian Trident

item_47043.Description: A common ranalon weapon that doubles as a multi-purpose tool. Ranastaves are sturdy enough to dig with and resilient enough to survive earth-magic being cast through them.
item_47043.Name: Ranastaff

item_47044.Description: Used by ratkin summoners to raise the dead and toss the occasional fireball.
item_47044.Name: Ratkin Staff

item_47045.Description: Made of a pretentious fairy wood, this staff is incredibly strong, yet gives in just the right ways.
item_47045.Name: Trueoak Staff

item_47046.Description: This traditional merfolk weapon has useful water enchantments, but unfortunately those same enchantments make it useless for fire magic. (With random level 35 enchantments.)
item_47046.Name: Staff of the Sea

item_47047.Description: This traditional merfolk weapon has useful water enchantments, but unfortunately those same enchantments make it useless for fire magic. (With random level 40 enchantments.)
item_47047.Name: Fancy Staff of the Sea

item_47048.Description: This traditional merfolk weapon has useful water enchantments, but unfortunately those same enchantments make it useless for fire magic. (With random level 45 enchantments.)
item_47048.Name: Extra-Fancy Staff of the Sea

item_47050.Description: A common ranalon weapon that doubles as a multi-purpose tool. Ranastaves are sturdy enough to dig with and resilient enough to survive earth-magic being cast through them.
item_47050.Name: Tough Ranastaff

item_47051.Description:
The traditional weapon of Ranalon Guardians. This model has a great heft and has been augmented with some common ranalon magics.
Note: this weapon is considered a Staff.
EffectDescs: Staff abilities that normally deal Crushing damage instead deal Slashing damage
item_47051.Name: Sacred Guardian Trident

item_47052.Description:
The custom-tailored weapon of a mighty Ranalon Guardian captain.
Note: this weapon is considered a Staff.
EffectDescs: Staff abilities that normally deal Crushing damage instead deal Slashing damage
item_47052.Name: Lusssha's Trident

item_47053.Description: Made of a felled treant, this staff almost seems to squirm with resentment.
item_47053.Name: Fruitless Staff

item_47054.Description: This appears to be a custom-detailed ranastaff, not something originally made in Povus. In any case, the quality is high.
item_47054.Name: "Povus Special" Staff

item_47055.Description: Used by goblin paleontologists in pursuit of knowledge.
item_47055.Name: Paleontology Staff

item_47056.Description: While it resembles a wooden staff, it's actually made of super-compressed, highly conductive mushrooms.
item_47056.Name: Fungi Staff

item_47057.Description: Customized for the Unfun Guy by visiting weaponsmiths, this staff hits hard. And often.
item_47057.Name: Unfun Staff

item_47058.Description: An ornate staff that celebrates your renowned generosity.
item_47058.Name: Staff Of Leadership

item_47059.Description: A simple wooden wand with runes etched into it.
item_47059.Name: Beginner's Weather Wand

item_47060.Description: A potent weapon used by Leafmasters, Stormmasters, and other guardians of elven society.
item_47060.Name: Leafwind

item_47061.Description: It looks like a stick. But it's a very magical stick.
item_47061.Name: Windtwig

item_47062.Description: Adorned with dead leaves that rustle to their own magical wind.
item_47062.Name: Wand of Frigid Winds

item_47063.Description: It emits a discomfiting aura, as if it isn't quite as real as it ought to be.
item_47063.Name: Ambrosia's Staff of Rudeness

item_47064.Description: A deadly wand in the right hands.
item_47064.Name: Gunn's Wand

item_47065.Description: For many decades this was the de facto standard for masters of the magical arts, only falling from favor because the tree it is made from has gone extinct.
item_47065.Name: Staff of the Artifex

item_47066.Description: A curiously-whittled piece of wood. It hums with electricity.
item_47066.Name: Trasen's Wand

item_47067.Description: A curiously-whittled piece of wood. It hums with electricity.
item_47067.Name: Trasen's Refined Wand

item_47068.Description:
The traditional weapon of Ranalon Guardians. This model is pretty nice.
Note: this weapon is considered a Staff.
EffectDescs: Staff abilities that normally deal Crushing damage instead deal Slashing damage
item_47068.Name: Guardian Trident

item_47069.Description: What is that stuff running down the side of the Blood Staff, you ask? Blood. It's blood.
item_47069.Name: Cultist's Blood Staff

item_47070.Description: A custom wand made by an old druid.
item_47070.Name: Touch of Decay

item_47071.Description: A cruel weapon for cruel necromancers who like to burn things.
item_47071.Name: Darkburn Staff

item_47072.Description: What is that stuff running down the side of the Blood Staff, you ask? Blood. It's blood.
item_47072.Name: Ilth Hale Blood Staff

item_47073.Description: The blade is permanently coated in poison.
EffectDescs: Staff abilities that normally deal Crushing damage instead deal Slashing damage. All slashing abilities apply Poison Slice damage for 10 seconds.
item_47073.Name: Viper Halberd

item_47074.Description: A nondescript stick. Wielding this weapon makes you seem less interesting.
item_47074.Name: Minimizer Staff

item_47101.Description: Come on, the bark isn't even fully removed from this stick! But it's pretty thick. (It will work for Staff Fighting but not Fire Magic abilities.)
item_47101.Name: Shoddy Melee Staff

item_47102.Description: Well, the bark has mostly been removed. Mostly. You'll only get a few splinters trying to use this. (It will work for Staff Fighting but not Fire Magic abilities.)
item_47102.Name: Rough Melee Staff

item_47103.Description: Look, someone figured out how to sand down the edges of a stick. Too bad the creator had no idea how to balance its weight. (It will work for Staff Fighting but not Fire Magic abilities.)
item_47103.Name: Crude Melee Staff

item_47104.Description: This staff is what you'd expect from a combat staff. Absolutely nothing special, though. This will work for Staff Fighting but lacks the runes necessary to work for Fire Magic.
item_47104.Name: Decent Melee Staff

item_47105.Description: Someone took a lot of time balancing and testing this staff to make sure it had the perfect weight distribution. This will work well for Staff Fighting, but lacks the runes necessary to work for Fire Magic.
item_47105.Name: Nice Melee Staff

item_47106.Description: Reinforced and quite sturdy. The weight distribution is slightly off because of the added metal, but it's hardly noticeable. This staff will work well for Staff Fighting, but lacks the runes necessary to work for Fire Magic.
item_47106.Name: Quality Melee Staff

item_47107.Description: The creator of this staff obviously had a lot of experience in making these. Largely metal-clad, but just the right amount of give from the wood. (This staff will work well for Staff Fighting, but lacks the runes necessary to work for Fire Magic.)
item_47107.Name: Great Melee Staff

item_47108.Description: This staff has a surprising amount of detail work. Grips at just the right places, metal tips, and a reduction of weight without adversely affecting durability. (It will work for Staff Fighting but not Fire Magic abilities.)
item_47108.Name: Amazing Melee Staff

item_47109.Description: This has all the relevant features that a staff fighter could want: durable, flexible, perfectly weighted, and makes a cool whistling sound when swung. (This will work for Staff Fighting but not Fire Magic abilities.)
item_47109.Name: Astounding Melee Staff

item_47110.Description: No words. Just swing this staff around a few times and you'll realize that its beauty surpasses the spoken language. (This will work for Staff Fighting but not Fire Magic abilities.)
item_47110.Name: Awesome Melee Staff

item_47111.Description: No words. Just swing this staff around a few times and you'll realize that its beauty surpasses the spoken language. (This will work for Staff Fighting but not Fire Magic abilities.)
item_47111.Name: Incredible Melee Staff

item_47112.Description: No words. Just swing this staff around a few times and you'll realize that its beauty surpasses the spoken language. (This will work for Staff Fighting but not Fire Magic abilities.)
item_47112.Name: Marvelous Melee Staff

item_47121.Description: Come on, the bark isn't even fully removed from this stick! But it's pretty thick. Very basic Fire Magic runes have been crudely etched into the bark.
item_47121.Name: Shoddy Combat Staff

item_47122.Description: Well, the bark has mostly been removed. Mostly. You'll only get a few splinters trying to use this. The crude Fire Magic runes bear the mark of an amateur, but should work.
item_47122.Name: Rough Combat Staff

item_47123.Description: Look, someone figured out how to sand down the edges of a stick. Too bad the creator had no idea how to balance its weight. The Fire Magic runes look a little less haphazard, though.
item_47123.Name: Crude Combat Staff

item_47124.Description: This staff is what you'd expect from a combat staff. Absolutely nothing special, though. The standard Fire Magic runes have been etched into the wood.
item_47124.Name: Decent Combat Staff

item_47125.Description: Someone took a lot of time balancing and testing this staff to make sure it had the perfect weight distribution. Then Fire Magic runes were carefully sculpted into the wood.
item_47125.Name: Nice Combat Staff

item_47126.Description: Reinforced and quite sturdy. The weight distribution is slightly off because of the added metal, but it's hardly noticeable. The Fire Magic runes were burned through the metal, creating a neat tactile sensation.
item_47126.Name: Quality Combat Staff

item_47127.Description: The creator of this staff obviously had a lot of experience in making these. Largely metal-clad, but just the right amount of give from the wood. The Fire Magic Runes were burned in, and glow with comforting warmth when used.
item_47127.Name: Great Combat Staff

item_47128.Description: This staff has a surprising amount of detail work. Grips at just the right places, metal tips, and a reduction of weight without adversely affecting durability. The Fire Magic runes are elegant but understated.
item_47128.Name: Amazing Combat Staff

item_47129.Description: This has all the relevant features that a staff fighter or fire mage could want: durable, flexible, perfectly weighted, fire-spewing, and makes a cool whistling sound when swung.
item_47129.Name: Astounding Combat Staff

item_47130.Description: No words. Just swing this staff around a few times and you'll realize that its beauty surpasses the spoken language. The Fire Magic runes are a masterpiece of calligraphy, too.
item_47130.Name: Awesome Combat Staff

item_5092.Description: The pods are too spicy to eat raw, but the powder scraped from them is a valuable spice for cooking.
item_5092.Name: Vanilla

item_5093.Description: Fresh soybeans, ready to be processed into edible food. They are too bitter to be eaten raw, but useful in cooking.
item_5093.Name: Soybeans

item_5094.Description: This packet holds a proprietary mix of mystery spices. It has a very autumn-y smell.
item_5094.Name: Harvest Spices

item_5095.Description: Like chicken meat, but larger, and with a more pronounced flavor. This bird was quite well-fed.
item_5095.Name: Plump Raw Turkey

item_5097.Description: A chunk of raw boar meat from an amazing animal.
item_5097.Name: Amazing Pork Shoulder

item_51.Description: WARNING! This spittle is contaminated with the Lycanthropy disease. Drinking it will make you a werewolf instantly and forever! There is NO cure.
item_51.Name: Werewolf Spit

item_51001.Description: Good for flinging small amounts of chemicals all around you. Held in the main hand.
item_51001.Name: Basic Combat Beaker

item_51002.Description: An extraordinary staff with an alchemical beaker on the end. You can use this for staff fighting or battle chemistry. It's not suitable for fire magic, though.
item_51002.Name: Hogan's Flingin' Stick

item_51003.Description: An unusual staff with an alchemical beaker on the end. Not suitable for casting Fire Magic.
item_51003.Name: Beaker-Stick

item_51004.Description: A beaker for flinging chemicals in combat. Held in the main hand.
item_51004.Name: Acid Beaker

item_51005.Description: A beaker for flinging chemicals in combat. Held in the main hand.
item_51005.Name: Splash Beaker

item_51006.Description: This beaker has been carefully constructed to keep healing chemicals at a lower temperature, slightly improving their effects. Held in the main hand.
item_51006.Name: Recuperative Beaker

item_51007.Description: This beaker is one of Xegatis' early failed attempts at restoring flesh to Nightmare Creatures. A crude Necromancy Gem is embedded in the bottom.
item_51007.Name: Beaker of Xegatis

item_51008.Description: The story goes that a crazed elf spent a hundred years splashing himself with different acid beakers to find the one that hurt the most. This is that beaker.
item_51008.Name: Maiming Beaker

item_51009.Description: This old beaker is perfectly shaped for gulping down quick-brewed healing concoctions.
item_51009.Name: Chugging Beaker

item_51010.Description: Good for flinging small amounts of chemicals all around you. Held in the main hand.
item_51010.Name: Basic Combat Beaker

item_51011.Description: Good for flinging small amounts of chemicals all around you. Held in the off hand.
item_51011.Name: Basic Combat Flask

item_51012.Description: A flask for flinging chemicals in combat. Held in the off hand.
item_51012.Name: Acid Flask

item_51013.Description: A flask for flinging chemicals in combat. Held in the off hand.
item_51013.Name: Splash Flask

item_51014.Description: This flask has been carefully constructed to keep healing chemicals at a lower temperature, slightly improving their effects. Held in the off hand.
item_51014.Name: Recuperative Flask

item_51015.Description: The great alchemists of yore supposedly used flasks like this when they fought in wars. Or perhaps that's just a tale invented to sell flasks.
item_51015.Name: War Flask

item_51016.Description: This old flask is perfectly shaped for gulping down quick-brewed healing concoctions.
item_51016.Name: Chugging Flask

item_51017.Description: Good for flinging small amounts of chemicals all around you. Held in the off hand.
item_51017.Name: Basic Combat Flask

item_51018.Description: While dwarves are mostly known for brewing alcohol, those same techniques can also be used to brew potent offensive chemicals.
item_51018.Name: Dwarven Brewer Flask

item_51019.Description: The creator of this beaker designed it around what he thought dwarves would use in combat. He was utterly wrong in every way, but the beaker is still pretty powerful.
item_51019.Name: Dwarf-Inspired Beaker

item_51020.Description: A beaker for exploding stuff. Held in the main hand.
item_51020.Name: Bombing Beaker

item_51021.Description: This cunningly made flask is slightly askew, causing chemicals to spray everywhere. Only experts can hope to use it in combat.
item_51021.Name: Lopsided Flask

item_51022.Description: The sneaky crone Anhinda made this flask after decades of trial and error.
item_51022.Name: Anhinda's Flask

item_51023.Description: Not great for splashing people, but pretty good for delivering healing concoctions.
item_51023.Name: Spillproof Flask

item_51024.Description: Shaped like a snake for some reason.
item_51024.Name: Serpent Flask

item_51025.Description: An ordinary-looking glass flask that's cold to the touch, even in hot environments.
item_51025.Name: Flask of Chills

item_51026.Description: The invention of a rakshasa alchemist who loved her pet. This flask's magic helps to alert pets when their owner is in danger.
item_51026.Name: Rathla's Flask

item_51027.Description: Some aberrant chemical reaction has burned off most of the crimson, but it's otherwise in good shape.
item_51027.Name: Crimson Flask

item_51028.Description: Used by the migrant house-builders that until recently found work in Povus. While it can be used as a weapon, its primary purpose was to store powerful drink.
item_51028.Name: Builder's Flask

item_51029.Description: This strange beaker constantly drips sugar-water. It has an inscription: "Keep those bees buzzin' and those birds flying high! - Galdyr"
item_51029.Name: Galdyr's Tasty Energy Flask

item_5106.Description: A raw fish. So-called because of its vaguely bluish skin, the grapefish is actually fairly bland.
item_5106.Name: Grapefish

item_51061.Description: A beaker full of a very, very stinky substance.
item_51061.Name: Fish Beaker

item_51062.Description: It has a splash-lip as well as a drinking lip, as if you'd be so foolish as to drink potions out of the same beaker you splash acids from!
item_51062.Name: Multipurpose Beaker

item_51063.Description: A mage's staff with a splash-beaker at the top, perfect for blasting and splashing at the same time.
item_51063.Name: Tricky Sage Beaker

item_51064.Description: This beaker has been coated in many layers of deadly chemicals. Wash your hands after touching it!
item_51064.Name: Tolmar's Beaker

item_51065.Description: A potent chemistry tool -- or weapon. Yeah, let's go with weapon.
item_51065.Name: Jar of Explosions

item_51066.Description: After barely losing the annual Statehelm archery contest, Tamoko gained fame when he returned the following year and used his newly-invented beaker to win the grand prize. The beaker design has since been replicated with his blessing, delighting archery fans but causing a terrible schism in the archery-contest establishment, many of whom consider battle chemistry to be "like cheating".
item_51066.Name: Tamoko's Beaker

item_51067.Description: Made of utterly unbreakable glass mined from the heart of a dying star, this is no measuring tool: it is a deadly weapon of war! (Because the measurement marks rubbed off long ago.)
item_51067.Name: Beaker of Formless Toxin

item_51068.Description: This enchanted beaker has been adorned with pieces of glass in a geometric pattern. It is a little unwieldy as a result.
item_51068.Name: Bedazzled Beaker

item_51069.Description: Designed by Povus's former master alchemist, Kimeta, and sold to Statehelm in large quantity.
item_51069.Name: "Povus Special" Beaker

item_5107.Description: A raw fish. Found in caves throughout the world, these blind fish are normally tiny, but can grow to surprising size in nature-magic-rich environments.
item_5107.Name: Cavefish

item_51070.Description: A seemingly frozen beaker that enables a strange influence over the weather.
item_51070.Name: Fluke's Frozen Beaker

item_51071.Description: This long-handled beaker has been coated in many layers of deadly chemicals. Wash your hands after touching it!
item_51071.Name: Tolmar's Beaker

item_5108.Description: A raw fish. Also known as Orcish Labyrinth Fish, these fish are surprisingly tasty when correctly prepared, but should not be eaten raw.
item_5108.Name: Green Vexfish

item_5109.Description: A raw fish. These strange fish originate in the distant continent of Fosulf. They require expert handling before they can be eaten safely, and few fishermen in Alharth know the technique.
item_5109.Name: Lungfish

item_5110.Description: A raw fish. These hideous creatures are surprisingly tasty.
item_5110.Name: Flounder

item_51101.Description: Enchanted to accelerate tossed liquids, this off-hand tool is perfect for chemistry-based fighting.
item_51101.Name: Quality Battle Flask

item_51102.Description: Enchanted to accelerate tossed liquids, this off-hand tool is perfect for chemistry-based fighting.
item_51102.Name: Great Battle Flask

item_51103.Description: Enchanted to accelerate tossed liquids, this off-hand tool is perfect for chemistry-based fighting.
item_51103.Name: Amazing Battle Flask

item_51104.Description: Enchanted to accelerate tossed liquids, this off-hand tool is perfect for chemistry-based fighting.
item_51104.Name: Astounding Battle Flask

item_51105.Description: Enchanted to accelerate tossed liquids, this off-hand tool is perfect for chemistry-based fighting.
item_51105.Name: Awesome Battle Flask

item_51106.Description: Enchanted to accelerate tossed liquids, this off-hand tool is perfect for chemistry-based fighting.
item_51106.Name: Incredible Battle Flask

item_51107.Description: Enchanted to accelerate tossed liquids, this off-hand tool is perfect for chemistry-based fighting.
item_51107.Name: Incomprehensible Battle Flask

item_5111.Description: A raw fish. Also called a yellowfin, these mid-sized ocean fish are delicious.
item_5111.Name: Amberjack

item_5112.Description: A raw hideous blood-sucking parasite fish.
item_5112.Name: Lamprey

item_5113.Description: A lump of gummy meat. It's supposedly edible, but only expert gourmands can stomach its squishy grossness.
item_5113.Name: Raw Oyster

item_5114.Description: A big raw shrimp. It needs to be de-veined and cleaned before eating.
item_5114.Name: Shrimp

item_5117.Description: Too small to be filleted, but still useful as bait.
item_5117.Name: Minnow

item_5165.Description: Eggs from a small fish. Crunchy.
item_5165.Name: Lumpfish Roe

item_5166.Description: Eggs from a salmon or similar fish. Savory.
item_5166.Name: Ikura

item_5167.Description: Exotic fish eggs. Tiny and crunchy. Often used in sushi preparation.
item_5167.Name: Tobiko

item_5168.Description: Eggs from a sturgeon or similar fish. Creamy.
item_5168.Name: Caviar

item_52.Description: Test potion transforms you into a pig. Permanent until dispelled! WARNING: think before you drink!
item_52.Name: Pig Juice

item_52001.Description: Once a fine weapon, this bow has been mistreated for a very long time. It still shoots arrows, though.
item_52001.Name: Old Worn Bow

item_52002.Description: A mass-produced longbow made for infantrymen to use in a bind. Nothing special.
item_52002.Name: Stock Bow

item_52003.Description: An Elven bow made by someone with a lot of time on their hands. (An Elf, in other words.)
item_52003.Name: Hunting Bow

item_52004.Description: An Elven bow that's been enhanced with Goblin magic.
item_52004.Name: Goblinized Bow

item_52005.Description: Although technically Orcish, these bows are made by Dwarven conscripts.
item_52005.Name: Un-Tal Bow

item_52006.Description: Hand-made by a bored bowyer of middling skill.
item_52006.Name: Basic Bow

item_52007.Description: Apparently once used by Lawara, an elf you met in on an island. It's high-quality, and has a custom hand plate that provides a bit of shielding.
item_52007.Name: Lawara's Bow

item_52008.Description: Tremor the Myconian took this bow from a pesky elf. Myconians can't use bows, but Tremor liked plucking the string to make a 'twang' sound. It really irritated other myconians, and Tremor liked that.
item_52008.Name: Tremor's Bow

item_52009.Description: Practically oozing with enchantment, this masterpiece is rarely seen outside of Elven lands.
item_52009.Name: Elven Master Bow

item_5201.Description: A cleaned fish, ready for cooking.
item_5201.Name: Clownfish Fillet

item_52010.Description: Dwarves aren't really great at making bows with decent range. But this bow is very sturdy!
item_52010.Name: Dwarven Bashbow

item_52011.Description: A light bow designed for precision over power.
item_52011.Name: Eltibule Bow

item_52012.Description: Crafted by goblin slaves under the watchful eye of Gyrumpa, the legendary bowyer. He hated fun, and made sure his bows were especially taxing to use.
item_52012.Name: Goblinic Piercer

item_52013.Description: Tremor the Myconian took this bow from a pesky elf. Myconians can't use bows, but Tremor liked plucking the string to make a 'twang' sound. It really irritated other myconians, and Tremor liked that.
item_52013.Name: Tremor's Enhanced Bow

item_52014.Description: The Stalwarts, like all dwarves, had to work hard overcome their prejudice against ranged weapons. They developed this bludgeoning bow which acknowledges the value of archery while still insisting that hammers are better.
item_52014.Name: Stalwart Bow

item_52015.Description: A rakshasa craftsman named Malgath once used this to demonstrate his skill at crafting.
item_52015.Name: Malgath's Demo Bow

item_52016.Description: A longbow optimized for long-distance targets.
item_52016.Name: Bow of Range

item_52017.Description: A longbow optimized for quick shots.
item_52017.Name: Fastbow

item_52018.Description: A fairly-new item made in the Rakshasa manner, but probably not by a Rakshasa. Still not terrible.
item_52018.Name: Replica Rakshasa Bow

item_52019.Description: A competent and accurate weapon made by the elves of Sedgewick Forest.
item_52019.Name: Thentree Bow

item_5202.Description: A cleaned fish, ready for cooking.
item_5202.Name: Perch Fillet

item_52020.Description: A scarred and twisted bow, barely able to be strung. A hum of darkness can be felt from within. A tiny necromancy gem is embedded in the top.
item_52020.Name: Blackened Bow

item_52021.Description: These lightweight bows aren't actually used by the Peltasts of the Crone Hegemony, but by their support archers.
item_52021.Name: Peltast Bow

item_52022.Description: An Elven bow that's been enhanced with shoddy Goblin magic.
item_52022.Name: Cheap Goblinized Bow

item_52023.Description: A standard bow design used by orcish archers throughout the world. It's resilient yet accurate.
item_52023.Name: Orcish Military Bow

item_52024.Description: A bow designed to channel lightning. And also arrows.
item_52024.Name: Shockbow

item_52025.Description: This thick-handled bow gives tiny psychic cues to the owner, helping it aim perfectly. Some inherently psychic individuals can further take advantage of this mental amplification.
item_52025.Name: Prescient Bow

item_52026.Description: Commissioned by Arianna Fangblade for a close personal friend.
item_52026.Name: Fangblade Jr.

item_52027.Description: A deadly masterpiece that has been disguised to look like a simple sapling bow.
item_52027.Name: Fairy Bow

item_52028.Description: An otherworldly device that can fire energy projectiles. It can also fire regular arrows.
EffectDescs: Equipping this allows you to use the abilities "Blitz Shot 9 (Energy Bow)" and "Aimed Shot 7 (Energy Bow)", assuming you already know and meet the requirements for the non-energy versions of those abilities.
item_52028.Name: Floxie's Faebow

item_52029.Description: A simple bow that can pack a lot of punch for its size.
item_52029.Name: Quality Bow

item_52032.Description: Clearly of Elven design, and unlikely to have been made in Povus. But Statehelm bought thousands of them, just the same.
item_52032.Name: "Povus Special" Bow

item_52033.Description: An Elven bow that's been enhanced with Goblin magic and lots of sharp bits.
item_52033.Name: Ultragoblinized Bow

item_52034.Description: The bow given to Tamoko for his contributions to the townfolk.
item_52034.Name: Tamoko's Bow of Compassion

item_52035.Description: Used in the first annual Gazluk Archery Competition by the titular Black Agatha, who assassinated the rightful winner with it.
item_52035.Name: Black Agatha's Bull's-eye Bow

item_52036.Description: A classic elven-style bow with magic to enhance distance.
item_52036.Name: Far Biter

item_52037.Description: Tremor the Myconian took this bow from a pesky elf. Myconians can't use bows, but Tremor liked plucking the string to make a 'twang' sound. It really irritated other myconians, and Tremor liked that.
item_52037.Name: Tremor's Enhanced Bow

item_52038.Description: An otherworldly device that can fire energy projectiles. It can also fire regular arrows.

item_52038.Name: Awesome Faebow

item_52039.Description: A bow designed by Denton Razor using a secret bowyery technique. It's surprisingly heavy for such a sleek weapon.

item_52602.Description: A simple crossbow with nothing fancy about it.
item_52602.Name: Stock Crossbow

item_52603.Description: A simple crossbow with nothing fancy about it.
item_52603.Name: Stock Crossbow

item_52604.Description: Designed for use by orcish healers, this crossbow comes equipped with a vicious blade for self-defense and a series of holy symbols to allow healing.
item_52604.Name: Cutting Crossbow

item_52605.Description: This mean-looking weapon has a necromancy gem embedded in it.
item_52605.Name: Dark Crossbow

item_52606.Description: The two bolt grooves on this crossbow allow for somewhat-faster firing, but it's hardly "speedy".
item_52606.Name: Speed Crossbow

item_52607.Description: This unassuming-looking weapon hides a series of fire runes on the inside of the flight groove.
item_52607.Name: Crossbow of Flames

item_52608.Description: This crossbow is not actually demonic; it's just designed to look intimidating. The embedded necromancy gem was probably not intended for actual use, but it does work.
item_52608.Name: Demonic Crossbow

item_52609.Description: A simple but robust crossbow that handles well and can be easily restrung.
item_52609.Name: Hunter's Crossbow

item_5261.Description: A cleaned fish, ready for cooking.
item_5261.Name: Striped Bass Fillet

item_52610.Description: An over-engineered dwarven weapon. It requires a lot of maintenance, but most users find the accelerated reload-time worth it.
item_52610.Name: Double Crossbow

item_52611.Description: This seems like a simple evil crossbow, but in actuality is far more complex, with bizarre otherworldly magic.
EffectDescs: Equipping this allows you to use the ability "Shoot Darkness Bolt", assuming you already know and meet the requirements for Shoot Crossbow 9.
item_52611.Name: Darkcaster

item_52612.Description: One of the few "Povus Special" weapons actually made in Povus. It has classic Deftwhisper styling.
item_52612.Name: "Povus Special" Crossbow

item_52613.Description: An antique style of dwarven crossbow, discontinued due to a tendency to explode while loaded. But this one seems fine.
item_52613.Name: Spring-Loaded Crossbow

item_52614.Description: A masterpiece dwarven crossbow further augmented by goblin mechanists. "A kiss from this rose leads to the grave" is engraved on the side.
item_52614.Name: Black Rose

item_5262.Name: Eagle Ray Fillet

item_53001.Description: Made by an amateur, this punching weapon barely fits onto your hand. But sometimes an ugly, stupid-looking weapon can inspire more fear than a good weapon. Not really. But keep thinking that while you wear these.
item_53001.Name: Shoddy Brass Knuckles

item_53002.Description: They've turned all green and gross. But they'll still work to make your punches more painful.
item_53002.Name: Corroded Brass Knuckles

item_53003.Description: These fit over your knuckles to make your punches hurt more. Now with real faux-brass coating!
item_53003.Name: Basic Brass Knuckles

item_53004.Description: Designed to fit over leather gloves, these brass knuckles have nasty bumps to make your punches cause extra injury.
item_53004.Name: Protruding Knuckles

item_53005.Description: It's sturdy, but it's so simple that it'd be hard not to be sturdy. But it's not false advertising, anyway.
item_53005.Name: Sturdy Cestus

item_53006.Description: This simple fist weapon was fitted for a goblin's hand, but you can make it work. (Cestuses count as an empty hand for purposes of Unarmed attacks.)
item_53006.Name: Goblin Cestus

item_53007.Description: This simple fist weapon will make your punches hurt more.
item_53007.Name: Quality Cestus

item_53008.Description: This simple fist weapon will make your punches hurt more.
item_53008.Name: Quality Cestus

item_53009.Description: Preferred by orcish martial artists, this black-iron fist weapon is intimidatingly heavy in the hand.
item_53009.Name: Orcish Katar

item_53011.Description: This grim fist weapon was clearly inspired by the Human legend of the Green Man, a druid who supposedly wanders the forests and punches wayward teens to death if they're out past curfew.
item_53011.Name: Fist of the Green Man

item_53012.Description: It was found in the gut of a giant spider. That's really the only spider-related thing going on here.
item_53012.Name: Spider Cestus

item_53013.Description: The preferred punching thingy of elven bullies.
item_53013.Name: Elven Cestus

item_53014.Description: It's a bit cramped for larger races, but this Dwarven unarmed weapon feels impressively heavy.
item_53014.Name: Dwarven Pugilfist

item_53015.Description: A piece of arm machinery from a large ancient golem.
item_53015.Name: Golem Fist

item_53016.Description: This punching weapon has a little mechanical serpent head on it which can be used to inject poison deep into a target.
item_53016.Name: Serpent Sting

item_53017.Description: This is just a piece of metal, but it's been covered in strange substances that help protect the hand of the puncher.
item_53017.Name: Yeti Knuckleduster

item_53018.Description: Someone has carved a fist weapon out of glasstone, a rock known for its supernatural lightness. The glasstone market is in shambles now that glasstone jewelry has fallen out of fashion among humans, so new uses are becoming affordable.
item_53018.Name: Glasstone Fist

item_53020.Description: This strangely-weighted punching weapon requires skill to use, but is quite deadly in the right hand.
item_53020.Name: Pounding Cestus

item_53021.Description: The creepy orcish mages known as Mutterers sometimes use weapons like this, designed to bleed the enemy.
item_53021.Name: Mutterer's Katar

item_53022.Description: A piece of arm machinery from a large ancient golem.
item_53022.Name: War Golem Fist

item_53023.Description: Designed by blacksmith-in-hiding Torgan, this weapon was weighted by a master. It requires quite a strong arm, though.
item_53023.Name: Torgan's Katar

item_53024.Description: A weapon made by ratkin martial artists. Ratkins are renowned for their use of poison.
item_53024.Name: Ratkin Katar

item_53025.Description: The weighting of this weapon is awkward for non-fairies, but it works after you get used to it.
item_53025.Name: Fairy Cestus

item_53026.Description: Used by ranalon martial artists to great effect.
item_53026.Name: Frog Punch

item_53027.Description: A tool used by rakshasa housebuilders, who like to hammer nails with their fists. This one has been cleaned up and enchanted.
item_53027.Name: Hammer Hand

item_53028.Description: This fist-shaped thing was found embedded in a particularly ornery myconian.
item_53028.Name: Gue's Remnant

item_53029.Description: Designed (but never used) by the slightly-mad gadgeteer Tamiq. It uses a series of magically-powered cascading motors to augment the punching power.
item_53029.Name: Tamiq's Automated Puncherfist

item_53030.Description: A piece of arm machinery from a large ancient golem.
item_53030.Name: Golem Fist

item_5306.Description: This head of broccoli looks a lot like a little green tree.
item_5306.Name: Broccoli

item_5307.Description: Orange and pointy. Yup, it's a carrot.
item_5307.Name: Carrot

item_5308.Description: A useful spice for cooking. It has an aromatic, warm and slightly bitter taste.
item_5308.Name: Oregano

item_5310.Description: A big bunch of purple grapes.
item_5310.Name: Grapes

item_5313.Description: This banana is in good shape - no brown spots yet.
item_5313.Name: Banana

item_5315.Description: A nice round gourd full of mushy stuff.
item_5315.Name: Pumpkin

item_5320.Description: A bunch of fresh barley grass.
item_5320.Name: Barley

item_5321.Description: A bunch of sugarcane stalks. Sugarcane can be cooked into molasses and sugar.
item_5321.Name: Sugarcane

item_5322.Description: Not really berries at all, these are actually seed cones with some bitter mushy stuff on the end. Useful as a spice and flavoring in brewing.
item_5322.Name: Juniper Berries

item_5323.Description: A fresh uncooked ear of corn. Corn is a bit of a delicacy in the Council Lands, although it's extremely common elsewhere.
item_5323.Name: Corn

item_5324.Description: Tart and sweet. A delicacy to some, but not as versatile for cooking as red apples.
item_5324.Name: Green Apple

item_5325.Description: Fruit from a strange plant that grows in the fae realm. While delicious, sprigganberries are incredibly poisonous unless the tiny seeds are carefully removed.
EffectDescs: Food Poisoning: Heavy poison damage over time masks beneficial effect
item_5325.Name: Sprigganberries

item_5327.Description: A strong but pleasant-smelling herb used in cooking.
item_5327.Name: Basil

item_5329.Description: Fresh green peas, ready for cooking.
item_5329.Name: Peas

item_5330.Description: Some fresh cranberries. Too bitter to be eaten raw, but useful in cooking.
item_5330.Name: Cranberries

item_5331.Description: A large gourd full of sticky bitter mush.
item_5331.Name: Swamp Gourd

item_5332.Description: Wheat with a finer quality, preferred over Human wheat for certain dishes.
item_5332.Name: Orcish Wheat

item_5333.Description: A watery fruit from the distant crone lands.
item_5333.Name: Tomato

item_5334.Description: Made from orcish wheat. This has a notably superior taste to human wheat flour, and is preferred for high-end baked goods.
item_5334.Name: Orcish Flour

item_5335.Description: This bioluminescent fruit smells like death, but has a pleasant mild taste.
item_5335.Name: Evu Fruit

item_5336.Description: This is basically inedible. It has limited alchemical uses.
item_5336.Name: Horse Apple

item_5338.Description: A big bunch of semisweet mulberries.
item_5338.Name: Mulberries

item_5339.Description: A chewy, hearty grain that can be milled into chewy, hearty flour.
item_5339.Name: Tundra Rye

item_5340.Description: Tundra rye that's been milled into a bakable flour.
item_5340.Name: Rye Flour

item_5341.Description: Corn ground into meal. It's useful for cooking in this form.
item_5341.Name: Cornmeal

item_5343.Description: An unpleasant-tasting but nutritionally dense substance.
item_5343.Name: Ground Flaxseed

item_5344.Description: Gross little seeds from a weed. They can't be grown, but can be ground into an edible form.
item_5344.Name: Chia Seeds

item_5345.Description: An unpleasant-tasting but nutritionally dense substance.
item_5345.Name: Ground Chia Seeds

item_5346.Name: Oat Groats

item_5347.Description: Oats ground into a powder, ready for cooking.
item_5347.Name: Oat Flour

item_5348.Description: Slightly magical spelt grown at night. Most useful when ground into flour.

item_5349.Description: Moonspelt ground into flour for cooking.
item_5349.Name: Moonspelt Flour

item_53501.Description: Some bones strapped to a handle make this off-hand martial weapon look as stupid as it feels.
item_53501.Name: Shoddy Fighting Claw

item_53502.Description: Sharpened bone "blades" protrude from this off-hand martial weapon. It's silly looking, but dangerous!
item_53502.Name: Primitive Fighting Claw

item_53503.Description: This martial artist's glove is adorned with small sharpened metal protrusions. It smells like soup.
item_53503.Name: Goblin Claw

item_53504.Description: Fashionable, but a little uncomfortable to wear unless you're a Rakshasa.
item_53504.Name: Sturdy Claw

item_53505.Description: A skilled metalsmith put this left-handed fighting claw together. It's a little uncomfortable to wear, though.
item_53505.Name: Quality Claw

item_53506.Name: Quality Claw

item_53508.Name: Basic War Claw

item_53509.Description: When the Council demanded that the Rakshasa provide renumeration for every human that was injured at the Battle of Rahu, outraged Rakshasa tore up the treaty and killed the messengers, leading to the Sand War. The Rakshasa won the war with claws like this, fashioned after weapons from their home world.
item_53509.Name: Sand War Claw

item_53510.Description: Made of Cold Iron, this weapon is used in fae civil wars. Fairies who wield it are in constant pain from the metal... but not as much pain as their victims.
item_53510.Name: Fae Claw

item_53512.Description: Few of the legendary Dwarven Stalwarts used unarmed weapons, but the ones that did wore claws like this.
item_53512.Name: Stalwart Claw

item_53513.Description: The Rakshasa outcasts in the Ilmari Desert enchant these claws with life-saving protection from the desert elements.
item_53513.Name: Resistant Claw

item_53514.Description: A claw enchanted specifically for making horrible scars.
item_53514.Name: Torturer's Claw

item_53515.Description: A claw tailored specifically for the Claw Barrage maneuver.
item_53515.Name: Claw-Barrager

item_53516.Description: A claw with ugly tassels dangling from it. Being hit by this stupid-looking weapon is especially infuriating.
item_53516.Name: Ridiculer's Claw

item_53517.Description: Another public-relations disaster by the famous Veilmoor clan of human smiths, these claws are each imbued with the soul of a kitten who would otherwise have been euthanized. While it's not technically illegal to use such small souls in enchanting, the 'save the kittens forever' campaign was not appreciated by the weapon-buying public. But as is typical with Veilmoor products, the weapon is so good that nothing else matters too much.
item_53517.Name: Tragic Kitten Claw

item_53518.Description: Carefully designed to avoid hurting you while sprinting.
item_53518.Name: Running Claw

item_53519.Description: Designed by blacksmith-in-hiding Torgan, this wicked weapon features hooked talons to rip into flesh.
item_53519.Name: Torgan's Claw
