item_6009.Description: Boiled cabbage with salt and butter to taste. Not as bad as it sounds!
item_6009.Name: Boiled Cabbage

item_6010.Description: Voted the most under-rated vegetable dish by 4 out of 5 elven gourmands.
item_6010.Name: Baked Beets

item_6012.Description: A heaping head of broccoli with the *perfect* amount of salt and butter.
item_6012.Name: Broccoli Florets

item_6014.Description: Stuffed with what? Venison, of course!
item_6014.Name: Stuffed Squash

item_6015.Description: This muffin might sound strange but it is actually quite sweet. Disgusting, but sweet.
item_6015.Name: Guava Beet Muffin

item_6017.Description: Apples and strawberries in sweet syrup. A little monotonous.
item_6017.Name: Boring Fruit Cocktail

item_6018.Description: Apples, strawberries, grapes and oranges in sweet syrup.
item_6018.Name: Fruit Cocktail

item_6019.Description: Apples, grapes, oranges and guava in sweet syrup. Who puts guava in fruit cocktail?
item_6019.Name: Weird Fruit Cocktail

item_6020.Description: A loaf of warm, moist banana bread.
item_6020.Name: Banana Bread

item_6022.Description: Unlike most food, this does not give a long-term regeneration effect. Bacon is an instant pick-me-up any time!
item_6022.Name: Bacon

item_6023.Description: Tough and dry, but good for gnawing. This provides a quick instant pick-me-up.
item_6023.Name: Venison Jerky

item_6025.Description: Just like roast beef - except not.
item_6025.Name: Venison Roast

item_6026.Description: Tasty pork and venison sausage. Just don't ask to see how it's made ...
item_6026.Name: Sausage

item_6029.Description: There are worse things to stuff in a mushroom than meat from a mantis claw. Probably.
item_6029.Name: Mantis-Stuffed Mushroom

item_6030.Description: A perfectly edible fish dish, if a bit uninspired.
item_6030.Name: Fried Clownfish

item_6031.Description: Tasty fish sticks with the heartburny flavor of fried onions.
item_6031.Name: Breaded Perch with Onions

item_6033.Description: These leftover bits of a Super Fishy Surprise have been mixed together to get an ... "interesting" and "unusual" flavor.
item_6033.Name: Bonus Fishy Surprise

item_6034.Description: Boiled crab meat. Butter is optional.
item_6034.Name: Boiled Crab

item_6037.Description: A seasoned shark steak with a wood-fired sweet smoky flavor.
item_6037.Name: Maple-Smoked Shark

item_6038.Description: Smoked perch with a sweet orange glaze.
item_6038.Name: Orange Perch

item_6039.Description: Three skewers of seafood and vegetables.
item_6039.Name: Shark and Crab Kebabs

item_6040.Description: A baked potato with delicious melted cheese.
item_6040.Name: Cheesy Baked Potato

item_6041.Description: A baked potato topped with fresh butter.
item_6041.Name: Buttered Baked Potato

item_6042.Description: Baked beets in a succulent, simple glaze.
item_6042.Name: Glazed Beets

item_6043.Description: Thin, runny, and smelly. Mmm! Salt is a key ingredient.
item_6043.Name: Cabbage Soup

item_6044.Description: Choice parts of a pig infused with ancient spirits of evil. An instant pick-me-up! Warning: if Ur-Bacon speaks to you, do not speak back. Never follow instructions you receive from evil food of any kind.
item_6044.Name: Ur-Bacon

item_6046.Description: A bowl of oats and milk. Warm and bland. You should eat a bowl immediately! Food boosts your health and power regeneration rates, and makes combat much easier.
item_6046.Name: Plain Porridge

item_6048.Description: Comes with its own handle! An instant fill-up for the not-particularly-discerning bar patron.
item_6048.Name: Chicken Drumstick

item_6050.Description: Stir-fried chicken with broccoli and other vegetables.
item_6050.Name: Chicken and Broccoli

item_6051.Description: Baked with a delicate lemon glaze. Delicious!
item_6051.Name: Lemon-Glazed Chicken

item_6052.Description: Baked chicken in a complex dish. This one was cooked just right and has a variety of textures.
item_6052.Name: Chicken Casserole

item_6053.Description: A disgusting concoction created by someone who doesn't understand certain important concepts.
item_6053.Name: Beginner's Buttermilk

item_6054.Description:
Some damp biscuits. Not appetizing, but much better than starving!

(For an hour after you eat food, you'll regenerate health and power between fights. And better food than this can regenerate you DURING combat, too!)
item_6054.Name: Hardtack

item_6055.Description: An odorous dish said to be palatable to psychic mantises.
item_6055.Name: Venison Psi-Mantis Style

item_6056.Description: It smells bad, but... it doesn't taste too bad, actually.
item_6056.Name: Chicken Psi-Mantis Style

item_6057.Description: An improvement over basic hash browns. Greasy and salty, in a good way!
item_6057.Name: Venison Hash

item_6059.Description: A baked potato that has been rotated at a perfect consistency for hours. As far as plain ungarnished potatoes go, this is great...
item_6059.Name: Perfectly Baked Potato

item_6060.Description: Small dried vegetable chunks, magically puffed with air and then filled with sugar and cheese. It's... interesting.
item_6060.Name: Fairy Puffs

item_6061.Description: This poisonous muffin smells of wood and herbs. It can be used as a test for lycanthropy, as the muffins tend to kill werewolves, while only maiming others.
item_6061.Name: Wolfsbane Muffin

item_6062.Description: A delicious treat: a banana shallow-fried in sugary butter.
item_6062.Name: Fried Banana

item_6063.Description: A deceptively simple dish of beets, fish, and meat, somehow made tasty together.
item_6063.Name: Beets 'n Meats

item_6064.Description: A blend of baked vegetables in a hearty cheese sauce.
item_6064.Name: Cheesy Veggie Delight

item_6065.Description: Laura's Neth's melt-in-your-mouth cheese biscuits are to die for.
item_6065.Name: Laura's Cheese Biscuits

item_6066.Description: They may look like a light snack at first glance, but these biscuits are meaty and filling enough for a hearty meal.
item_6066.Name: Laura's Crab Biscuits

item_6068.Description: An orcish staple, famous for its lingering effect. It's... an acquired taste.
item_6068.Name: Black Soup

item_6069.Description: A very potent Elvish brew. Bitter as can be, but it warms you right up.
item_6069.Name: Bitter-Mint Tea

item_6071.Description: Unleavened bread. Not super tasty by itself, but good in sandwiches.
item_6071.Name: Flatbread

item_6072.Description: Tasty crabmeat in a makeshift bun. Lemony!
item_6072.Name: Crab Roll

item_6073.Description: Made with whatever meat is available and seasoned within an inch of its life. Most races find the smell pleasant, but the taste much too salty.
item_6073.Name: Goblin Stew

item_6074.Description: A mushy fruit paste that can be eaten as a snack.
item_6074.Name: Guava Bowl

item_6075.Description: A true masterpiece of potato-making. Well, actually, the potato itself is a little soggy. But the toppings are masterful!
item_6075.Name: Loaded Baked Potato

item_6076.Description: A tasty baked dish with mutton and veggies.
item_6076.Name: Shepherd's Pie

item_6077.Description: A tasty baked dish with beef and veggies.
item_6077.Name: Cottage Pie

item_6078.Description: A pleasant baked dish with odds and ends.
item_6078.Name: Peasant's Pie

item_6079.Description: Dried meat from unusual creatures. Salted beyond reckoning.
item_6079.Name: Mystery Jerky

item_6080.Description: Warm crusty bread, perfect for a cold day.
item_6080.Name: Snacking Bread

item_6081.Description: Cured pig meat with a touch of sugar and a hint of cloves.
item_6081.Name: Juicy Ham

item_6082.Description: A cup of heated mushroom blend with a pinch of spices.
item_6082.Name: Myconutmeg

item_6090.Description: A delicious, if basic, pumpkin pie. It's missing fancy spices! And maybe something to top it with.
item_6090.Name: Basic Pumpkin Pie

item_6092.Description: Gretchen Salas has a way with a potato. These rolls are really good! You can't even taste the potato.
item_6092.Name: Gretchen's Potato Rolls

item_6093.Description: An elvish drink. Not quite tea, and not quite fruit juice, but something in between.
item_6093.Name: Leafwater

item_6094.Description: An elvish invention. A single fist-sized cube of this will keep you from being hungry all day. It tastes like fruitcake.
item_6094.Name: Lembas Brick

item_6095.Description: A bell pepper full of steak! Mm. Meaty.
item_6095.Name: Stuffed Bell Pepper

item_6096.Description: A stir-fried vegetarian dish with more than a hint of spice.
item_6096.Name: Vegetable Masterpiece

item_6097.Description: Supposedly a favorite of mountain-dwelling orcs. Fresh mutton topped with cheese and peppers.
item_6097.Name: Mountain Mutton

item_6098.Description: A tough but highly portable snack consisting of chewy shark meat in a fried pepper husk. It's an acquired taste.
item_6098.Name: Shark Chew

item_6099.Description: A heady mixture of edible mushrooms in a green pepper "bowl".
item_6099.Name: Shroom Feast

item_61.Description: Dear player, thank you for completing this quest. If this were a complete MMO, you would have received a fun reward now. Maybe next time! - Eric
item_61.Name: I.O.U. Quest Reward

item_6100.Description: An advanced preparation of the humble bird. Delicious!
item_6100.Name: Aromatic Chicken

item_61001.Description: Some plain scissors, for cutting hair.
item_61001.Name: Shears

item_6101.Description: A very spicy version of Aromatic Chicken. Not for the faint of heart.
item_6101.Name: Spicy Chicken

item_6102.Description: A stew which is definitely better than the sum of its ingredients.
item_6102.Name: Basic Pepperpot

item_6103.Description: An exotic meal that uses a rare fish found only in the deepest of caves. The fish is delicious, but has a slightly bitter aftertaste that has to be drowned out by tons of lemon.
item_6103.Name: Spicy Cavefish

item_6104.Description: A bizarre snack that uses a rare fish found only in the deepest of caves. You eat it scales and all. It takes some getting used to.
item_6104.Name: Cavefish Sticks

item_6106.Description: The perfect refreshment after desert exertion.
item_6106.Name: Chuma's Agave Secret

item_6107.Description: An unusual tea with a strong kick.
item_6107.Name: Desert Tea

item_6108.Description: This drink has a not-too-great flavor, but it's very good at rehydrating tired bodies. The preferred desert beverage of people who are too rich to drink water.
item_6108.Name: Hydration Punch

item_6109.Description: Venison fried in butter and coated in fresh-cracked pepper. A restorative treat!
item_6109.Name: Pepper Venison

item_6110.Description: A delicious snack food. It's ... some sort of meat... drenched in a sweet sauce and wrapped in dough. Selaxi refuses to part with the recipe.
item_6110.Name: Selaxi's Scorpion Stinger

item_61101.Description: A sheen product for hair that provides a medium sheen.
item_61101.Name: Hair Wax

item_6111.Description: A tasty beverage of cactus juice and some sweet ingredient Selaxi refuses to share.
item_6111.Name: Selaxi's Cactus Mixer

item_6112.Description: An invention of the yeti people, this kabob-like snack is best eaten before you learn the ingredients.
item_6112.Name: Yeti Stick

item_6113.Description: A yeti invention of boiled mutton in matted fur. The stench is impressive. The taste is unique, and not as bad as you'd expect.
item_6113.Name: Furpot

item_6115.Description: A pie so good that it would be foolish to eat it as just a dessert. Eat it as a meal.
item_6115.Name: Fancy Pumpkin Pie

item_6116.Description: Hard on the outside, runny liquid on the inside. Mmm...
item_6116.Name: Soft-Boiled Egg

item_6117.Description: Runny and hot and covered in salt and pepper. Ideal with some bread.
item_6117.Name: Poached Egg

item_6118.Description: This is just some raw eggs in a glass, blended with a little milk. Gross.
item_6118.Name: Raw Egg Blend

item_6119.Description: Somebody wove some long bacon strips into a sort of bowl. And then put chunks of fried meat into the bowl. Weird. Salty.
item_6119.Name: Bacon Basket

item_6120.Description: It's a scrambled egg, beloved breakfast of nearly every sentient race.
item_6120.Name: Scrambled Egg

item_6121.Description: It's... a clownfish. Dried and salted. Snack-sized.
item_6121.Name: Dried Clownfish

item_6123.Description: A well-preserved and salted fish, perfect for snacking.
item_6123.Name: Dried Grapefish

item_6124.Description: A well-preserved and salted fish. This makes an amazing snack!
item_6124.Name: Dried Perch

item_6127.Description: A well-preserved and salted fish. An ... interesting... snack.
item_6127.Name: Dried Cave Fish

item_6128.Description: Low-quality pieces of cat meat have been sliced extraordinarily thin, tenderized, and then buried in salt. The result is a cup of hot stew that tastes ... salty. But not horrible.
item_6128.Name: Cat Stew Cup

item_6129.Description: Cat meat coated in a thick orange sauce. Surprisingly not terrible.
item_6129.Name: Orange Cat

item_6130.Description: The perfect seasonings make cat meat not just palatable, but actually tasty.
item_6130.Name: Spicy Lemon Cat

item_6131.Description: Dried meat and fish in a secret blend of spices.
item_6131.Name: Nishika's Travel Snack

item_6132.Description: Made from the tender tentacles of young kraken, this meal is quite the delicacy.
item_6132.Name: Kraken Calamari

item_6133.Description: It stinks! And it tastes vinegary. But it's... it's edible.
item_6133.Name: Pickled Fish

item_6134.Description: Picked beets in a secret alpha-development sauce. (This item cannot be crafted. It provides benefits equivalent to a level 25 Meal item, but it has no Gourmand requirement. A normal level 25 Meal requires Gourmand level 10+.)
item_6134.Name: Alpha Beets

item_6135.Description: Fried cat-meat in a house blend of spices and lightly breaded.
item_6135.Name: House Cat

item_6136.Description: Shaved ice flavored with apple. This treat should be eaten quickly before it melts!
item_6136.Name: Apple Shaved Ice

item_6137.Description: Shaved ice flavored with strawberries. This treat should be eaten quickly before it melts!
item_6137.Name: Strawberry Shaved Ice

item_6138.Description: Shaved ice flavored with grapes. This treat should be eaten quickly before it melts!
item_6138.Name: Grape Shaved Ice

item_6139.Description: Shaved ice flavored with orange juice. This treat should be eaten quickly before it melts!
item_6139.Name: Orange Shaved Ice

item_6140.Description: Shaved ice flavored with guava. This treat should be eaten quickly before it melts!
item_6140.Name: Guava Shaved Ice

item_6141.Description: Shaved ice flavored with pureed banana. This treat should be eaten quickly before it melts!
item_6141.Name: Banana Shaved Ice

item_6142.Description: Shaved ice flavored with lemon juice. This treat should be eaten quickly before it melts!
item_6142.Name: Lemon Shaved Ice

item_6143.Description: Fresh, cold, and delicious. Eat it before it melts!
item_6143.Name: Mint Ice Cream

item_6144.Description: A well-made omelet is an attractive and delicious meal. This one's full of ham and cheese.
item_6144.Name: Basic Ham Omelet

item_6146.Description: Fresh, cold, and delicious. Eat it before it melts!
item_6146.Name: Strawberry Ice Cream

item_6147.Description: Delicious long-grain rice, as prepared in Rahu.
item_6147.Name: Rahu Rice

item_6148.Description: Raw clownfish on a ball of delicious rice.
item_6148.Name: Clownfish Nigiri

item_6149.Description: Raw crab meat on a ball of delicious rice.
item_6149.Name: Crab Nigiri

item_6150.Description: Raw grapefish on a ball of delicious rice.
item_6150.Name: Grapefish Nigiri

item_6151.Description: Raw perch on a ball of delicious rice.
item_6151.Name: Perch Nigiri

item_6152.Description: Raw eel on a ball of delicious rice.
item_6152.Name: Eel Nigiri

item_6153.Description: Raw cavefish on a ball of delicious rice.
item_6153.Name: Cavefish Nigiri

item_6154.Description: Raw shark on a ball of delicious rice.
item_6154.Name: Shark Nigiri

item_6155.Description: Raw clownfish wrapped in seaweed, on a ball of delicious rice.
item_6155.Name: Clownfish Sushi Roll

item_6156.Description: Raw crab meat wrapped in seaweed, on a ball of delicious rice.
item_6156.Name: Crab Sushi Roll

item_6157.Description: Raw grapefish wrapped in seaweed, on a ball of delicious rice.
item_6157.Name: Grapefish Sushi Roll

item_6158.Description: Raw perch wrapped in seaweed, on a ball of delicious rice.
item_6158.Name: Perch Sushi Roll

item_6159.Description: Raw eel wrapped in seaweed, on a ball of delicious rice.
item_6159.Name: Eel Sushi Roll

item_6160.Description: Raw cavefish wrapped in seaweed, on a ball of delicious rice.
item_6160.Name: Cavefish Sushi Roll

item_6161.Description: Raw shark wrapped in seaweed, on a ball of delicious rice.
item_6161.Name: Shark Sushi Roll

item_6162.Description: An old mini-loaf made to last decades. The outside is as hard as a rock, but the inside is still edible.
item_6162.Name: Hard Roll

item_6165.Description: A tiny tart with cinnamon-pumpkin filling.
item_6165.Name: Laura Neth's Famous Tart

item_6166.Description: Merry Christmas and Happy New Year from the Project: Gorgon team! Thanks for playing and supporting us!
item_6166.Name: Magical Candy Cane

item_6167.Description: Congratulations from the Project: Gorgon team! Thanks for playing and supporting us!
item_6167.Name: Celebratory Cake

item_6168.Description: Raw vexfish on a ball of delicious rice.
item_6168.Name: Green Vexfish Nigiri

item_6169.Description: Tasty raw vexfish wrapped in seaweed, on a ball of delicious rice.
item_6169.Name: Green Vexfish Sushi Roll

item_6170.Description: A stack of orcish breakfast pancakes.
item_6170.Name: Tagenite Stack

item_6172.Description: Eel prepared in the orcish way: coated in cheese.
item_6172.Name: Orcish Eel

item_6173.Description: A fancy plate of snack foods.
item_6173.Name: Orcish Snack Plate

item_6179.Description: Fresh creamy yogurt with strawberries. A sweet snack.
item_6179.Name: Strawberry Yogurt

item_6180.Description: A nice fresh loaf. It's a dense and filling bread.
item_6180.Name: Barley Bread

item_6181.Description: A nice fresh loaf, filled with nuts. It's extremely dense bread and very filling.
item_6181.Name: Vegan Nut Barley Bread

item_6182.Description: A secret variety of rice cultivated in Rahu. Most citizens know it exists, but few know exactly where or how it is made.
item_6182.Name: Secret Rice

item_6184.Description: Apples, strawberries, and grapes in sweet syrup. It's good... but not great.
item_6184.Name: Slightly Sub-Par Fruit Cocktail

item_6186.Description: Thick-sliced slab bacon from the most savory pork shoulder. Unlike most food, this does not give a long-term regeneration effect. Great Bacon is an instant pick-me-up any time!
item_6186.Name: Great Bacon

item_6188.Description: These carrot-flavored biscuits seem to be just as good as real carrots... to rabbits. They're pretty terrible-tasting to everybody else.
item_6188.Name: Rabbit Treat

item_6189.Description: Cheesy breaded porcini mushrooms with a lot of heat!
item_6189.Name: Spicy Porcini Bites

item_6190.Description: A watery soup. Edible but not at all inspiring.
item_6190.Name: Watery Mushroom Soup

item_6196.Description: It's a filling meal, but nobody's going to ask you for the recipe.
item_6196.Name: Clownfish Chowder

item_6198.Description: Pork chops in a delicious sweet sauce.
item_6198.Name: Pork Chops with Grape Jelly

item_62.Description: Hold down Shift to run very, very fast. You also take no damage from falls.
item_62.Name: Super Speed Potion

item_6200.Description: It's an apple coated in a sugar glaze so thick that it hurts your teeth to bite into. A somewhat tedious treat.
item_6200.Name: Candied Apple

item_6202.Description: A dish that could really use some spice. But it's tasty anyway.
item_6202.Name: Bland Mutton Vindaloo

item_6206.Description: It's an egg scrambled with onions and topped with hash browns.
item_6206.Name: Onion Omelet

item_6209.Description: This candy has some sort of horrible flavor. Licorice? It's awful.
item_6209.Name: Gross Candy

item_6210.Description: A sweet disk of hard candy. It's supposed to taste like... SOMETHING... but it's impossible to say what.
item_6210.Name: Fruit Candy

item_6211.Description: A sweet disk of hard candy that tastes of watermelon.
item_6211.Name: Watermelon Candy

item_6212.Description: A sweet and spicy disk of hard candy.
item_6212.Name: Cinnamon Candy

item_6213.Description: A vaguely grape-flavored disk of candy on a small stick.
item_6213.Name: Grape Lollipop

item_6214.Description: A sweet and minty disk of hard candy on a handy stick.
item_6214.Name: Mint Lollipop

item_6215.Description: A fruity disk of hard candy on a stick.
item_6215.Name: Berry Lollipop

item_6216.Description: Exotic-flavored candy that's unlike any natural food you've tasted. Candy aficionados love it.
item_6216.Name: Butterscotch-Cream Candy

item_6217.Description: Exotic candy that combines unlikely flavors. Candy connoisseurs swear by it.
item_6217.Name: Mint-Blueberry Candy

item_6218.Description: Amazing candy that can only be truly appreciated by expert gourmands. Comes in a bit of wax paper to prevent outside odors from diluting its flavor bouquet.
item_6218.Name: Grape-Strawberry Candy

item_6219.Description: A very simple version of the classic human cookie. Edible, but probably best used for decoration.
item_6219.Name: Bland Gingerbread Human

item_6220.Description: A nuanced and tasty version of the classic human treat.
item_6220.Name: Tasty Gingerbread Human

item_6221.Description: A nice blend of sweetness and mintiness.
item_6221.Name: Sweet-and-Minty Candy Cane

item_6224.Description: Only true connoisseurs realize that this sublimely delicious candy cane far exceeds its mint-addled cousins.
item_6224.Name: Grape Candy Cane

item_6225.Description: An elvish invention. A single fist-sized cube of this will keep you from being hungry all day. Although supposedly "jerky" flavored, there is no meat involved in the recipe and it actually tastes sort of like a fruitcake.
item_6225.Name: Jerky Lembas Brick

item_6226.Description: Unlike most food, this does not give a long-term regeneration effect. Fried potatoes are an instant pick-me-up any time!
item_6226.Name: Fried Potato Sticks

item_6228.Description: With a bewildering aroma and a barrage of different textures, this ranalon favorite is exotic and delicious... although it does take some getting used to.
item_6228.Name: Ranalon Salad

item_6229.Description: Carefully prepared and grilled lungfish. Makes a nice snack.
item_6229.Name: Lungfish Kabob

item_6230.Description: Fish and vegetables in a flour wrapping. Delicious!
item_6230.Name: Lungfish Roll

item_6231.Description: Deep-fried and battered. All races love an occasional greasy treat!
item_6231.Name: Fried Lungfish

item_6232.Description: A thick stew that fills you up.
item_6232.Name: Mokapok Stew

item_6233.Description: The humble pork chop taken to a higher level via careful marination.
item_6233.Name: Succulent Pork Chops

item_6234.Description: A dish that would definitely be too sweet if it didn't have the side-effect of numbing half your tastebuds while you eat.
item_6234.Name: Sweet and Numb Chicken

item_6235.Description: A tasty plate for the hero on a diet.
item_6235.Name: Diet Lunch

item_6236.Description: Delicious! Although it could be spicier.
item_6236.Name: Barbecue Rabbit Chops

item_6237.Description: This tongue-numbing drink doesn't taste good. But it doesn't taste BAD, either.
item_6237.Name: Cup o' Paralysis

item_6238.Description: Chicken that's succulent, sweet, sour, spicy, and numbing. All the flavors!
item_6238.Name: All-Flavor Chicken

item_6239.Description: A tasty meal that fills you up.
item_6239.Name: Creamy Squash Casserole

item_6240.Description: Deliciously baked vegetables covered in delicious cheese.
item_6240.Name: Broccoli Squash Bake

item_6241.Description: A very unconventional salad that's surprisingly energizing.
item_6241.Name: Winter Salad

item_6242.Description: A delicious breakfast. Too bad about the lack of syrup.
item_6242.Name: Banana-Almond Pancakes

item_6243.Description: A tasty and complex dish that makes the ingredients go a long way.
item_6243.Name: Chicken-Rabbit Rice

item_6244.Description: The sweet and spicy sauce goes perfectly with this plump quality chicken meat.
item_6244.Name: Barbecue Chicken

item_6245.Description: Some sort of meat in a delicious sauce.
item_6245.Name: Barbecued Mystery Meat

item_6246.Description: A tasty snack from the Red Wing casino.
item_6246.Name: Casino Kabobs

item_6247.Description: A delicious snack from the Red Wing Casino.
item_6247.Name: Deluxe Casino Kabobs

item_6248.Description: Some mantises say it's good for a hangover. But mantises don't eat soup, so who knows how they'd know that.
item_6248.Name: Recuperative Soup

item_6249.Description: Meat and vegetables in a creamy sauce. There's really nothing quite like this taste.
item_6249.Name: Mandibles' Perfect Lunch

item_6250.Description: A light breakfast to start a day of heavy gambling.
item_6250.Name: Casino Breakfast

item_6251.Description: An appealing-smelling mix of vegetables and mystery meat.
item_6251.Name: Casino Stir-Fry

item_6252.Description: A dense and filling food, but entirely unexciting and, well, frankly disappointing.
item_6252.Name: Disappointing Corn Surprise

item_6253.Description: Made with super-tart apples and complemented by super-sweet sugar. Delicious!
item_6253.Name: Tart Applesauce

item_6254.Description: It smells rancid and the texture is not pleasant. But it is filling.
item_6254.Name: Eyeball Soup

item_6255.Description: It starts delicious and then ends... not delicious.
item_6255.Name: Candied Heart

item_6256.Description: It looks revolting, but... actually it's pretty good.
item_6256.Name: Bone Soup

item_6257.Description: The pig snout is rubbery and squishy, but the sauce makes it work! Kind of.
item_6257.Name: Baked Pig Snout

item_6258.Description: Ham-flavored broth with maggots swimming in it! It looks vile but if you eat it quickly, it's... less vile.
item_6258.Name: Maggot Soup

item_6259.Description: Fried beetles with salt. What's not to like?
item_6259.Name: Basic Beetle Skewer

item_6260.Description: Beetles are the least-offensive ingredient in this horrifying -- but tasty -- snack.
item_6260.Name: Deluxe Beetle Skewer

item_6261.Description: They smell delicious and taste even better.
item_6261.Name: Cinnamon Pumpkin Rolls

item_6661.Description: Whatever type of meat this once was, it's completely overrun with demonic energy now.
item_6661.DynamicCraftingSummary: This can be used in Cooking recipes that call for 'Cheap Meat.' In those recipes, all Cheap Meat behaves the same way, so use whatever you have handy.
item_6661.Name: Infernal Meat

item_6662.Description: A basic but filling rye. Has a complex aroma and hints of molasses.
item_6662.Name: Rye Bread

item_6663.Description: A dense and delicious rye bread with strong hints of beer.
item_6663.Name: Beer Bread

item_6664.Description: A plain but tasty loaf of sourdough.
item_6664.Name: Simple Sourdough

item_6665.Description: A rich, dense, slightly sweet bread.
item_6665.Name: Pumpernickel Bread

item_6666.Description:
A hard-boiled egg, sliced in half, with the yolk taken out and replaced with the essence of an infernal hellspawn, then sprinkled with some spices. Just like mom used to make!

In addition to the usual food effects, this meal also reduces the power cost effect of Hellfire by 25%.
item_6666.Name: Deviled Egg

item_6667.Description:
An unidentifiable hunk of meat, imbued with demonic essence, and roasted to perfection.

In addition to the usual food effects, this meal also reduces the power cost effect of Hellfire by 25%.
item_6667.Name: Demonic Roast

item_6668.Description:
A tasty soup with little bits of delectable meat floating around in it, infused with demonic essence.

In addition to the usual food effects, this meal also reduces the power cost effect of Hellfire by 25%.
item_6668.Name: Infernal Soup

item_6669.Description:
A spongey cake with a light icing applied to the outside of it. Not made from actual angels, but from the purified essence of demon... close enough, right?

In addition to the usual food effects, this meal also reduces the power cost effect of Hellfire by 25%.
item_6669.Name: Angel Food Cake

item_6670.Description:
A human dish popular in the Crone Hegemony. This one is topped with tiny infernal souls that dance across the cheese and let out little hellish screams from time to time. So cute!

Note: Souls do not count as meat, so this is technically vegetarian.

In addition to the usual food effects, this meal also reduces the power cost effect of Hellfire by 25%.
item_6670.Name: Human-Style Pizza with Souls

item_6672.Description: A powerful pick-me-up for rabbits in danger.
item_6672.Name: Fuzzlebun's Energy Bar

item_6675.Description: A sweet yet savory holiday meal.

item_6676.Description: A loaf of enticing, lucious banana bread.

item_6677.Description: A heavenly snack that is squash-flavored, but in a good way.

item_6679.Description: The meat of a high-quality crab. Can be used in recipes or eaten raw.

item_71.Description: Teaches you the Myconian language. (This is a testing aid and will not be available for long; please use this to test the Myconian dungeon, which can be accessed via random brown mushrooms in Serbule.)
item_71.Name: Myconian Primer

item_72.Description: Lets you fly for 30 minutes (press the Move Up key to begin). You'll take no damage from falls while the effect lasts.
item_72.Name: Flight Potion

item_73.Description: You become a raven. Use the Move Up key to fly. Your attacks will do negligible damage. But you can fly, so that's something.
item_73.Name: Raven Potion

item_74.Description: Teaches you how to survey, find minerals, and mine ore. (Raises your skill in Surveying, Geology, and Mining to 1 if they aren't already.)
item_74.Name: Surveying Book

item_75.Description: Delicious potion that transforms you into a cow. Permanent until dispelled! WARNING: think before you drink!
item_75.Name: Cow Juice

item_77.Description: It's a note labeled "To my dear friend."

item_79.Description: Turns off PvP caused by PvP Juice test-potions.
item_79.Name: Un-PvP Juice

item_80.Description: Makes you PvP-flagged for a half hour. You can attack other players who are also PvP-flagged.
item_80.Name: PvP Juice (30 minutes)

item_81.Description: Makes you PvP for an hour.

item_82.Description: Strange weeds that supposedly bring the dead back to life.
